  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal data class StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      val leftFraction: Float,
      val topFraction: Float,
      val widthFraction: Float,
      val heightFraction: Float,
  ) {
      init {
          require(leftFraction >= 0f && topFraction >= 0f)
          require(widthFraction > 0f && heightFraction > 0f)
          require(leftFraction + widthFraction <= 1f)
          require(topFraction + heightFraction <= 1f)
      }
  }
  
  /** Bounds of the printed barcode card in the square logo_small.png asset. */
  internal val startupLogoCameraPatch = StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      leftFraction = 0.378f,
      topFraction = 0.575f,
      widthFraction = 0.382f,
      heightFraction = 0.100f,
  )
  
  internal fun GroundedResourceReadiness.startupConfirmationOrNull():
      GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming? = this as? GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming

  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import java.util.concurrent.Executors
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
  
  /** P2-03e camera eye: observes one analysis shape and creates no Stream/Beetle evidence. */
  @Composable
  internal fun StartupCameraConfirmationHost(
      attemptId: Long,
      onAnalysisFrame: (attemptId: Long, SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
      onUnavailable: (attemptId: Long) -> Unit,
      modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  ) {
      if (LocalInspectionMode.current) {
          Box(modifier = modifier.background(Color.DarkGray))
          return
      }
  
      val context = LocalContext.current
      val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
      val cameraProviderFuture = remember { ProcessCameraProvider.getInstance(context) }
      val previewView = remember(attemptId) {
          PreviewView(context).apply {
              scaleType = PreviewView.ScaleType.FILL_CENTER
          }
      }
      val mainExecutor = remember(context) { ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(context) }
      val analysisExecutor = remember(attemptId) {
          Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
              Thread(runnable, "ITROBOC-Startup-Confirmation").apply { isDaemon = true }
          }
      }
      val currentOnAnalysisFrame by rememberUpdatedState(onAnalysisFrame)
      val currentOnUnavailable by rememberUpdatedState(onUnavailable)
  
      DisposableEffect(attemptId, lifecycleOwner, cameraProviderFuture, analysisExecutor) {
          val settled = AtomicBoolean(false)
          var boundProvider: ProcessCameraProvider? = null
          var boundPreview: Preview? = null
          var boundAnalysis: ImageAnalysis? = null
  
          fun unavailableOnce() {
              if (settled.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                  currentOnUnavailable(attemptId)
              }
          }
  
          cameraProviderFuture.addListener({
              if (settled.get()) return@addListener
              val cameraProvider = try {
                  cameraProviderFuture.get()
              } catch (_: Exception) {
                  unavailableOnce()
                  return@addListener
              }
              val preview = createTdCameraPreview().also {
                  it.setSurfaceProvider(previewView.surfaceProvider)
              }
              val imageAnalysis = createTdImageAnalysis()
              imageAnalysis.setAnalyzer(analysisExecutor) { imageProxy ->
                  if (settled.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                      val size = SnapFrameSize(imageProxy.width, imageProxy.height)
                      imageProxy.close()
                      mainExecutor.execute {
                          imageAnalysis.clearAnalyzer()
                          runCatching { cameraProvider.unbind(preview, imageAnalysis) }
                          currentOnAnalysisFrame(attemptId, size)
                      }
                  } else {
                      imageProxy.close()
                  }
              }
  
              try {
                  cameraProvider.bindToLifecycle(
                      lifecycleOwner,
                      tdCameraSelector(),
                      preview,
                      imageAnalysis,
                  )
                  boundProvider = cameraProvider
                  boundPreview = preview
                  boundAnalysis = imageAnalysis
              } catch (_: Exception) {
                  imageAnalysis.clearAnalyzer()
                  unavailableOnce()
              }
          }, mainExecutor)
  
          onDispose {
              boundAnalysis?.clearAnalyzer()
              val useCases = listOfNotNull(boundPreview, boundAnalysis).toTypedArray()
              if (useCases.isNotEmpty()) {
                  runCatching { boundProvider?.unbind(*useCases) }
              }
              analysisExecutor.shutdown()
              unavailableOnce()
          }
      }
  
      AndroidView(
          factory = { previewView },
          modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize(),
      )
  }

  /**
   * Centralized typography for ITROBOC UI.
   * Prefer semantic roles over raw font sizes.

  object ItrobocTextStyles {
      // Large landing buttons
      val MainMenuAction = TextStyle(fontSize = 60.sp)
  
      // Merged: Screen title + Primary action buttons + Dialog title + Dialog section headers + Status summary + Swap headers
      val BigVisible = TextStyle(fontSize = 40.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
  
      // Internal cockpit/dialog groupings
      val SectionHeader = TextStyle(fontSize = 30.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
  
      // Merged: Cockpit header + Cockpit action button + Dialog action button
      val CockpitBasic = TextStyle(fontSize = 32.sp)
  
      // The large "Last Scanned" card ID

      // Merged: Hand card symbol + Hand card ranks

  # P2-03e — Logo camera contract confirmation
  
  Status: code passed Vel VFR; awaiting tablet verification
  
  Depends on: P2-03c
  
  ## Goal
  
  At calibrated startup, briefly replace the printed barcode card beneath the
  beetle in `logo_small.png` with a very small live camera patch while CameraX
  confirms that the saved/preallocated scene contract matches the current camera
  analysis session.
  
  The patch is not decorative proof. It must bind the same Preview plus
  ImageAnalysis use-case configuration used by TD Stream. Its first actual
  analysis frame supplies the confirmation dimensions. Merely drawing a Preview,
  or matching the Compose patch size, proves nothing about ImageAnalysis.
  
  ## Contract
  
  ```text
  saved schema-compatible contract
                !=
  confirmed compatible with this CameraX session
  ```
  
  - A valid saved contract lets startup preallocate the two complete scene slots,
    but leaves application readiness in `CONFIRMING`.
  - Persisted identity includes a schema version, selected camera identity,
    shared analysis-configuration identity, source frame size, Stream ROI, and
    derived SAA/SAB shape. A camera-selection change invalidates the candidate.
  - While confirming, Main Menu exposes only **Calibrate** and the camera patch
    occupies the small barcode-card area of the existing logo. Do not replace the
    beetle, wordmark, or the rest of the image.
  - Share the TD Preview/ImageAnalysis configuration seam. If resolution behavior
    needs to be pinned, introduce one shared CameraX resolution policy rather
    than relying on the logo patch's measured UI size.
  - A matching ImageAnalysis frame seals readiness, removes the temporary camera
    host, and restores the ordinary Main Menu actions.
  - Schema incompatibility, camera identity/configuration change, or mismatching
    ImageAnalysis geometry returns `INVALID`. Delete the saved candidate
    immediately, retire its preallocated slot generation, and leave only
    **Calibrate** available; do not revive the rejected contract.
  - Missing/revoked camera permission, transient camera-provider/binding failure,
    or lifecycle disposal before an analysis frame returns `UNCONFIRMED`. Retain
    the saved candidate, never grant readiness, and still leave only
    **Calibrate** available. Permission regrant alone restores nothing; a later
    ceremony must obtain a fresh confirming frame and must not silently loop in
    the failed ceremony.
  - The confirmation host must unbind immediately after success or disposal. Do
    not decode barcodes, create Beetle evidence, start Love Blonds, or count the
    confirmation frame as FOF/SPS.
  - Do not add an artificial Analyzer sleep. The patch lives for the real
    negotiation/confirmation interval; tablet verification decides whether a
    small presentation-only dwell is needed to make the visual legible.
  
  ## Will the small patch negotiate?
  
  Yes, if it is a real CameraX binding that includes ImageAnalysis. The visible
  patch size alone does not choose or verify analysis dimensions. CameraX still
  negotiates its bound streams; therefore the ticket must observe the resulting
  ImageAnalysis frame and must use the same use-case contract as TD. The first
  tablet run records both confirmation and TD dimensions to prove they agree.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [x] Pure state tests distinguish saved candidate, confirming, ready, and
    invalid states.
  - [x] Pure patch-geometry/access tests plus Main Menu source inspection place
    the temporary camera host over the logo's printed barcode card and keep only
    **Calibrate** actionable until confirmation.
  - [x] A Preview-only callback cannot seal readiness; one matching
    ImageAnalysis frame can.
  - [x] Mismatch and camera/configuration change invalidate and delete the
    persisted candidate; permission loss, provider/binding failure, and disposal
    remain unconfirmed and preserve it. Neither outcome leaves stale readiness
    or a bound startup camera.
  - [ ] Tablet evidence records the Main Menu confirmation frame dimensions and
    the first TD analysis dimensions under the same camera selection.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  This ticket confirms camera configuration and controls startup navigation. At
  its landing it did not scan a card, capture an Impression, or integrate slots
  into TD; P2-03d has since activated capture. The tiny rendered surface still
  does not determine analysis resolution.
  
  ## Implemented confirmation road
  
  A schema-compatible candidate with existing camera permission enters one
  correlated `CONFIRMING` attempt. Main Menu overlays a real Preview plus
  ImageAnalysis host on the printed barcode card in `logo_small.png`; the host
  shares the back-camera selector, Preview construction, and keep-latest analysis
  construction used by TD. Drawing the patch publishes nothing. Its first actual
  analysis frame closes immediately and supplies only the unrotated dimensions.
  
  Matching frame/ROI/derived-scene identity seals `READY`. Contradiction deletes
  the saved candidate, revokes the replaceable pool generation, and publishes
  `INVALID`. Provider/binding failure, disposal, permission loss, or a manual
  Calibrate takeover publishes `UNCONFIRMED`, retains the candidate, and rejects
  late callbacks by attempt correlation. Camera permission is rechecked on app
  resume; regrant alone does not start a second ceremony. The host never invokes
  a decoder, Stream lane, BeetleMind, FOF/SPS, Love Blonds, or Impression capture.
  
  ## Vel VFR
  
  Vel reviewed `47e35d3` and kept its implementation without a corrective code
  patch. The confirmation state has one correlated authority; success, failure,
  manual takeover, permission loss, and disposal reject late callbacks. The host
  closes its single analysis frame, clears the Analyzer, and unbinds only its own
  shared-policy Preview/ImageAnalysis use cases. INVALID revokes one replaceable
  pool generation rather than terminally closing the application owner.
  
  Visual inspection of the `313 x 313` logo places the fractional patch at
  approximately `(118, 180)..(238, 211)`, over the printed barcode card without
  covering the beetle or wordmark. Focused confirmation/startup/pool tests and
  the full `./gradlew test` suite passed on 2026-08-19. This is static and
  automated evidence only: tablet verification still owns actual patch
  legibility, prompt unbinding, and equality of startup and TD negotiated
  analysis dimensions.
  
  ## Accepted Vel dissent — failure is not falsification
  
  Archy accepts the distinction between `INVALID` and `UNCONFIRMED`. Both enforce
  the same hard product gate, so no profile, exchange, settings, Admin, or TD work
  can proceed. They differ only in what the evidence permits us to destroy:
  
  ```text
  actual contradictory configuration/frame evidence -> INVALID -> delete
  no confirming evidence before transient failure     -> UNCONFIRMED -> retain
  ```
  
  Closing the confirmation ceremony before reading a frame cannot prove the
  saved contract false. Implementation must also retire invalid preallocation as
  one replaceable pool generation; the current pool's terminal `close()` must not
  strand later recalibration.

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
  import androidx.compose.material3.*
  import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
  import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
  import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.contentDescription
  import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.semantics
  import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
  import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
  
  @Composable
  internal fun MainMenuScreen(
      resourceAccess: MainMenuResourceAccess,
      startupConfirmation: GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming?,
      onNavigate: (Screen) -> Unit,
      onCalibrate: () -> Unit,
      onConfirmationFrame: (attemptId: Long, org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
      onConfirmationUnavailable: (attemptId: Long) -> Unit,
  ) {
      Column(
          modifier = Modifier
              .fillMaxSize()
              .padding(16.dp),
          horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
      ) {
          BoxWithConstraints(
              modifier = Modifier.weight(4f).fillMaxWidth(),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
          ) {
              val logoSize = minOf(maxWidth, maxHeight)
              Box(modifier = Modifier.size(logoSize)) {
                  Image(
                      painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.logo_small),
                      contentDescription = "ITROBOC Logo",
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                  )
                  startupConfirmation?.let { confirming ->
                      StartupCameraConfirmationHost(
                          attemptId = confirming.attemptId,
                          onAnalysisFrame = onConfirmationFrame,
                          onUnavailable = onConfirmationUnavailable,
                          modifier = Modifier
                              .offset(
                                  x = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.leftFraction,
                                  y = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.topFraction,
                              )
                              .size(
                                  width = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.widthFraction,
                                  height = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.heightFraction,
                              )
                              .semantics {
                                  contentDescription = "Confirming calibrated camera"
                              },
                      )
                  }
              }
          }
  
          Row(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
              if (resourceAccess == MainMenuResourceAccess.CALIBRATION_ONLY) {
                  Button(
                      onClick = onCalibrate,
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(8f),
                  ) {
                      Text("Calibrate", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
              } else {
                  Button(
                      onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.AdminActions) },
                      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                  ) {
                      Text("Admin", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
  
                  Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import android.Manifest
  import android.os.Bundle
  import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
  import androidx.activity.compose.rememberLauncherForActivityResult
  import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
  import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
  import androidx.activity.viewModels
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
  import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
  import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
  import androidx.compose.runtime.*
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
  import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
  import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleEventObserver
  import androidx.lifecycle.compose.LocalLifecycleOwner
  import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
  
  class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
      private val viewModel: ItrobocMainViewModel by viewModels()
  
      override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
          super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
          AdminEditScanDebugLogStartup.clearOnce(this)
          setContent {
              MaterialTheme {
                  Surface(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                      AppNavigation(viewModel)
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  }
  
  @Composable
  fun AppNavigation(viewModel: ItrobocMainViewModel) {
      val activeProfileItem = viewModel.activeProfileItem
      val activeDeckProfile = viewModel.activeDeckProfile
      val context = LocalContext.current
      val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
  
      // Global Camera Permission Ceremony
      val launcher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
          contract = ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(),
          onResult = { granted ->
              viewModel.updateCameraPermission(granted)
          }
      )
  
      LaunchedEffect(viewModel.hasCameraPermission) {
          if (!viewModel.hasCameraPermission) {
              launcher.launch(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
          }
      }
  
      DisposableEffect(lifecycleOwner, context) {
          val observer = LifecycleEventObserver { _, event ->
              if (event == Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME) {
                  viewModel.updateCameraPermission(
                      ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) ==
                          android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED,
                  )
              }
          }
          lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.addObserver(observer)
          onDispose { lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.removeObserver(observer) }
      }
  
      when (val screen = viewModel.currentScreen) {
          is Screen.MainMenu -> {
              MainMenuScreen(
                  resourceAccess = viewModel.groundedResourceReadiness.mainMenuAccess(),
                  startupConfirmation = viewModel.groundedResourceReadiness
                      .startupConfirmationOrNull(),
                  onNavigate = { viewModel.navigateTo(it) },
                  onCalibrate = {
                      viewModel.beginResourceCalibration()
                      viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminCalibrate)
                  },
                  onConfirmationFrame = viewModel::confirmStartupResources,
                  onConfirmationUnavailable = viewModel::stopStartupConfirmation,
              )
          }
          is Screen.TdActions -> {
              TdOverviewScreen(
                  sessionState = viewModel.sessionState,
                  activeProfile = activeProfileItem,
                  autosaveEnabled = viewModel.autosaveEnabled,
                  autosavePrefix = viewModel.autosavePrefix,
                  autosavePath = viewModel.autosavePath,
                  snapTuningSettings = viewModel.snapTuningSettings,
                  oldFilesCount = viewModel.oldAutosaveFiles.size,
                  onSessionStateChange = { viewModel.updateSession(it) },
                  onAutosaveEnabledChange = { viewModel.updateAutosaveEnabled(it) },
                  onAutosavePrefixChange = { viewModel.updateAutosavePrefix(it) },
                  onSnapTuningSettingsChange = { viewModel.updateSnapTuningSettings(it) },
                  onResetSnapTuningSettings = { viewModel.resetSnapTuningSettings() },
                  onClearOldFiles = { viewModel.clearOldFiles(it) },
                  onWipeSession = { viewModel.wipeSession() },
                  onNavigateToBoard = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.EditBoard(it)) },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.MainMenu) }
              )
          }
          is Screen.EditBoard -> {
              val boardEditState = viewModel.sessionState.getOrInitBoard(screen.boardNumber)
              key(screen.boardNumber) {
                  EditBoardScreen(
                      boardEditState = boardEditState,
                      deckProfile = activeDeckProfile,
                      orientationMode = viewModel.barcodeOrientationMode,
                      feedMode = viewModel.tdFeedMode,
                      requiredConsensusFrames = viewModel.sessionState.requiredConsensusFrames,
                      snapTuningSettings = viewModel.snapTuningSettings,
                      groundedBufferPool = viewModel.groundedBufferPool,
                      totalBoardsInGrid = viewModel.sessionState.totalBoardsInGrid,
                      onOrientationModeChange = { viewModel.updateOrientation(it) },
                      onFeedModeChange = { viewModel.updateTdFeedMode(it) },
                      onBoardEditStateChange = { updatedState ->
                          viewModel.updateSession(viewModel.sessionState.updateBoard(updatedState))
                      },
                      onGroundedResourceFailure = viewModel::invalidateGroundedResources,
                      onNavigateToBoard = { boardNumber ->
                          viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.EditBoard(boardNumber))
                      },
                      onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.TdActions) }
                  )
              }
          }
          is Screen.AdminActions -> {
              AdminActionsScreen(
                  uiState = viewModel.profileState,
                  onSelectProfile = { viewModel.selectProfile(it) },
                  onAddProfile = { viewModel.addProfile(it) },
                  onDeleteActiveProfile = { viewModel.deleteActiveProfile() },
                  onExportActiveProfile = { activeDeckProfile },
                  onImportProfile = { viewModel.importProfile(it) },
                  onEdit = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminEdit) },
                  onCalibrate = {
                      viewModel.beginResourceCalibration()
                      viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminCalibrate)
                  },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.MainMenu) },
              )
          }
          is Screen.AdminCalibrate -> {
              AdminCalibrateScreen(
                  onResolutionDiscovered = { size, attemptId ->
                      viewModel.groundResources(
                          attemptId,
                          groundedResourceContractFor(size),
                      )
                  },
                  state = viewModel.groundedResourceCalibrationState,
                  onCameraFailure = viewModel::failResourceCalibration,
                  onRetry = viewModel::beginResourceCalibration,
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.MainMenu) }
              )
          }
          is Screen.AdminEdit -> {
              val editor = remember(activeProfileItem.id) { activeDeckProfile.toEditor() }
              AdminEditScreen(
                  editor = editor,
                  hasCameraPermission = viewModel.hasCameraPermission,
                  onSave = { updatedProfile ->
                      viewModel.saveEditedProfile(updatedProfile)
                  },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminActions) }
              )
          }
      }
  }

    ```kotlin
    }
    ```
    *Note: `PreviewView` doesn't support a "stretch-to-fill" (distorted) mode natively, but we can achieve a "squeeze" effect by changing the `scaleType` or wrapping the `AndroidView` in a custom layout.*

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import kotlin.test.Test
  import kotlin.test.assertEquals
  import kotlin.test.assertIs
  import kotlin.test.assertNull
  import kotlin.test.assertTrue
  
  class StartupCameraConfirmationTest {
      @Test
      fun `compatible saved candidate starts confirmation and preview alone cannot seal it`() {
          val fixture = fixtureWithSavedContract()
  
          fixture.startup.restore(canConfirm = true)
  
          val confirming = assertIs<GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming>(fixture.startup.readiness)
          assertEquals(fixture.contract, confirming.contract)
          assertEquals(confirming, fixture.startup.readiness.startupConfirmationOrNull())
          assertEquals(MainMenuResourceAccess.CALIBRATION_ONLY, confirming.mainMenuAccess())
      }
  
      @Test
      fun `one matching analysis frame seals current session readiness`() {
          val fixture = fixtureWithSavedContract()
          fixture.startup.restore(canConfirm = true)
          val attemptId = assertIs<GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming>(
              fixture.startup.readiness,
          ).attemptId
  
          fixture.startup.confirmAnalysisFrame(attemptId, fixture.contract.sourceFrameSize)
  
          assertEquals(GroundedResourceReadiness.Ready(fixture.contract), fixture.startup.readiness)
          assertEquals(MainMenuResourceAccess.ORDINARY, fixture.startup.readiness.mainMenuAccess())
          assertNull(fixture.startup.readiness.startupConfirmationOrNull())
      }
  
      @Test
      fun `contradictory frame invalidates candidate and retires preallocation`() {
          val fixture = fixtureWithSavedContract()
          fixture.startup.restore(canConfirm = true)
          val attemptId = assertIs<GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming>(
              fixture.startup.readiness,
          ).attemptId
  
          fixture.startup.confirmAnalysisFrame(attemptId, SnapFrameSize(120, 100))
  
          assertIs<GroundedResourceReadiness.Invalid>(fixture.startup.readiness)
          assertNull(fixture.store.read())
          assertNull(fixture.pool.snapshot().shape)
          assertEquals(MainMenuResourceAccess.CALIBRATION_ONLY, fixture.startup.readiness.mainMenuAccess())
      }
  
      @Test
      fun `provider failure or disposal retains candidate and rejects late frame`() {
          val fixture = fixtureWithSavedContract()
          fixture.startup.restore(canConfirm = true)
          val attemptId = assertIs<GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming>(
              fixture.startup.readiness,
          ).attemptId
  
          fixture.startup.confirmationUnavailable(attemptId)
          fixture.startup.confirmAnalysisFrame(attemptId, fixture.contract.sourceFrameSize)
  
          assertEquals(
              GroundedResourceReadiness.Unconfirmed(fixture.contract),
              fixture.startup.readiness,
          )
          assertEquals(fixture.contract, fixture.preferences.load(tdCameraAnalysisIdentity))
      }
  
      @Test
      fun `manual ceremony cancels confirmation authority before a late frame`() {
          val fixture = fixtureWithSavedContract()
          fixture.startup.restore(canConfirm = true)
          val attemptId = assertIs<GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming>(
              fixture.startup.readiness,
          ).attemptId
  
          fixture.startup.cancelConfirmation()
          fixture.startup.confirmAnalysisFrame(attemptId, fixture.contract.sourceFrameSize)
  
          assertEquals(
              GroundedResourceReadiness.Unconfirmed(fixture.contract),
              fixture.startup.readiness,
          )
      }
  
      @Test
      fun `missing permission starts unconfirmed and later grant does not silently retry`() {
          val fixture = fixtureWithSavedContract()
  
          fixture.startup.restore(canConfirm = false)
          fixture.startup.observeCameraPermission(granted = true)
  
          assertEquals(
              GroundedResourceReadiness.Unconfirmed(fixture.contract),
              fixture.startup.readiness,
          )
      }
  
      @Test
      fun `incompatible persisted identity becomes invalid and is deleted`() {
          val store = FakeContractStore()
          val preferences = GroundedResourceContractPreferences(store)
          preferences.save(
              groundedResourceContractFor(SnapFrameSize(100, 100)).copy(
                  identity = CameraAnalysisIdentity("front-camera-v1", "keep-only-latest-v1"),
              ),
          )
          val startup = GroundedResourceStartup(
              pool = GroundedBufferPool(),
              preferences = preferences,
              identity = tdCameraAnalysisIdentity,
          )
  
          startup.restore(canConfirm = true)
  
          assertIs<GroundedResourceReadiness.Invalid>(startup.readiness)
          assertNull(store.read())
      }
  
      @Test
      fun `logo patch stays within square asset and covers the printed card band`() {
          assertTrue(startupLogoCameraPatch.leftFraction in 0.37f..0.39f)
          assertTrue(startupLogoCameraPatch.topFraction in 0.57f..0.59f)
          assertTrue(
              startupLogoCameraPatch.leftFraction + startupLogoCameraPatch.widthFraction <= 1f,
          )
          assertTrue(
              startupLogoCameraPatch.topFraction + startupLogoCameraPatch.heightFraction <= 1f,
          )
      }
  
      private fun fixtureWithSavedContract(): Fixture {
          val store = FakeContractStore()
          val preferences = GroundedResourceContractPreferences(store)
          val contract = groundedResourceContractFor(SnapFrameSize(100, 100))
          preferences.save(contract)
          val pool = GroundedBufferPool()
          return Fixture(
              pool = pool,
              store = store,
              preferences = preferences,
              contract = contract,
              startup = GroundedResourceStartup(
                  pool = pool,
                  preferences = preferences,
                  identity = tdCameraAnalysisIdentity,
              ),
          )
      }
  
      private data class Fixture(
          val pool: GroundedBufferPool,
          val store: FakeContractStore,
          val preferences: GroundedResourceContractPreferences,
          val contract: GroundedResourceContract,
          val startup: GroundedResourceStartup,
      )
  
      private class FakeContractStore(
          private var value: String? = null,
      ) : GroundedResourceContractStore {
          override fun read(): String? = value
  
          override fun write(value: String) {
              this.value = value
          }
  
          override fun clear() {
              value = null
          }
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal data class StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      val leftFraction: Float,
      val topFraction: Float,
      val widthFraction: Float,
      val heightFraction: Float,
  ) {
      init {
          require(leftFraction >= 0f && topFraction >= 0f)
          require(widthFraction > 0f && heightFraction > 0f)
          require(leftFraction + widthFraction <= 1f)
          require(topFraction + heightFraction <= 1f)
      }
  }
  
  /** Bounds of the printed barcode card in the square logo_small.png asset. */
  internal val startupLogoCameraPatch = StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      leftFraction = 0.431f,
      topFraction = 0.584f,
      widthFraction = 0.268f,
      heightFraction = 0.198f,
  )
  
  internal fun GroundedResourceReadiness.startupConfirmationOrNull():
      GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming? = this as? GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
  import androidx.compose.material3.*
  import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
  import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
  import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.contentDescription
  import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.semantics
  import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
  import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
  
  @Composable
  internal fun MainMenuScreen(
      resourceAccess: MainMenuResourceAccess,
      startupConfirmation: GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming?,
      onNavigate: (Screen) -> Unit,
      onCalibrate: () -> Unit,
      onConfirmationFrame: (attemptId: Long, org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
      onConfirmationUnavailable: (attemptId: Long) -> Unit,
  ) {
      Column(
          modifier = Modifier
              .fillMaxSize()
              .padding(16.dp),
          horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
      ) {
          BoxWithConstraints(
              modifier = Modifier.weight(4f).fillMaxWidth(),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
          ) {
              val logoSize = minOf(maxWidth, maxHeight)
              Box(modifier = Modifier.size(logoSize)) {
                  Image(
                      painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.logo_small),
                      contentDescription = "ITROBOC Logo",
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                  )
                  startupConfirmation?.let { confirming ->
                      StartupCameraConfirmationHost(
                          attemptId = confirming.attemptId,
                          onAnalysisFrame = onConfirmationFrame,
                          onUnavailable = onConfirmationUnavailable,
                          modifier = Modifier
                              .offset(
                                  x = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.leftFraction,
                                  y = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.topFraction,
                              )
                              .size(
                                  width = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.widthFraction,
                                  height = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.heightFraction,
                              )
                              .semantics {
                                  contentDescription = "Confirming calibrated camera"
                              },
                      )
                  }
              }
          }
  
          Row(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
              if (resourceAccess == MainMenuResourceAccess.CALIBRATION_ONLY) {
                  Button(
                      onClick = onCalibrate,
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(8f),
                  ) {
                      Text("Calibrate", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
              } else {
                  Button(
                      onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.AdminActions) },
                      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                  ) {
                      Text("Admin", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
  
                  Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))
  
                  Button(
                      onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.TdActions) },
                      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                  ) {
                      Text("TD eye", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
              }
          }
          
      }
  }
  
  @Preview(showBackground = true)
  @Composable
  fun MainMenuPreview() {
      MaterialTheme {
          MainMenuScreen(
              resourceAccess = MainMenuResourceAccess.ORDINARY,
              startupConfirmation = null,
              onNavigate = {},
              onCalibrate = {},
              onConfirmationFrame = { _, _ -> },
              onConfirmationUnavailable = {},
          )
      }
  }

The "Startup Eye" has been refined to move from a raw technical patch to a grounded, metaphorical cognition seam.

## Changes Made

### 1. Precision Alignment
- **`StartupLogoCameraPatch.kt`**: Coordinates updated to match Archy's pixel measurements (135, 184) to (217, 184) on the 313x313 logo asset. The patch now maintains a standard 4:3 aspect ratio.
- **`StartupCameraConfirmationTest.kt`**: Regression tests updated to reflect the new precision coordinates.

### 2. The Aesthetic Braid (MainMenuScreen.kt)
- **Animated Visibility**: The camera Eye now fades in smoothly when confirmation begins and fades out when it finishes, rather than snapping into existence.
- **Viewfinder Border**: A subtle green border (`alpha = 0.5f`) defines the boundaries of the cognitive pupil.
- **Scanning Beam**: An infinite scanline animation (`LinearOutSlowInEasing`) sweeps across the Eye, signaling active perception.
- **Muted Cognition**: A grayscale-ish tonal shift (via `BlendMode.Saturation`) is applied to the live feed to distinguish it from the final TD Stream experience.

## Verification

### Automated Tests
- `StartupCameraConfirmationTest.kt` updated and syntactically verified.
- `MainMenuScreen.kt` build errors (scope conflicts and FQN issues) resolved.

### Manual Verification Required

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal data class StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      val leftFraction: Float,
      val topFraction: Float,
      val widthFraction: Float,
      val heightFraction: Float,
  ) {
      init {
          require(leftFraction >= 0f && topFraction >= 0f)
          require(widthFraction > 0f && heightFraction > 0f)
          require(leftFraction + widthFraction <= 1f)
          require(topFraction + heightFraction <= 1f)
      }
  }
  
  /** Bounds of the printed barcode card in the square logo_small.png asset. */
  internal val startupLogoCameraPatch = StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      leftFraction = 0.431f,
      topFraction = 0.584f,
      widthFraction = 0.268f,
      heightFraction = 0.198f,
  )
  
  internal fun GroundedResourceReadiness.startupConfirmationOrNull():
      GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming? = this as? GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import androidx.compose.animation.core.*
  import androidx.compose.animation.fadeIn
  import androidx.compose.animation.fadeOut
  import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
  import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
  import androidx.compose.foundation.border
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
  import androidx.compose.material3.*
  import androidx.compose.runtime.*
  import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  import androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawWithContent
  import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
  import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.BlendMode
  import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
  import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
  import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.contentDescription
  import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.semantics
  import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
  import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
  
  @Composable
  internal fun MainMenuScreen(
      resourceAccess: MainMenuResourceAccess,
      startupConfirmation: GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming?,
      onNavigate: (Screen) -> Unit,
      onCalibrate: () -> Unit,
      onConfirmationFrame: (attemptId: Long, org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
      onConfirmationUnavailable: (attemptId: Long) -> Unit,
  ) {
      Column(
          modifier = Modifier
              .fillMaxSize()
              .padding(16.dp),
          horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
      ) {
          BoxWithConstraints(
              modifier = Modifier.weight(4f).fillMaxWidth(),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
          ) {
              val logoSize = if (this.maxWidth < this.maxHeight) this.maxWidth else this.maxHeight
              Box(modifier = Modifier.size(logoSize)) {
                  Image(
                      painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.logo_small),
                      contentDescription = "ITROBOC Logo",
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                  )
                  androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility(
                      visible = startupConfirmation != null,
                      enter = fadeIn(),
                      exit = fadeOut(),
                      modifier = Modifier
                          .offset(
                              x = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.leftFraction,
                              y = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.topFraction,
                          )
                          .size(
                              width = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.widthFraction,
                              height = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.heightFraction,
                          )
                  ) {
                      val confirming = startupConfirmation!!
                      Box(
                          modifier = Modifier
                              .fillMaxSize()
                              .border(1.dp, Color.Green.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                              .drawWithContent {
                                  drawContent()
                                  drawRect(
                                      color = Color.Gray,
                                      alpha = 0.7f,
                                      blendMode = BlendMode.Saturation
                                  )
                              }
                              .semantics {
                                  contentDescription = "Confirming calibrated camera"
                              }
                      ) {
                          StartupCameraConfirmationHost(
                              attemptId = confirming.attemptId,
                              onAnalysisFrame = onConfirmationFrame,
                              onUnavailable = onConfirmationUnavailable,
                              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                          )
  
                          val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "StartupScanline")
                          val scanLineOffset by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
                              initialValue = 0f,
                              targetValue = 1f,
                              animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
                                  animation = tween(1500, easing = LinearOutSlowInEasing),
                                  repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
                              ),
                              label = "ScanlineOffset"
                          )
  
                          Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                              val currentSize = size
                              val y = currentSize.height * scanLineOffset
                              drawLine(
                                  color = Color.Green.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                                  start = Offset(0f, y),
                                  end = Offset(currentSize.width, y),
                                  strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx()
                              )
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
  
          Row(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
              if (resourceAccess == MainMenuResourceAccess.CALIBRATION_ONLY) {
                  Button(
                      onClick = onCalibrate,
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(8f),
                  ) {
                      Text("Calibrate", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
              } else {
                  Button(
                      onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.AdminActions) },
                      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                  ) {
                      Text("Admin", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
  
                  Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))
  
                  Button(
                      onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.TdActions) },
                      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                  ) {
                      Text("TD eye", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
              }
          }
          
      }
  }
  
  @Preview(showBackground = true)
  @Composable
  fun MainMenuPreview() {
      MaterialTheme {
          MainMenuScreen(
              resourceAccess = MainMenuResourceAccess.ORDINARY,
              startupConfirmation = null,
              onNavigate = {},
              onCalibrate = {},
              onConfirmationFrame = { _, _ -> },
              onConfirmationUnavailable = {},
          )
      }
  }

    ) {
        BoxWithConstraints(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(4f).fillMaxWidth(),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            val logoSize = if (this.maxWidth < this.maxHeight) this.maxWidth else this.maxHeight
            val confirmingToRender = remember { mutableStateOf<GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming?>(null) }
            if (startupConfirmation != null) {
                confirmingToRender.value = startupConfirmation
            }
            Box(modifier = Modifier.size(logoSize)) {
                Image(
                    painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.logo_small),
                    contentDescription = "ITROBOC Logo",
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                )
                androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility(
                    visible = startupConfirmation != null,
                    enter = fadeIn(),
                    exit = fadeOut(),
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .offset(
                            x = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.leftFraction,
                            y = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.topFraction,
                        )
                        .size(
                            width = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.widthFraction,
                            height = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.heightFraction,
                        )
                ) {
                    val confirming = confirmingToRender.value
                    if (confirming != null) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .fillMaxSize()
                                .border(1.dp, Color.Green.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                                .drawWithContent {
                                    drawContent()
                                    drawRect(
                                        color = Color.Gray,
                                        alpha = 0.7f,
                                        blendMode = BlendMode.Saturation
                                    )
                                }
                                .semantics {
                                    contentDescription = "Confirming calibrated camera"
                                }
                        ) {
                            StartupCameraConfirmationHost(
                                attemptId = confirming.attemptId,
                                onAnalysisFrame = onConfirmationFrame,
                                onUnavailable = onConfirmationUnavailable,
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            )

                            val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "StartupScanline")
                            val scanLineOffset by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
                                initialValue = 0f,
                                targetValue = 1f,
                                animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
                                    animation = tween(1500, easing = LinearOutSlowInEasing),
                                    repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
                                ),
                                label = "ScanlineOffset"
                            )

                            Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                                val currentSize = size
                                val y = currentSize.height * scanLineOffset
                                drawLine(
                                    color = Color.Green.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                                    start = Offset(0f, y),
                                    end = Offset(currentSize.width, y),
                                    strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx()
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Row(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
            if (resourceAccess == MainMenuResourceAccess.CALIBRATION_ONLY) {
                Button(
                    onClick = onCalibrate,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(8f),
                ) {
                    Text("Calibrate", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                }
            } else {
                Button(
                    onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.AdminActions) },
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                ) {
                    Text("Admin", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))

                Button(
                    onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.TdActions) },
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                ) {
                    Text("TD eye", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal data class StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      val leftFraction: Float,
      val topFraction: Float,
      val widthFraction: Float,
      val heightFraction: Float,
  ) {
      init {
          require(leftFraction >= 0f && topFraction >= 0f)
          require(widthFraction > 0f && heightFraction > 0f)
          require(leftFraction + widthFraction <= 1f)
          require(topFraction + heightFraction <= 1f)
      }
  }
  
  /** Bounds of the printed barcode card in the square logo_small.png asset. */

  package org.itroboc.app

  import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
  import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
  import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale
  import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource

  import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.semantics
  import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
  import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
  
  @Composable
  internal fun MainMenuScreen(
      resourceAccess: MainMenuResourceAccess,
      startupConfirmation: GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming?,
      onNavigate: (Screen) -> Unit,
      onCalibrate: () -> Unit,
      onConfirmationFrame: (attemptId: Long, org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
      onConfirmationUnavailable: (attemptId: Long) -> Unit,
  ) {
      Column(
          modifier = Modifier
              .fillMaxSize()
              .padding(16.dp),
          horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
      ) {
          BoxWithConstraints(
              modifier = Modifier.weight(4f).fillMaxWidth(),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
          ) {
              val logoSize = if (this.maxWidth < this.maxHeight) this.maxWidth else this.maxHeight
              Box(modifier = Modifier.size(logoSize)) {
                  Image(
                      painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.logo_small),
                      contentDescription = "ITROBOC Logo",
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                  )
                  LittleTheatreForWidthAndHeight(
                      startupConfirmation = startupConfirmation,
                      onConfirmationFrame = onConfirmationFrame,
                      onConfirmationUnavailable = onConfirmationUnavailable,
                      modifier = Modifier
                          .offset(
                              x = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.leftFraction,
                              y = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.topFraction,
                          )
                          .size(
                              width = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.widthFraction,
                              height = logoSize * startupLogoCameraPatch.heightFraction,
                          ),
                  )
              }
          }
  
          Row(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
              if (resourceAccess == MainMenuResourceAccess.CALIBRATION_ONLY) {
                  Button(
                      onClick = onCalibrate,
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(8f),
                  ) {
                      Text("Calibrate", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
              } else {
                  Button(
                      onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.AdminActions) },
                      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                  ) {
                      Text("Admin", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
  
                  Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))
  
                  Button(
                      onClick = { onNavigate(Screen.TdActions) },
                      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)
                  ) {
                      Text("TD eye", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction)
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  }
  
  @Composable
  private fun LittleTheatreForWidthAndHeight(
      startupConfirmation: GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming?,
      onConfirmationFrame: (attemptId: Long, org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
      onConfirmationUnavailable: (attemptId: Long) -> Unit,
      modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  ) {
      val confirmingToRender = remember {
          mutableStateOf<GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming?>(null)
      }
      if (startupConfirmation != null) {
          confirmingToRender.value = startupConfirmation
      }
  
      androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility(
          visible = startupConfirmation != null,
          enter = fadeIn(),
          exit = fadeOut(),
          modifier = modifier,
      ) {
          val confirming = confirmingToRender.value
          if (confirming != null) {
              Box(
                  modifier = Modifier
                      .fillMaxSize()
                      .border(4.dp, Color.Green.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                      .semantics {
                          contentDescription = "Confirming calibrated camera"
                      },
              ) {
                  StartupCameraConfirmationHost(
                      attemptId = confirming.attemptId,
                      onAnalysisFrame = onConfirmationFrame,
                      onUnavailable = onConfirmationUnavailable,
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                  )
  
                  Image(
                      painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.logo_small),
                      contentDescription = "Kind introspection",
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                      contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                  )
  
                  val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "StartupScanline")
                  val scanLineOffset by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
                      initialValue = 0f,
                      targetValue = 1f,
                      animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
                          animation = tween(3000, easing = LinearEasing),
                          repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart,
                      ),

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import androidx.camera.core.ImageAnalysis
  import androidx.camera.core.Preview
  import androidx.camera.lifecycle.ProcessCameraProvider
  import androidx.camera.view.PreviewView
  import androidx.compose.foundation.background
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
  import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
  import androidx.compose.runtime.DisposableEffect
  import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
  import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
  import androidx.compose.runtime.rememberUpdatedState
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
  import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
  import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalInspectionMode
  import androidx.compose.ui.viewinterop.AndroidView
  import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
  import androidx.lifecycle.compose.LocalLifecycleOwner
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import java.util.concurrent.Executors
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
  
  /** P2-03e camera eye: observes one analysis shape and creates no Stream/Beetle evidence. */
  @Composable
  internal fun StartupCameraConfirmationHost(
      attemptId: Long,
      onAnalysisFrame: (attemptId: Long, SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
      onUnavailable: (attemptId: Long) -> Unit,
      modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  ) {
      if (LocalInspectionMode.current) {
          Box(modifier = modifier.background(Color.DarkGray))
          return
      }
  
      val context = LocalContext.current
      val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
      val cameraProviderFuture = remember { ProcessCameraProvider.getInstance(context) }
      val previewView = remember(attemptId) {
          PreviewView(context).apply {
              scaleType = PreviewView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER
          }
      }
      val mainExecutor = remember(context) { ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(context) }
      val analysisExecutor = remember(attemptId) {
          Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
              Thread(runnable, "ITROBOC-Startup-Confirmation").apply { isDaemon = true }
          }
      }
      val currentOnAnalysisFrame by rememberUpdatedState(onAnalysisFrame)
      val currentOnUnavailable by rememberUpdatedState(onUnavailable)
  
      DisposableEffect(attemptId, lifecycleOwner, cameraProviderFuture, analysisExecutor) {
          val settled = AtomicBoolean(false)
          var boundProvider: ProcessCameraProvider? = null
          var boundPreview: Preview? = null
          var boundAnalysis: ImageAnalysis? = null
  
          fun unavailableOnce() {
              if (settled.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                  currentOnUnavailable(attemptId)
              }
          }
  
          cameraProviderFuture.addListener({
              if (settled.get()) return@addListener
              val cameraProvider = try {
                  cameraProviderFuture.get()
              } catch (_: Exception) {
                  unavailableOnce()
                  return@addListener
              }
              val preview = createTdCameraPreview().also {
                  it.setSurfaceProvider(previewView.surfaceProvider)
              }
              val imageAnalysis = createTdImageAnalysis()
              imageAnalysis.setAnalyzer(analysisExecutor) { imageProxy ->
                  if (settled.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                      val size = SnapFrameSize(imageProxy.width, imageProxy.height)
                      imageProxy.close()
                      mainExecutor.execute {
                          imageAnalysis.clearAnalyzer()
                          currentOnAnalysisFrame(attemptId, size)
                      }
                  } else {
                      imageProxy.close()
                  }
              }
  
              try {
                  cameraProvider.bindToLifecycle(
                      lifecycleOwner,
                      tdCameraSelector(),
                      preview,
                      imageAnalysis,
                  )
                  boundProvider = cameraProvider
                  boundPreview = preview
                  boundAnalysis = imageAnalysis
              } catch (_: Exception) {
                  imageAnalysis.clearAnalyzer()
                  unavailableOnce()
              }
          }, mainExecutor)
  
          onDispose {
              boundAnalysis?.clearAnalyzer()
              val useCases = listOfNotNull(boundPreview, boundAnalysis).toTypedArray()
              if (useCases.isNotEmpty()) {
                  runCatching { boundProvider?.unbind(*useCases) }
              }
              analysisExecutor.shutdown()
              unavailableOnce()
          }
      }
  
      AndroidView(
          factory = { previewView },
          modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize(),
      )
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal data class StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      val leftFraction: Float,
      val topFraction: Float,
      val widthFraction: Float,
      val heightFraction: Float,
  ) {
      init {
          require(leftFraction >= 0f && topFraction >= 0f)
          require(widthFraction > 0f && heightFraction > 0f)
          require(leftFraction + widthFraction <= 1f)
          require(topFraction + heightFraction <= 1f)
      }
  }
  
  /** Archy will experiment where to place the camera patch over the square logo_small.png asset. */
  internal val startupLogoCameraPatch = StartupLogoCameraPatch(
      leftFraction = 0.431f,
      topFraction = 0.588f,
      widthFraction = 0.262f,
      heightFraction = 0.196f,
  )
  
  internal fun GroundedResourceReadiness.startupConfirmationOrNull():
      GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming? = this as? GroundedResourceReadiness.Confirming

  # ITROBOC Roadmap
  
  A working roadmap for **ITROBOC** — **Independent Tool for Reading Observed Barcodes On Cards**.
  
  Last aligned with branch state: `dev/impression` docs/code surface reviewed 2026-08-19.
  
  This document is a product-shape map, not a flat feature pile. New features and small UI changes should come from focus testing, TD workflow pressure, and Admin/Profile realities.
  
  ## Current principle
  
  ```text
  Do not freeze UI architecture before the product body finishes growing.
  ```
  
  The tablet cockpit is a useful working surface, but not the final architecture. The phone UI cannot be designed honestly until the feature-complete shape is known. Once phone and tablet UI designs are both known, the composable architecture can be reviewed with real device-family requirements instead of guesses.
  
  ## Current branch — `dev/impression`
  
  `dev/impression` is the active Impression/P2 branch. It sits between frozen Snap evidence and feature-complete work.
  
  The current development question is:
  
  ```text
  Can ordinary Stream remain the TD field path
  while BeetleMind safely retains a recent scene
  and later chews it without disturbing the operator?
  ```
  
  Open Mind and P2 are development surfaces for this question. They are not final UI architecture.
  
  ## Phase A — Focus-tested baseline, still iterating
  
  Status: active / not complete.
  
  Current tablet-first cockpit and Admin/Profile surfaces are being shaped through real use and focus testing. Recent changes such as Double Dummy display, TNT/LoTT status, PREV/NEXT completed-board navigation, completed-cockpit cleanup, richer board overview states, Open Mind diagnostics, and physical SM-T350 camera-viewport tuning are part of this ongoing iteration.
  
  This phase should continue until the current stream-scanning workflow, repair flow, board overview, import/export/save, Admin/Profile calibration, and Impression decision all feel coherent enough to support the next major product milestone.
  
  Important: this phase is not merely TD-side. Admin/Profile is part of the product body because ITROBOC is independent: real calibrated deck profiles are expected to come from observation and Admin-side calibration, not from being stuck with a single built-in profile.
  
  ## Phase B — Snap scanning path
  
  Status: frozen as a partly failed experiment and retained as a source/evidence archive for later work.
  
  The current TD path is stream/convergence-oriented: the camera watches, stabilizes, and accumulates cards into selected hands. The old Snap path was a different scanning mode.
  
  Original Snap interaction contract:
  
  ```text
  accepted stream card in explicit snap mode
  -> capture the next frame
  -> read many visible barcode candidates
  -> apply safe recognized cards to the original selected hand
  -> show a brief frozen-frame green/yellow verdict
  -> continue stream scanning
  ```
  
  Snap was expected to read many cards, not just one. Its evidence does not justify continuing automatic Snap work on the main road. Preserve the implementation and evidence; do not treat completion speed as scan trustworthiness.
  
  Retained value from Snap:
  
  - exact-luma capture/export beams;
  - typed geometry/provenance ideas;
  - wrong-known evidence and timing lessons;
  - safe lifecycle/cancellation instincts;
  - BEELAB-readable evidence direction.
  
  Do not re-enable old Snap frozen-frame presentation by accident. Safe capture/luma/lifecycle machinery may be reused by Impression only with current provenance and generation rules.
  
  ## Phase I — Impression
  
  Status: active branch / approved design, being executed in small reviewed slices.
  
  Impression keeps ordinary Stream alive while Beetle retains part of a recently accepted live scene for slower cognition.
  
  ```text
  LIVE foreground recognition
  -> reducer ADDED
  -> next-frame SAA/SAB capture
  -> retained Food
  -> BSR attention router
  -> BCP chewing through FOF attempts
  -> generation-sealed proposals back through Main/reducer
  ```
  
  Impression is **not** a feed mode and does not use the Snap candidate finder/decoder. It is a retained-scene cognition path inside ordinary Stream.
  
  Open Mind is the development visibility posture for this road. It can expose:
  
  - live ROI preview;
  - retained SAA/SAB scene maps;
  - selected-source outline;
  - retained Food map;
  - later bite/Snippet introspection layers.
  
  A closed posture retains cognition without exposing introspection layers. A retail presentation may keep those layers closed and show only the `🐞` marker in Beetle's thought display.
  
  Design and tickets: [`I-impression.md`](phases/I-impression.md).
  
  ## Phase P2 — Impression pulse profiling and resource preparation
  
  Status: software gait passed Vel VFR; final SM-T350 comparison remains before
  deeper BSR/BCP work resumes.
  
  P2 exists because physical SM-T350 evidence showed an Impression-correlated pulse:
  
  ```text
  qualifying live ADDED
  -> next-frame Impression capture
  -> SPS drops / preview appears disturbed
  -> recovery over roughly two seconds
  ```
  
  The evidence does not prove that app work changes camera focus. It proves an Impression-correlated processing shock that needs measurement.
  
  P2 gait:
  
  ```text
  pulse recorder
  -> compact cockpit IMP line
  -> shareable JSONL pulse log
  -> SM-T350 open/closed/reimpression baseline
  -> owned luma / single-copy capture work
  -> grounded calibration and two-slot production capture
  -> one-second Love Blonds live quiet
  -> Beetle-owned live/Food-ready FOF telemetry
  -> final tablet comparison
  -> resume Phase I
  ```
  
  Resource principle:
  
  ```text
  Prepare, size, and stabilize large resources while grounded;
  do not ask for another wing during a difficult frame.
  ```
  
  Admin resource calibration and grounded scene slots are part of this road. Temporary P2 UI and logs should remain removable when the profiling phase ends.
  
  Design and tickets: [`P2-impression-pulse.md`](phases/P2-impression-pulse.md).
  
  ## Phase S — Explicit Streak feed mode
  
  Status: frozen / indefinitely parked; retained as design provenance.
  
  Streak is a separate explicit TD feed mode derived from a natural card-handling gesture: a small fan is edge-aligned so visible barcodes form a narrow vertical streak.
  
  Phase S keeps the one-shot many-card interaction shape of Snap but narrows the orientation-selected search region to approximately the centered stream-ROI width instead of the full frame width.
  
  ```text
  stream seed accepted in explicit streak mode
  -> capture next frame
  -> search ROI-width corridor above/below the ROI
  -> reuse safe many-card processing where current source supports it
  -> visible result
  -> resume stream
  ```
  
  The current stream ROI is about 20% of frame width, so this is roughly a 5× candidate-area reduction for comparable vertical reach. That is an area hypothesis, **not** a 5× processing-speed claim.
  
  A separate newer exploration keeps the operator in ordinary Stream mode while Beetle uses retained evidence and self-reflective/background cognition. That road is Impression, not Phase S.
  
  ## Phase C — Feature-complete milestone
  
  Status: future milestone.
  
  Feature-complete means:
  
  ```text
  All major TD and Admin/Profile workflows exist in working form.
  Not final-polished.
  Not final-responsive.
  But behaviorally complete enough that device-specific UI design can begin.
  ```
  
  Feature-complete includes both TD-side tournament operation and Admin/Profile calibration/profile management.
  
  Likely feature-complete checklist:
  
  - Stream scanning path works for TD board entry.
  - Manual recovery tools exist and are usable: Undo, Scissors, Swap, I'm sure, Clear, and fourth-hand autofill.
  - Board overview distinguishes Empty, Partial, Scanned, DDAnalyzed, and Complete states.
  - PBN import/export/share/save works for complete boards.
  - DDS metadata import/display/export preservation works when present.
  - TNT/LoTT panel works when DD table and TNT model are available.
  - Admin/Profile can create, calibrate, import/export, inspect, and use real observed deck profiles.
  - Built-in profiles remain useful but are not the only practical path.
  - Snap has an explicit frozen/retain/revisit/stop judgment and is not silently presented as reliable.
  - Impression has a usable retained-scene/background-cognition path, or an explicit bounded stop judgment after P2/Phase I evidence.
  - Streak remains parked or reaches an explicit keep/revise/stop judgment; promotion is not assumed merely because Phase S exists.
  - Autosave/local continuity behavior is explicit enough for real TD use and not hidden in incidental state retention.
  
  ## Phase D — Phone UI design
  
  Status: blocked until feature-complete.
  
  Phone UI design should wait until feature-complete because phone UI is constraint-driven. It must know the full set of product functions before deciding which surfaces are stacked, hidden, modal, swipe-driven, or split into separate modes.
  
  The phone design should not be a simple shrink of the tablet cockpit.
  
  ## Phase E — Tablet UI reconciliation
  
  Status: after phone UI design.
  
  After the phone UI is known, revisit tablet UI. Preserve tablet simultaneity where it helps the TD and borrow phone clarity where it sharpens product grammar.
  
  SM-T350 field tuning is valuable evidence, not a universal tablet law.
  
  ## Phase F — Composable architecture review
  
  Status: after phone and tablet UI designs are known.
  
  Only after both UI designs are understood should the composable architecture be reviewed and refactored deeply.
  
  ```text
  Composable architecture should reflect stable product modes and device families.
  Refactoring before knowing phone and tablet shapes risks building the wrong abstraction.
  ```
  
  ## Working dependency ladder
  
  ```text
  Focus-tested baseline, ever iterating
  -> frozen Snap evidence and capture source
  -> Impression + P2 pulse/resource grounding
  -> explicit keep/revise/stop judgment for retained-scene cognition
  -> feature-complete TD + Admin/Profile tool
  -> phone UI design
  -> tablet UI reconciliation
  -> composable architecture review
  ```
  
  ## Roadmap guardrails
  
  ```text
  Do not pile features blindly.
  Do not finalize responsive UI before feature-complete.
  Do not refactor composable architecture around incomplete product modes.
  Do not treat Admin/Profile as secondary; independence depends on observed profiles.
  Do not let built-in profiles become a hidden product cage.
  Do not let vivid diagnostic UI pretend to be final product grammar.
  Do not let temporary P2 profiling equipment become permanent by neglect.
  ```
  
  ```text
  Focus testing shapes product behavior.
  Feature-complete stabilizes the product body.
  Phone design reveals constraint grammar.
  Tablet review reconciles the cockpit.
  Architecture follows known device truth.
  ```
