  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
  import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableIntStateOf
  import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
  import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
  import org.itroboc.core.*
  import org.itroboc.vision.*
  import java.util.concurrent.Executor
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
  
  internal class EditBoardController(
      private var onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit,
      private var onGroundedResourceFailure: (String) -> Unit = {},
      private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis,
      snapCoordinatorFactory: EditBoardSnapCoordinatorFactory = editBoardSnapCoordinatorFactory(),
      private val mainExecutor: Executor = Executor(Runnable::run),
      internal val impressionPulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder = ImpressionPulseRecorder(),
      private val impressionPulseLogLedger: ImpressionPulseLogLedger =
          ImpressionPulseLogProcessSession.ledger,
      private val impressionPulseVisitId: Long = ImpressionPulseLogProcessSession.newVisitId(),
      loveBlondsGate: LoveBlondsGate = LoveBlondsGate(),
      telemetryLaneFactory: StreamTelemetryLaneFactory = InlineStreamTelemetryLane.FACTORY,
      beetleLaneFactory: StreamBeetleLaneFactory = InlineStreamBeetleLane.FACTORY,
  ) {
      val diagnostics = EditBoardDiagnosticState()
  
      private val nextImpressionGeneration = AtomicLong(1L)
      private val nextImpressionCorrelationId = AtomicLong(1L)
  
      private val snapCoordinator = snapCoordinatorFactory.create(
          nowMillis = nowMillis,
          boardCorrelationMatches = ::boardCorrelationMatches,
          applyKnownCandidates = ::applySnapCandidates,
          recordProcessedSnap = diagnostics::recordProcessedSnap,
          armDiagnosticExport = diagnostics::armSnapFixtureExport,
          cancelDiagnosticExport = diagnostics::cancelSnapFixtureExport,
          acceptDiagnosticCapture = diagnostics::acceptSnapCapture,
          publishStatusMessage = { lastResultMessage = it },
      )
  
      val snapCaptureGate: SnapCaptureGate
          get() = snapCoordinator.captureGate
  
      var streamTelemetrySnapshot by mutableStateOf(
          StreamTelemetrySnapshot(scansPerSecond = 0.0, outstandingMainCallbacks = 0),
      )
          private set
  
      private val publicationPresenter = EditBoardPublicationPresenter(
          pulseRecorder = impressionPulseRecorder,
          pulseLogLedger = impressionPulseLogLedger,
          pulseVisitId = impressionPulseVisitId,
      )
  
      private val streamSession = EditBoardStreamSession(
          nowMillis = nowMillis,
          mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
          pulseRecorder = impressionPulseRecorder,
          loveBlondsGate = loveBlondsGate,
          telemetryLaneFactory = telemetryLaneFactory,
          beetleLaneFactory = beetleLaneFactory,
          isFrameCurrent = snapCoordinator::accepts,
          onTelemetrySnapshot = {
              streamTelemetrySnapshot = it
              publicationPresenter.publishCompletedPulse()
          },
          onPublication = ::publishBeetlePublication,
      )
  
      val streamMainHandoffGate: StreamMainHandoffGate
          get() = streamSession.mainHandoffGate
      val impressionRetinalBridge: ImpressionRetinalBridge
          get() = streamSession.retinalBridge
      val impressionPulseLine: String?
          get() = publicationPresenter.impressionPulseLine
      val impressionPulseLogAvailable: Boolean
          get() = publicationPresenter.impressionPulseLogAvailable
  
      // --- Inputs updated every recomposition ---
      var boardEditState by mutableStateOf(BoardEditState(0))
      var deckProfile by mutableStateOf(BuiltInDeckProfiles.defaultProfile())
      var orientationMode by mutableStateOf(BarcodeOrientationMode.BRM)
      var requiredConsensusFrames by mutableIntStateOf(TdSessionState.DEFAULT_CONSENSUS_FRAMES)
      val feedMode: TdFeedMode
          get() = snapCoordinator.feedMode
      val snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings
          get() = snapCoordinator.finderSettings
      val snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long
          get() = snapCoordinator.processingDeadlineMillis
      val snapScanState: SnapScanState
          get() = snapCoordinator.scanState
  
      // --- UI Visibility / Operational Status ---
      var hasCameraPermission by mutableStateOf(true)
          private set
      var showScissorsScreen by mutableStateOf(false)
          private set
      var showSwapScreen by mutableStateOf(false)
          private set
      private var liveCentralAreaVisible = true
  
      fun updateScissorsVisible(show: Boolean) {
          showScissorsScreen = show
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      fun updateSwapVisible(show: Boolean) {
          showSwapScreen = show
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      /** A hidden live CentralArea cannot retain cognition from its former scene. */
      fun updateLiveCentralAreaVisibility(visible: Boolean) {
          if (liveCentralAreaVisible && !visible) unimpress()
          liveCentralAreaVisible = visible
      }
  
      // --- Performance State ---
  
      // --- Scan State ---
      var lastResultMessage by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
      var lastScannedCard by mutableStateOf<CardId?>(null)
      var thoughts by mutableStateOf(BeetleThought.Blank.presentation)
      val impressionPresentation: ImpressionDisplaySnapshot?
          get() = publicationPresenter.impressionPresentation
      val foodPresentation: FoodDisplaySnapshot?
          get() = publicationPresenter.foodPresentation
  
      fun update(
          state: BoardEditState,
          profile: DeckProfile,
          mode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
          snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings = this.snapFinderSettings,
          snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long = this.snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
          onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit,
          onGroundedResourceFailure: (String) -> Unit = this.onGroundedResourceFailure,
      ) {
          snapCoordinator.cancelIfBoardChanged(state.boardNumber)
          if (
              state.boardNumber != boardEditState.boardNumber ||
              state.boardState != boardEditState.boardState ||
              state.selectedSeat != boardEditState.selectedSeat ||
              profile != deckProfile
          ) {
              unimpress()
          }
          boardEditState = state
          deckProfile = profile
          orientationMode = mode
          this.requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames
          streamSession.updateConfiguration(
              deckProfile = profile,
              orientationMode = mode,
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          )
          snapCoordinator.updateSettings(
              finderSettings = snapFinderSettings,
              processingDeadlineMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          )
          this.hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission
          this.onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange
          this.onGroundedResourceFailure = onGroundedResourceFailure
          streamSession.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      private fun updateMindStatus() {
          val status = BeetleOperationalStatus(
              hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission,
              isScissorsOpen = showScissorsScreen,
              isSwapOpen = showSwapScreen,
              isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          )
          streamSession.updateStatus(status)
      }
  
      fun dream(topic: BeetleDream) {
          streamSession.dream(topic)
      }
  
      fun canAcceptStreamFrame(): Boolean = streamSession.canAcceptFrame()
  
      fun handleCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          if (!snapCoordinator.accepts(streamOutcome.epoch)) return
          handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome)
      }
  
      internal fun handleCameraScan(scanOutcome: CameraScanOutcome) {
          handleCameraScan(
              StreamCameraScanOutcome(
                  epoch = snapCaptureGate.currentEpoch(),
                  outcome = scanOutcome,
              ),
          )
      }
  
      private fun handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          streamSession.submitFrame(streamOutcome, observedAtMillis = nowMillis())
      }
  
      private fun publishBeetlePublication(publication: StreamBeetlePublication) {
          val effects = publicationPresenter.effectsOf(publication)
          diagnostics.observeRoiPreview(effects.roiPreview)
          effects.thoughtPresentation?.let { thoughts = it }
          effects.acceptedCardScan?.let(::applyAcceptedCardScan)
          publicationPresenter.applyPresentation(publication)
          effects.groundedResourceFailure?.let { failure ->
              onGroundedResourceFailure(failure.reason)
          }
      }
  
      internal fun impressionPulseLogRecords(): List<ImpressionPulseLogRecord> =
          publicationPresenter.pulseLogRecords()
  
      internal fun removeSharedImpressionPulseLogRecords(
          shared: List<ImpressionPulseLogRecord>,
      ) {
          publicationPresenter.removeSharedPulseLogRecords(shared)
      }
  
      private fun applyAcceptedCardScan(scan: AcceptedCardScan) {
          val isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          if (isBoardScanned) return
  
          val targetSeat = boardEditState.selectedSeat
  
          val update = EditBoardReducer.applyScannedCard(
              editState = boardEditState,
              card = scan.cardId,
              signature = scan.rawSignature,
          )
  
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
  
          val targetHandComplete = update.state.boardState.handOf(targetSeat).isComplete()
  
          // A complete target hand makes every retained follow-up inference stale.
          if (targetHandComplete) {
              unimpress()
          } else if (
              qualifiesForImpressionCapture(
                  disposition = update.disposition,
                  provenance = scan.provenance,
                  targetHandComplete = targetHandComplete,
              )
          ) {
              armImpressionCapture(scan, targetSeat)
          }
  
          if (snapCoordinator.shouldArmAfterAcceptedScan(
                  dispositionAdded = update.disposition == ScannedCardDisposition.ADDED,
                  targetHandComplete = targetHandComplete,
              )
          ) {
              snapCoordinator.armCapture(
                  scan = scan,
                  targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  orientationMode = orientationMode,
                  correlation = SnapBoardCorrelation(
                      boardNumber = update.state.boardNumber,
                      boardStateAfterSeed = update.state.boardState,
                      targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  ),
              )
          }
      }
  
      fun selectFeedMode(mode: TdFeedMode) {
          snapCoordinator.selectFeedMode(mode)
      }
  
      internal fun armDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport(): Boolean =
          snapCoordinator.armDiagnosticFixtureExport(
              hasExplicitOrientation = orientationMode != BarcodeOrientationMode.AUTO,
          )
  
      internal fun cancelDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport() {
          snapCoordinator.cancelDiagnosticFixtureExport()
      }
  
      internal fun handleDiagnosticSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome): String? =
          snapCoordinator.handleDiagnosticCapture(outcome)
  
      internal fun handleSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome) {
          snapCoordinator.handleCapture(
              outcome = outcome,
              deckProfile = deckProfile,
              orientationMode = orientationMode,
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          )
      }
  
      private fun armImpressionCapture(
          scan: AcceptedCardScan,
          targetSeat: Seat,
      ) {
          val request = ImpressionCaptureRequest(
              generation = ImpressionGeneration(nextImpressionGeneration.getAndIncrement()),
              correlationId = ImpressionCorrelationId(nextImpressionCorrelationId.getAndIncrement()),
              seedCardId = scan.cardId,
              seedSignature = scan.rawSignature,
              targetSeat = targetSeat,
              boardNumber = boardEditState.boardNumber,
              boardView = ActiveBoardView.from(boardEditState, targetSeat),
              orientationMode = orientationMode,
              configurationGeneration = streamSession.currentConfigurationGeneration(),
              sourceFrameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
              streamRoi = SnapFrameRegion(
                  x = scan.streamRoi.x,
                  y = scan.streamRoi.y,
                  width = scan.streamRoi.width,
                  height = scan.streamRoi.height,
              ),
          )
          streamSession.armImpression(
              request = request,
              openMindAtBegin = diagnostics.isMindOpen,
          )
      }
  
      private fun boardCorrelationMatches(correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation): Boolean =
          boardEditState.boardNumber == correlation.boardNumber &&
              boardEditState.boardState == correlation.boardStateAfterSeed
  
      private fun applySnapCandidates(
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation,
          cards: List<CardId>,
      ): SnapCardBatchUpdate {
          val update = EditBoardReducer.applySnapCardBatch(
              editState = boardEditState,
              targetSeat = correlation.targetSeat,
              cards = cards,
          )
          if (update.state != boardEditState) emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          return update
      }
  
      internal fun cancelSnapLifecycle() = snapCoordinator.cancelLifecycle()
  
      private fun emitBoardEditState(state: BoardEditState) {
          boardEditState = state
          streamSession.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          onBoardEditStateChange(state)
      }
  
      fun onSeatClick(seat: Seat) {
          if (seat != boardEditState.selectedSeat) {
              unimpress()
          }
          val nextBoardEditState = boardEditState.copy(selectedSeat = seat)
          val update = EditBoardReducer.tryAutoFillFourthHand(nextBoardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          if (update.message != null) {
              lastResultMessage = update.message
          }
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      fun onClearHand() {
          val selectedHand = boardEditState.boardState.handOf(boardEditState.selectedSeat)
          if (selectedHand.count() > 0) {
              unimpress()
              val update = EditBoardReducer.clearSelectedHand(boardEditState)
              emitBoardEditState(update.state)
              lastResultMessage = update.message
              lastScannedCard = null
          }
      }
  
      fun onClearBoard() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.clearBoard(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          lastScannedCard = null
      }
  
      fun onUndo() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.undoAddForSelectedHand(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onRemoveCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.removeCardFromSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onManualAddCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.addManualCardToSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
      }
  
      fun onSwapHands(targetSeat: Seat) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.swapSelectedHandWith(boardEditState, targetSeat)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onConfirmDuplicate() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.confirmDuplicateOverride(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun closeStreamLanes() {
          streamSession.close()
      }
  
      private fun unimpress() {
          streamSession.unimpress()
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.core.ActiveBoardView
  import org.itroboc.core.CardId
  import org.itroboc.vision.BarcodeRoi
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapDetectionBounds
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapSeedWidthEvidence
  
  internal data class BeetleMindSettings(
      val requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      val debounceWindowMillis: Long = DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MILLIS,
  ) {
      init {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES) {
              "requiredConsensusFrames must be within $ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES"
          }
          require(debounceWindowMillis >= 0L) {
              "debounceWindowMillis must be non-negative"
          }
      }
  
      companion object {
          val ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES = 2..6
          const val DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MILLIS = 1_000L
      }
  }
  
  internal enum class BeetleDream(
      val presentation: String,
  ) {
      EYES("Eyes"),
      HANDS("Hands"),
      WIND("Wind"),
      JOKER("Joker"),
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleSignatureCandidate(
      val rawSignature: String,
      val confidence: Double,
  )
  
  internal sealed interface BeetleEvidence {
      val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance
  
      data class Known(
          val rawSignature: String,
          val cardId: CardId,
          val confidence: Double,
          val seedWidthEvidence: SnapSeedWidthEvidence,
          val detectionBounds: SnapDetectionBounds?,
          val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
          val streamRoi: BarcodeRoi,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class Unknown(
          val rawSignature: String,
          val confidence: Double,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class Ambiguous(
          val candidates: List<BeetleSignatureCandidate>,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class NotFound(
          val reason: String,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class ConversionFailure(
          val reason: String,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  }
  
  internal sealed interface BeetleThought {
      val presentation: String
  
      data object Blank : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "0"
      }
  
      data class Pondering(
          val subject: String,
          val evidenceCount: Int,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          init {
              require(evidenceCount > 0) { "evidenceCount must be positive" }
          }
  
          override val presentation: String = subject + when (evidenceCount) {
              1 -> "?"
              2 -> "??"
              else -> "???"
          }
      }
  
      data class Certain(
          val subject: String,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "$subject."
      }
  
      data class Uncertain(
          val candidateSignature: String,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "$candidateSignature~"
      }
  
      data class Dreaming(
          val topic: BeetleDream,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = topic.presentation
      }
  
      data class Diagnostic(
          override val presentation: String,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          init {
              require(presentation.isNotBlank()) { "Diagnostic thought must not be blank" }
          }
      }
  }
  
  internal data class AcceptedCardScan(
      val rawSignature: String,
      val cardId: CardId,
      val confidence: Double,
      val seedWidthEvidence: SnapSeedWidthEvidence,
      val detectionBounds: SnapDetectionBounds?,
      val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      val streamRoi: BarcodeRoi,
      val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
  )
  
  internal data class BeetleMindSnapshot(
      val thought: BeetleThought,
      val isImpressed: Boolean,
  ) {
      val presentation: String
          get() = thought.presentation + if (isImpressed) "🐞" else ""
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleMindOutput(
      val snapshot: BeetleMindSnapshot,
      val acceptedCardScan: AcceptedCardScan? = null,
  ) {
      val thought: BeetleThought
          get() = snapshot.thought
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleLiveObservation(
      val output: BeetleMindOutput,
      val isNeglectableView: Boolean,
      val mailbox: LiveEvidenceMailboxView,
      val dreamGrant: BsrDreamGrant?,
  )
  
  internal data class BeetleOperationalStatus(
      val hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
      val isScissorsOpen: Boolean,
      val isSwapOpen: Boolean,
      val isBoardScanned: Boolean,
  )
  
  /** Pure Kotlin evidence-trust state machine. It does not own camera or board behavior. */
  internal class BeetleMind(
      private val nowMillis: () -> Long,
      private val settings: BeetleMindSettings,
      private val selfReflection: BeetleSelfReflection = BeetleSelfReflection {
          BsrDeliberationDecision.Refuse
      },
  ) {
      var thought: BeetleThought = BeetleThought.Blank
          private set
  
      private var currentImpression: ImpressionCaptured? = null
      private var reservedImpressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest? = null
      private var currentCognitiveBoard: ActiveBoardView? = null
      var currentFood: BeetleFood? = null
          private set
      private var lastFoodGeneration: FoodGeneration? = null
      private var foodConfiguration: FoodConfiguration? = null
  
      private var ponderingSignature: String? = null
      private var ponderingCount: Int = 0
      private var lastAcceptedRawSignature: String? = null
      private var lastAcceptedProvenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance? = null
      private var lastAcceptedAtMillis: Long = 0L
      private var ponderingProvenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance? = null
  
      var lastLiveMailboxView: LiveEvidenceMailboxView? = null
          private set
  
      fun observeLive(
          evidence: BeetleEvidence,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int = settings.requiredConsensusFrames,
          liveMailbox: LiveEvidenceMailboxView,
      ): BeetleLiveObservation {
          val isNeglectableView = requireNotNull(isNeglectableView(evidence)) {
              "Live mailbox truth accompanies only live evidence"
          }
          lastLiveMailboxView = liveMailbox
          selfReflection.observeConsensusFrames(requiredConsensusFrames)
          val output = observe(evidence, requiredConsensusFrames)
          val foodIdentity = currentFood?.let {
              BsrFoodIdentity(it.impressionGeneration, it.generation)
          }
          return BeetleLiveObservation(
              output = output,
              isNeglectableView = isNeglectableView,
              mailbox = liveMailbox,
              dreamGrant = foodIdentity?.let { identity ->
                  selfReflection.deliberate(
                      BsrDeliberationOpportunity(
                          foodIdentity = identity,
                          isNeglectableView = isNeglectableView,
                          liveMailbox = liveMailbox,
                          requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
                      ),
                  )
              },
          )
      }
  
      fun isNeglectableView(evidence: BeetleEvidence): Boolean? {
          if (evidence.provenance !is BeetleEvidenceProvenance.Live) return null
          return when (evidence) {
              is BeetleEvidence.NotFound -> true
              is BeetleEvidence.Known ->
                  currentCognitiveBoard?.isInTargetHand(evidence.cardId) == true
              is BeetleEvidence.Unknown,
              is BeetleEvidence.Ambiguous,
              is BeetleEvidence.ConversionFailure,
              -> false
          }
      }
  
      fun observe(
          evidence: BeetleEvidence,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int = settings.requiredConsensusFrames,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES) {
              "requiredConsensusFrames must be within ${BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES}"
          }
  
          return when (evidence) {
              is BeetleEvidence.Known -> observeKnown(
                  evidence = evidence,
                  requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
              )
              is BeetleEvidence.Unknown -> {
                  clearPondering()
                  publish(BeetleThought.Pondering(evidence.rawSignature, evidenceCount = 1))
              }
              is BeetleEvidence.Ambiguous -> {
                  clearPondering()
                  val nextThought = evidence.candidates.firstOrNull()
                      ?.rawSignature
                      ?.let(BeetleThought::Uncertain)
                      ?: BeetleThought.Blank
                  publish(nextThought)
              }
              is BeetleEvidence.NotFound,
              is BeetleEvidence.ConversionFailure,
              -> clearAttention()
          }
      }
  
      fun observeStatus(status: BeetleOperationalStatus): BeetleMindOutput {
          val dreamTopic = when {
              !status.hasCameraPermission -> BeetleDream.EYES
              status.isScissorsOpen -> BeetleDream.HANDS
              status.isSwapOpen -> BeetleDream.WIND
              status.isBoardScanned -> BeetleDream.JOKER
              else -> null
          }
  
          return if (dreamTopic != null) {
              dream(dreamTopic)
          } else if (thought is BeetleThought.Dreaming) {
              clearAttention()
          } else {
              BeetleMindOutput(snapshot())
          }
      }
  
      fun dream(topic: BeetleDream): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          return publish(BeetleThought.Dreaming(topic))
      }
  
      fun unimpress(): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          selfReflection.reset()
          currentImpression?.close()
          currentImpression = null
          reservedImpressionRequest = null
          currentCognitiveBoard = null
          currentFood = null
          lastFoodGeneration = null
          return publish(BeetleThought.Blank)
      }
  
      val isImpressed: Boolean
          get() = currentImpression != null
  
      val currentImpressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration?
          get() = currentImpression?.request?.generation
  
      val cognitiveBoard: ActiveBoardView?
          get() = currentCognitiveBoard
  
      val currentFoodGeneration: FoodGeneration?
          get() = lastFoodGeneration
  
      fun snapshot(): BeetleMindSnapshot = BeetleMindSnapshot(
          thought = thought,
          isImpressed = isImpressed,
      )
  
      /** Applies one ordered cognition configuration; returns whether Food changed. */
      fun observeCognitionConfiguration(
          orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int = settings.requiredConsensusFrames,
      ): Boolean {
          val previous = foodConfiguration
          if (previous != null && generation.value <= previous.generation.value) return false
  
          selfReflection.observeConsensusFrames(requiredConsensusFrames)
          foodConfiguration = FoodConfiguration(orientationMode, generation)
          if (currentImpression == null || previous?.orientationMode == orientationMode) return false
          replaceFood(orientationMode)
          return true
      }
  
      /** Same-scene replacement seam for later exhaustion handling; never requests CameraX. */
      fun reselectFood(): BeetleFood? {
          val impression = currentImpression ?: return null
          val orientationMode = foodConfiguration
              ?.orientationMode
              ?: impression.request.orientationMode
          replaceFood(orientationMode)
          return currentFood
      }
  
      fun reserveImpression(request: ImpressionCaptureRequest): Boolean {
          val latestGeneration = reservedImpressionRequest?.generation
              ?: currentImpression?.request?.generation
          if (latestGeneration != null && request.generation.value <= latestGeneration.value) {
              return false
          }
          reservedImpressionRequest = request
          selfReflection.reserveReplacement(request.generation)
          // A newer live ADDED changed reality. Old pixels may remain visible until the
          // replacement installs, but I-04f forbids cognition from using their stale view.
          currentCognitiveBoard = null
          return true
      }
  
      fun installImpression(outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome): ImpressionPresentationUpdate? {
          val reserved = reservedImpressionRequest ?: return rejectImpressionOutcome(outcome)
          if (outcome.request != reserved) return rejectImpressionOutcome(outcome)
          reservedImpressionRequest = null
  
          return when (outcome) {
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured -> {
                  val previousImpression = currentImpression
                  currentImpression = outcome.impression
                  currentCognitiveBoard = outcome.request.boardView
                  selfReflection.installImpression(outcome.request.generation)
                  lastFoodGeneration = null
                  val requestConfiguration = FoodConfiguration(
                      orientationMode = outcome.request.orientationMode,
                      generation = outcome.request.configurationGeneration,
                  )
                  val activeConfiguration = foodConfiguration
                      ?.takeIf { it.generation.value > requestConfiguration.generation.value }
                      ?: requestConfiguration
                  foodConfiguration = activeConfiguration
                  replaceFood(activeConfiguration.orientationMode)
                  val presentation = outcome.impression.toPresentation()
                  previousImpression?.close()
                  ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Present(presentation)
              }
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed,
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.CutOff,
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.GroundingInvalid,
              -> null
          }
      }
  
      fun isReservedImpression(request: ImpressionCaptureRequest): Boolean =
          reservedImpressionRequest == request
  
      fun reportImpressionCutOff(): BeetleMindOutput =
          publish(BeetleThought.Diagnostic("Impression skipped: scene slots busy"))
  
      fun close() {
          unimpress()
          selfReflection.dispose()
      }
  
      val bsrState: BsrAttentionState
          get() = selfReflection.state
  
      fun runGrantedDreamStep(
          grant: BsrDreamGrant,
          step: (BsrDreamGrant) -> BsrDreamResult,
      ): Boolean {
          if (!selfReflection.beginChoosingMovieGenre(grant)) return false
          return selfReflection.completeDream(step(grant))
      }
  
      private fun rejectImpressionOutcome(
          outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome,
      ): ImpressionPresentationUpdate? {
          val rejected = (outcome as? ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured)?.impression
          if (rejected !== currentImpression) rejected?.close()
          return null
      }
  
      private fun observeKnown(
          evidence: BeetleEvidence.Known,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          if (
              evidence.rawSignature == ponderingSignature &&
              evidence.provenance == ponderingProvenance
          ) {
              ponderingCount++
          } else {
              ponderingSignature = evidence.rawSignature
              ponderingCount = 1
              ponderingProvenance = evidence.provenance
          }
  
          val cardName = "${evidence.cardId.suit.prettySymbol}${evidence.cardId.rank.symbol}"
          if (ponderingCount < requiredConsensusFrames) {
              return publish(BeetleThought.Pondering(cardName, ponderingCount))
          }
  
          val currentTimeMillis = nowMillis()
          val acceptedCardScan = if (
              evidence.rawSignature == lastAcceptedRawSignature &&
              evidence.provenance == lastAcceptedProvenance &&
              currentTimeMillis - lastAcceptedAtMillis < settings.debounceWindowMillis
          ) {
              null
          } else {
              lastAcceptedRawSignature = evidence.rawSignature
              lastAcceptedProvenance = evidence.provenance
              lastAcceptedAtMillis = currentTimeMillis
              AcceptedCardScan(
                  rawSignature = evidence.rawSignature,
                  cardId = evidence.cardId,
                  confidence = evidence.confidence,
                  seedWidthEvidence = evidence.seedWidthEvidence,
                  detectionBounds = evidence.detectionBounds,
                  sourceFrameSize = evidence.sourceFrameSize,
                  streamRoi = evidence.streamRoi,
                  provenance = evidence.provenance,
              )
          }
          return publish(
              nextThought = BeetleThought.Certain(cardName),
              acceptedCardScan = acceptedCardScan,
          )
      }
  
      private fun clearPondering() {
          ponderingSignature = null
          ponderingCount = 0
          ponderingProvenance = null
      }
  
      private fun replaceFood(orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode) {
          val impression = currentImpression ?: return
          val generation = lastFoodGeneration?.next() ?: FoodGeneration(1L)
          lastFoodGeneration = generation
          currentFood = when (
              val selection = selectFoodFromImpression(impression, orientationMode)
          ) {
              is FoodSelectionResult.Selected -> BeetleFood(
                  impressionGeneration = impression.request.generation,
                  generation = generation,
                  retained = selection.food,
              )
              FoodSelectionResult.ExplicitOrientationRequired -> null
          }
          currentFood?.let { food ->
              selfReflection.installFood(
                  BsrFoodIdentity(food.impressionGeneration, food.generation),
              )
          } ?: selfReflection.clearFood(impression.request.generation)
      }
  
      private fun clearAttention(): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          return publish(BeetleThought.Blank)
      }
  
      private fun publish(
          nextThought: BeetleThought,
          acceptedCardScan: AcceptedCardScan? = null,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          thought = nextThought
          return BeetleMindOutput(
              snapshot = snapshot(),
              acceptedCardScan = acceptedCardScan,
          )
      }
  
      private data class FoodConfiguration(
          val orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          val generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      )
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal data class BsrFoodIdentity(
      val impressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration,
      val foodGeneration: FoodGeneration,
  )
  
  internal data class BsrDeliberationOpportunity(
      val foodIdentity: BsrFoodIdentity,
      val isNeglectableView: Boolean,
      val liveMailbox: LiveEvidenceMailboxView,
      val requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
  ) {
      init {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES)
      }
  
      val isEligible: Boolean
          get() = isNeglectableView && liveMailbox.unfinishedAfterCurrent == 0
  }
  
  internal data class BsrDeliberationContext(
      val opportunity: BsrDeliberationOpportunity,
      val priorDreamResult: BsrDreamResult?,
  )
  
  internal sealed interface BsrDeliberationDecision {
      data object Refuse : BsrDeliberationDecision
      data object ChooseDream : BsrDeliberationDecision
  }
  
  internal fun interface BsrDeliberator {
      fun decide(context: BsrDeliberationContext): BsrDeliberationDecision
  }
  
  internal data class BsrDreamGrant(
      val dreamId: Long,
      val foodIdentity: BsrFoodIdentity,
      val maxFofOpportunities: Int,
  ) {
      init {
          require(dreamId > 0L)
          require(maxFofOpportunities in BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES)
      }
  }
  
  internal data class BsrDreamResult(
      val grant: BsrDreamGrant,
      val opportunitiesUsed: Int,
  ) {
      init {
          require(opportunitiesUsed in 0..grant.maxFofOpportunities)
      }
  }
  
  internal sealed interface BsrAttentionState {
      data object Unimpressed : BsrAttentionState
      data class ReimpressionPending(
          val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
      ) : BsrAttentionState
      data class Impressed(
          val impressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration,
          val foodIdentity: BsrFoodIdentity?,
      ) : BsrAttentionState
      data class ReadyToDream(
          val grant: BsrDreamGrant,
      ) : BsrAttentionState
      data class ChoosingMovieGenre(
          val grant: BsrDreamGrant,
      ) : BsrAttentionState
  }
  
  /** Pure BSR policy state. I-05d supplies serial scheduling; I-06 supplies real genres. */
  internal class BeetleSelfReflection(
      private val deliberator: BsrDeliberator,
  ) {
      var state: BsrAttentionState = BsrAttentionState.Unimpressed
          private set
      var priorDreamResult: BsrDreamResult? = null
          private set
  
      private var currentFoodIdentity: BsrFoodIdentity? = null
      private var currentImpressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration? = null
      private var currentConsensusFrames: Int? = null
      private var nextDreamId = 1L
      private var disposed = false
  
      fun installImpression(generation: ImpressionGeneration): Boolean {
          if (disposed) return false
          val pending = state as? BsrAttentionState.ReimpressionPending
          if (pending != null && generation != pending.generation) return false
          val current = currentImpressionGeneration
          if (current != null && generation.value < current.value) return false
          currentImpressionGeneration = generation
          currentFoodIdentity = null
          priorDreamResult = null
          state = BsrAttentionState.Impressed(generation, foodIdentity = null)
          return true
      }
  
      fun installFood(identity: BsrFoodIdentity): Boolean {
          if (disposed) return false
          val current = currentFoodIdentity
          val pending = state as? BsrAttentionState.ReimpressionPending
          if (pending != null && identity.impressionGeneration != pending.generation) return false
          val currentImpression = currentImpressionGeneration
          if (
              currentImpression != null &&
              identity.impressionGeneration.value < currentImpression.value
          ) return false
          if (
              current != null &&
              identity.impressionGeneration.value < current.impressionGeneration.value
          ) return false
          if (
              current != null &&
              identity.impressionGeneration == current.impressionGeneration &&
              identity.foodGeneration.value <= current.foodGeneration.value
          ) return false
  
          currentImpressionGeneration = identity.impressionGeneration
          currentFoodIdentity = identity
          priorDreamResult = null
          state = BsrAttentionState.Impressed(identity.impressionGeneration, identity)
          return true
      }
  
      fun clearFood(impressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration) {
          if (disposed || currentImpressionGeneration != impressionGeneration) return
          currentFoodIdentity = null
          priorDreamResult = null
          state = BsrAttentionState.Impressed(impressionGeneration, foodIdentity = null)
      }
  
      fun reserveReplacement(generation: ImpressionGeneration): Boolean {
          if (disposed) return false
          val currentGeneration = currentImpressionGeneration
          val pendingGeneration = (state as? BsrAttentionState.ReimpressionPending)?.generation
          val latest = listOfNotNull(currentGeneration, pendingGeneration).maxByOrNull { it.value }
          if (latest != null && generation.value <= latest.value) return false
  
          currentFoodIdentity = null
          currentImpressionGeneration = null
          priorDreamResult = null
          state = BsrAttentionState.ReimpressionPending(generation)
          return true
      }
  
      fun deliberate(opportunity: BsrDeliberationOpportunity): BsrDreamGrant? {
          if (disposed || !opportunity.isEligible) return null
          val impressed = state as? BsrAttentionState.Impressed ?: return null
          if (impressed.foodIdentity != opportunity.foodIdentity) return null
          currentConsensusFrames = opportunity.requiredConsensusFrames
          return when (
              deliberator.decide(BsrDeliberationContext(opportunity, priorDreamResult))
          ) {
              BsrDeliberationDecision.Refuse -> null
              BsrDeliberationDecision.ChooseDream -> BsrDreamGrant(
                  dreamId = nextDreamId++,
                  foodIdentity = opportunity.foodIdentity,
                  maxFofOpportunities = opportunity.requiredConsensusFrames,
              ).also { state = BsrAttentionState.ReadyToDream(it) }
          }
      }
  
      fun beginChoosingMovieGenre(grant: BsrDreamGrant): Boolean {
          val ready = state as? BsrAttentionState.ReadyToDream ?: return false
          if (ready.grant != grant) return false
          state = BsrAttentionState.ChoosingMovieGenre(grant)
          return true
      }
  
      fun completeDream(result: BsrDreamResult): Boolean {
          val choosing = state as? BsrAttentionState.ChoosingMovieGenre ?: return false
          if (choosing.grant != result.grant) return false
          priorDreamResult = result
          state = BsrAttentionState.Impressed(
              result.grant.foodIdentity.impressionGeneration,
              result.grant.foodIdentity,
          )
          return true
      }
  
      fun observeConsensusFrames(requiredConsensusFrames: Int) {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES)
          val previous = currentConsensusFrames
          currentConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames
          if (previous == null || previous == requiredConsensusFrames) return
          val identity = currentFoodIdentity ?: return
          if (
              state is BsrAttentionState.ReadyToDream ||
              state is BsrAttentionState.ChoosingMovieGenre
          ) {
              state = BsrAttentionState.Impressed(identity.impressionGeneration, identity)
          }
      }
  
      fun reset() {
          if (disposed) return
          currentFoodIdentity = null
          currentImpressionGeneration = null
          currentConsensusFrames = null
          priorDreamResult = null
          state = BsrAttentionState.Unimpressed
      }
  
      fun dispose() {
          reset()
          disposed = true
      }
  }

  # I-06: BCP dream loop through FOF
  
  Status: software VFR complete; integrated tablet behavior joins I-08
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: I-05 and I-04f
  
  Design source: [`I-impression.md`](I-impression.md), especially **First BSR policy**, **Food lifecycle**, and **Evidence provenance and board consequences**.
  
  ## Goal
  
  Let Beetle Chewing Process feed bounded bites of retained Food through the ordinary FOF cognition path.
  
  ## Execution order
  
  1. [`I-06a`](../dev_history/mind/I-06a-food-fof-dream-results.md) — deterministic Food traversal
     through the ordinary FOF/cognition result seam.
  2. [`I-06b`](../dev_history/mind/I-06b-optimistic-cognitive-board.md) — optimistic cognitive-copy
     updates and generation-sealed Main basket proposals.
  
  Each slice is one reviewed commit. I-06a must not invent an unsealed board
  mutation shortcut; I-06b must not add new vision or traversal behavior.
  
  ## Vel handoff after I-05
  
  Shift has a green light to implement I-06a and I-06b as two commits, in that
  order. Preserve the I-05 distinction between one **dream grant** and one atomic
  **FOF attempt**:
  
  - one grant chooses one deterministic bite location and snapshots the
    consensus-sized attempt budget;
  - repeated opportunities within that grant feed the same bite pixels through
    FOF, so ordinary consensus can actually stabilize;
  - each attempt is one atomic Beetle-lane task; before queuing the next attempt,
    check the protocol-owned live mailbox and let admitted live work run first;
  - completing, exhausting, cancelling, or replacing the grant is explicit. A
    later neglectable live view may deliberate again, but dream completion must
    not manufacture its successor;
  - evolve the I-05 test seam into `DREAMING(MovieGenre)` with only the first real
    deterministic genre. Do not keep a production fake-step branch beside it.
  
  Before wiring the decoder, write the chosen bite rectangle, near-slit-first
  order, stride, and terminal edge clamp into I-06a. Derive the bite dimensions
  from the ordinary FOF input contract and retained Food geometry; do not assume
  that the stretched Food overlay is algorithmic geometry. If the current FOF
  entry point cannot consume an immutable retained-luma view without a large
  copy, stop and report that exact seam rather than creating a Food-only decoder.
  
  I-06b then consumes the typed Food result. Keep prediction, cognitive-copy
  update, and proposal creation in one Beetle transition; keep reducer authority
  and the generation seal on Main. Test the final hand-completing proposal before
  invalidating its seal, plus disagreement, user mutation, and stale queued
  proposal rejection.
  
  ## Required behavior
  
  - Reuse FOF and normal typed cognition semantics; do not use Snap candidate decoding.
  - Every dream result carries Food provenance and therefore cannot trigger Impression recapture.
  - Every completed Food FOF opportunity emits the same P2-05 Beetle-owned
    perception fact as completed live FOF; Telemetry, not Main, accumulates it.
  - Begin with a deterministic cinema traversal. Before coding, the worker records the exact bite size, order, stride, and edge-clamping derived from current FOF input geometry; Shift reviews that small geometry decision.
  - BCP receives each result and retains explicit progress for choosing the next bite. One completed FOF attempt consumes one snapshotted dream opportunity.
  - Show the current bite outline on Food and its supplied pixels in `RoiPreviewStrip()`.
  - Scene/Food generation replacement rejects queued dream results.
  - Food exhaustion is explicit and permits later reselection from the same SAA/SAB scene.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [x] Tests prove live and Food inputs use the intended common recognition seam.
  - [x] Food-origin predicted `ADDED` follows the I-06b cognitive-copy/basket
    protocol and never arms capture.
  - [x] Cancellation/replacement cannot publish stale cognition or UI state.
  - [x] Current-bite geometry and preview pixels correspond to the same retained evidence.
  - [x] Live evidence queued during a dream runs after the current FOF call and before another bite.
  - [x] Orientation/consensus changes and hard-clear events follow the canonical lifecycle matrix.
  - [ ] The consolidated physical behavior remains `Not checked` until the
    [`I-08 SM-T350 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md).
  
  ## Read first
  
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/CameraFrameDecoder.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamBeetleProcessor.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/BeetleMind.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/RoiPreview.kt`
  - [`I-04f`](../dev_history/mind/I-04f-active-board-cognitive-copy.md)
  - the current Stream decoder/evidence translation tests.
  
  ## Handoff
  
  Keep traversal pure and Beetle-owned. Land FOF reuse, Food provenance, cancellation, bite outline, and ROI-preview evidence without adding Snippet colors; I-07 owns reducer-outcome marks. Run full tests and `:app:assembleDebug`; update `docs/features.md` for visible bite/preview behavior.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Start with a deterministic traversal. Suspicion wobble and other adaptive search policy require later evidence and a separate ticket.

  # I-07: Cognitive board-outcome Snippets
  
  Status: software VFR complete; awaiting I-08 field evidence
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: I-06
  
  Design source: [`I-impression.md`](I-impression.md), especially **Evidence provenance and board consequences**, **Visible overlays**, and **Approved clearing policy**.
  
  ## Goal
  
  Mark the retained location of Food barcodes with their board consequence:
  
  ```text
  green  = this occurrence caused ADDED
  yellow = this occurrence caused ALREADY_IN_TARGET
  ```
  
  Recognition alone is insufficient. BeetleMind predicts the board consequence
  from its I-06b cognitive copy; other outcomes create no Phase I Snippet.
  
  ## Execution order
  
  1. [`I-07a`](../dev_history/mind/I-07a-snippet-outcome-protocol.md) — cognitive-copy outcome plus
     Beetle-owned Snippet state.
  2. [`I-07b`](../dev_history/mind/I-07b-snippet-projection-and-rendering.md) — pure projection and green/yellow overlay rendering.
  
  I-07a is a correctness/ownership slice. I-07b is the bounded presentation slice suitable for Shift after I-07a passes review.
  
  ## Vel handoff after I-06
  
  Shift may continue with I-07a and I-07b as two separate commits after I-06b
  passes its automated checks. I-07a must consume the exact predicted consequence
  already produced by I-06b; it must not ask Main for success or independently
  re-run board membership logic.
  
  Normalize Food detection bounds exactly once:
  
  ```text
  bite-local detection bounds
  → Food-local occurrence bounds
  → retained SAA/SAB scene coordinates
  ```
  
  Store the final retained-scene occurrence with Impression/Food/dream/bite
  identity and predicted consequence. Use a deterministic occurrence key based
  on source reservoir plus scene geometry; CardId alone is not a location. Green
  supersedes yellow for the same occurrence, while repeated identical facts are
  idempotent.
  
  I-07b receives only an immutable snapshot. Reuse the existing overlay geometry
  transforms rather than measuring Compose output backward. Project first to the
  source postcard, and project to Food only when its retained source bounds
  contain the occurrence. Keep the live slit last in z-order and keep all marks
  hidden with the other Open Mind evidence layers when Open Mind is closed.
  
  ## Whole-ticket acceptance
  
  - [x] `ADDED` creates one green mark at the originating occurrence.
  - [x] `ALREADY_IN_TARGET` creates one yellow mark.
  - [x] Other current dispositions create no mark.
  - [x] Duplicate recognition is deterministic; green supersedes yellow.
  - [x] Old-generation Food results are rejected; a basket disagreement clears
    their optimistic marks with the Impression.
  - [x] Marks project consistently into SAA/SAB and containing Food.
  - [x] Food replacement preserves scene marks; hard clear removes them.
  - [ ] Physical color, alignment, lifecycle, and ordinary scanning remain
    `Not checked` until the consolidated
    [`I-08 SM-T350 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md).
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Snippets show two board consequences at barcode locations. They do not claim Food exhaustion, invent colors for other outcomes, or create a second mutation path.

  # ITROBOC Feature Ledger
  
  Last aligned with branch state: `dev/impression` docs/code surface reviewed 2026-08-23.
  
  This file tracks user-visible capabilities and major functional milestones. It is not a full changelog. Performance-specific completed work lives in the optimization docs.
  
  ## Current branch headline
  
  `dev/impression` is the Impression/P2 branch. It keeps TD Stream scanning as the field path and adds retained-scene diagnostic/cognition infrastructure:
  
  ```text
  Stream remains foreground
  Open Mind exposes retained scene maps
  P2 measures the Impression capture/presentation pulse
  Snap remains frozen evidence, not active reliability
  ```
  
  ## Recent user-visible and diagnostic changes
  
  - **Open Mind / retained Impression maps**: TD Stream can show BeetleMind-retained SAA and SAB grayscale scene maps at the upper-left/lower-left of the live CentralArea after an Impression is captured. Food fills a narrow map at the right when selected. A subtle outline marks the selected source. The camera and slit continue behind them.
  - **Open Mind posture**: the operator chooses Open Mind from the Beetle before the first accepted card. After scanning begins, the last-card display replaces the control for the rest of the Edit Board visit. Returning to TD ends the visit and permits a new choice.
  - **Closed posture**: closing Open Mind hides retained maps without discarding retained cognition.
  - **Impression marker**: Beetle's thought display carries one `🐞` while a retained Impression exists, whether Open Mind is visibly open or closed.
  - **Scene-map clearing**: retained maps clear when the target hand completes or the operator performs a semantic owner-changing action such as manual seat switch/repair/navigation as defined by the Impression contract.
  - **SM-T350 cockpit tuning**: the TD cockpit gives its live camera scene a near-4:3 viewport on the SM-T350 so CameraX preview edges and Compose-owned Impression/Food overlays remain visually aligned with neighboring hand rows.
  - **Landscape lock**: tablet/phone cockpit stays in landscape when the physical device rotates.
  - **Thin Stream slit**: visible Stream slit and Analyzer ROI remain 20% of their coordinate-space width and at most 8 pixels high, keeping operator steering familiar while rejecting strongly diagonal barcode presentations.
  - **Temporary Impression pulse line**: during P2 field profiling, the scan status area shows one compact completed timing record such as `IMP A42 C18 B1 M27`. It updates once per completed Impression pulse and is explicitly removable after profiling.
  - **Temporary Impression pulse log**: completed P2 pulse records accumulate in a bounded process-session ledger across Edit Board visits. **Share IMP log** exports the current batch as timestamped JSONL and begins a fresh batch, with subjective field-observation fields ready for later annotation.
  - **Admin resource calibration**: Calibrate uses a field-tuned preview bounded to one third of both available screen dimensions, observes real camera analysis geometry, displays compact Frame/ROI/SAA/SAB lines, prepares two bounded SAA/SAB scene slots, and durably saves the versioned contract. On later starts, the **Little Theatre** briefly occupies an Archy-tuned experimental patch over the square logo while one real ImageAnalysis frame confirms the candidate. The theatre uses fade transitions, a scanning beam, and a "lower curtain" lifecycle that keeps the camera bound until the exit animation finishes. Until confirmation succeeds, Main Menu exposes only direct **Calibrate**. TD Impression capture now consumes those grounded slots; a live geometry contradiction revokes readiness and returns to calibration-only Main Menu.
  - **Bounded Impression cutoff**: if both grounded postcard slots are briefly occupied, the accepted card remains accepted, the current Impression/Food remains installed, and Thoughts reports `Impression skipped: scene slots busy` without fallback allocation or delayed retry.
  - **Love Blonds quiet**: after a successful Impression capture submission, ordinary live barcode analysis rests for one monotonic second while camera preview and Beetle cognition remain active. No frame or result is delayed for later delivery; a semantic seat/board owner change clears the remaining quiet.
  - **Inner-cinema SPS**: cockpit SPS counts completed Beetle-owned live and Food FOF perceptions rather than Analyzer deliveries, without adding per-perception Main callbacks.
  - **Food inner cinema**: after a neglectable live view yields attention, BeetleMind repeatedly examines one deterministic near-slit Food bite through ordinary FOF consensus, then advances through the retained corridor. Open Mind shows that bite as a subtle outline and places its exact grayscale pixels in ROI Preview. Food and live completions share the same inner-cinema SPS ingress.
  - **Optimistic Food additions**: BeetleMind can continue recognizing retained Food against its tiny Impression-scoped board copy. Predicted additions cross a generation-sealed proposal to Main and the ordinary reducer; they never arm a fresh capture. Any current-generation disagreement drops the Impression instead of allowing the two board views to diverge.
  - **Recognized Snippets**: Open Mind crosses retained barcode occurrences with a horizontal green mark when Food cognition predicts `ADDED`, or yellow when the card is already familiar in the target hand. Marks stay aligned independently in SAA/SAB and the containing stretched Food, survive Food reselection, and remain hidden with the other evidence when Open Mind is closed.
  
  ## 1. TD operations — the cockpit
  
  - **Stream scanning**: real-time barcode scanning with the Beetle mascot providing visual stabilization and thought-process feedback.
  - **Precision targeting**: uses a thin centered ROI / slit to improve scan accuracy under varied lighting.
  - **Seat management**: independent scanning and management for North, East, South, and West hands.
  - **Dynamic board grid**: supports tournament grids from 15 to 39 boards.
  - **Board navigation**: PREV/NEXT navigation from within the cockpit after board completion.
  - **Status dashboard**: real-time display of hand completion, scan telemetry, outstanding callback load, card-disposition messages, and temporary P2 pulse lines where active.
  - **Fourth-hand autofill**: calculates the last hand when the other three are complete.
  - **Autosave / local continuity**: app/session state has explicit local persistence surfaces where currently implemented; Save remains available for exported PBN files through Android SAF.
  
  ## 2. Recovery and error correction
  
  - **Undo**: LIFO undo for the currently selected hand.
  - **Clear actions**: selective Clear Hand or Clear Board with confirmation safety.
  - **Hand Swap**: swap selected hand contents with another seat.
  - **I'm Sure**: resolve false-positive duplicate rejections by explicitly moving a card from its current seat to the target seat.
  - **Scissors repair screen**:
    - remove specific cards;
    - manually add cards for scratched/unreadable barcodes;
    - move cards between hands with Pull Protection confirmation.
  
  ## 3. Analysis and bridge data
  
  - **PBN export/share/save**: generates professional PBN 2.1 records for complete boards, supports Android share intents, and saves locally through the Android Storage Access Framework.
  - **PBN import**: accepts complete board records numbered `1..39`, ignores unsupported/partial blocks, and expands the local grid to accommodate imported data.
  - **Double Dummy integration**:
    - displays Optimum Result tables for scanned boards when DDS metadata is available;
    - preserves Double Dummy data through import/export until real board mutation invalidates it.
  - **TNT/LoTT panel**: shows Total Number of Tricks and Law of Total Tricks delta, for example `⚖️+1`, when the board is scanned and suitable optimum-table data is available.
  - **Board overview map**:
    - Gray: Empty;
    - Yellow: Partial hand(s);
    - Green: Scanned (52 cards);
    - Cyan: Double Dummy analysis available;
    - Purple: Complete / TNT-ready.
  
  ## 4. Admin and deck management
  
  - **Deck Profiles**: independent mapping of raw barcode signatures to card identities, allowing ITROBOC to support various physical card designs.
  - **Profile Calibration**: Admin interface for creating and editing profiles using live camera evidence.
  - **Profile import/export**: JSON profile exchange for observed deck profiles.
  - **Resource Calibration**: P2/Impression resource grounding observes real camera analysis geometry and prepares bounded SAA/SAB scene slots with explicit discovery/failure/retry states. A compatible saved candidate preallocates the slots on startup but remains unconfirmed until current-session camera evidence arrives.
  - **Resource Calibration follow-up**: non-urgent Phase A tickets separately
    test/polish
    [first-ever granted-permission use](phases/A-admin-calibrate-first-ever-polish.md)
    and
    [missing/denied/revoked camera permission](phases/A-admin-calibrate-missing-camera-permission.md);
    they do not weaken the calibration-only readiness gate.
  - **Read-only Preview**: visual verification of signature-to-card mappings.
  
  ## 5. Diagnostic tools — TD-side
  
  - **Open Mind**: demo/debug posture on the Beetle mascot that jointly exposes live ROI preview, retained SAA/SAB scene maps, selected-source outline, Food map, current bite, and recognized Snippets.
  - **ROI Preview**: grayscale strip of the current ROI/FOF input when Open Mind is open.
  - **Impression pulse line/log/export**: temporary P2 profiling surfaces for measuring Impression-correlated pulses.
  - **Snap Fixture Export**: `Arm SE` captures one-shot exact-luma bundles (`.zip`) for algorithm troubleshooting and lab diagnosis.
  
  ## 6. Scanning and cognition modes
  
  - **Stream scanning**: current field scanning path and TD default.
  - **Snap scanning**: frozen/retained experiment. Its frozen-frame presentation has been removed. Once the Impression scanning path is stable and verified, the remaining Snap feature code is headed for deletion. Safe capture, luma, and evidence machinery will be preserved for reuse or transitioned to the Impression/BeeLab evidence exchange.
  - **Streak**: parked explicit feed-mode idea derived from a narrow card fan / barcode streak gesture. It remains provenance, not current field path.
  - **Impression**: retained-scene cognition road inside ordinary Stream. It captures SAA/SAB after a real live `ADDED`, selects Food, and runs bounded, live-preemptible Food dreams without creating a second recognition seam.
  - **Orientation control**: manual toggle for BFM and BRM. `AUTO` must not silently pick Impression Food side.
  
  ## 7. Current cautions
  
  - Temporary P2 profiling UI must remain removable.
  - Open Mind is a diagnostic/product-discovery posture, not a final phone UI decision.
  - Retained scene maps are presentation of Beetle-owned evidence; board mutation still belongs to Main/reducer.
  - Snap evidence and completion speed do not establish field reliability.
  - Impression background cognition is not complete until BSR/BCP/dream tickets land with generation/provenance safety.

  # P2-04 — Love Blonds one-second Analyzer quiet
  
  Status: software implementation passed Vel VFR; awaiting P2-06 SM-T350 comparison
  
  Depends on: P2-02
  
  Note: Originally named "Love Blinds" as a principle for temporary blindness. Then a simple typo turned out hilarious gold.
  
  ## Goal
  
  After one qualifying live `ADDED` produces and submits a captured Impression,
  let Analyzer rest for at least one second so BeetleMind can retain and use good
  Food instead of accepting densely adjacent physical barcodes immediately.
  
  The field arrangement places several barcodes close enough to enter one natural
  camera motion. Once Love Blonds clears, cognition may already know neighboring
  cards from the retained Food, making their later live recognition unsurprising.
  
  ## Required behavior
  
  - Main's live `ADDED` first reserves the next-frame Impression. That reservation
    does not start Love Blonds and must not suppress its own capture frame.
  - Analyzer starts the monotonic one-second quiet only after it successfully
    fills the retained scene and submits a `Captured` outcome. Start immediately
    after submission; do not wait for BeetleMind installation and do not add a
    BeetleMind -> Analyzer acknowledgement.
  - During the window, Analyzer does not decode or publish ordinary Stream
    evidence; therefore no barcode result reaches BeetleMind and no card lands
    in Main's authoritative reducer. Camera preview remains visually live.
  - Release skipped CameraX frames promptly. Do not retain a frame or queue a
    barcode result for delivery after the window.
  - When the deadline expires, ordinary Analyzer admission resumes without
    waiting for a grounded scene slot. If a later eligible Impression finds both
    slots occupied, P2-03d owns the simple cutoff and **Thoughts** diagnostic;
    Love Blonds does not extend itself into resource backpressure.
  - Keep the installed Impression and Food. Suppression does not unimpress and
    does not queue a delayed replacement capture.
  - Food dreams never arm live Impression capture and never affect the window.
  - BeetleMind may continue BSR/BCP/Food work during the quiet. Love Blonds rests
    live vision; it does not sedate cognition.
  - Conceptually this is one second of micro-devotion. Archy finds the intended
    irony: 🪲 remains devotional to the current `🐞` precisely while the quiet
    lets him fantasize safely about others of her kind in retained Food. Those
    internal encounters still earn their consequences through the authoritative
    basket; they cannot create another Impression.
  - Do not sleep or block Analyzer, BeetleMind, Main, or Telemetry. Frame
    admission checks a monotonic deadline; no worker waits out the second.
  - Controller disposal and hard-clear behavior are explicit: a semantic
    seat/board owner change unimpresses and clears the remaining window;
    disposal closes Analyzer admission. Orientation-only Food reselection does
    neither.
  - Keep the duration injected/testable and default it to `1_000 ms`.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [x] A successful `Captured` submission suppresses later Analyzer Stream work
    for one second.
  - [x] Rejected reservation does not start the window.
  - [x] Reservation leaves its next capture frame admissible; only successful
    `Captured` submission starts the deadline.
  - [x] Failed/cut-off capture does not start the deadline, and no Mind-to-Analyzer
    acknowledgement exists.
  - [x] Frames crossing the slit during the window produce no card addition or
    delayed result, while preview remains live.
  - [x] No delayed capture fires when the window expires.
  - [x] Monotonic-clock boundary and lifecycle tests are deterministic.
  - [ ] SM-T350 repeated-card handling is compared before and after the policy.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Love Blonds is a bounded Analyzer-admission quiet, not camera-preview freezing,
  thread sleeping, consensus reset, autofocus control, or proof that an adjacent
  card was already dreamed.
  
  ## Current-build field observation
  
  On 2026-08-22 Archy manually observed on the post-convoy SM-T350 build that
  Beetle ignores the live slit for the intended approximate second. The broader
  targeted P2-06 inside/outside-window and dense-handling comparison remains
  postponed, so the final tablet-comparison checkbox stays open.
  
  ## Landed shape
  
  The retinal bridge owns one injected monotonic `LoveBlondsGate`. Analyzer asks
  it before consuming ordinary Stream admission. A successful `Captured` command
  submission starts the gate after the current capture/publish operation; the
  next frames are promptly released by CameraX's existing `use` boundary until
  the exact deadline. Expiry merely makes the next normal frame admissible—there
  is no queued frame, retry, callback, or additional worker.

  # I-05: BSR attention router
  
  Status: software VFR complete; integrated tablet behavior joins the I-08 flight
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: I-04f
  
  Design source: [`I-impression.md`](I-impression.md), especially **First BSR policy**, **Food lifecycle**, and **Approved clearing policy**.
  
  ## Goal
  
  Let Beetle Self-Reflection grant bounded background attention to retained Food while live foreground remains primary.
  
  ## Archy's design notes
  
  - Food installation does not automatically grant the first dream.
  - While impressed, a live view is `isNeglectableView` only when it contains no
    found barcode, or resolves to a `CardId` already present in the target hand
    of the cognitive ActiveBoardView. Recognition recency is irrelevant.
  - Unknown, ambiguous, and conversion-failure evidence is potentially
    interesting: unfinished barcode-like bits may be a door into a dream.
  - A neglectable view and an empty live mailbox are eligibility information, not
    an instruction to dream.
  - BSR decides which dream to show.
  - When one dream finishes, BSR analyzes its result and adapts; exhaustion of the
    bounded budget does not automatically grant a successor dream.
  
  After Food exists, completion of a neglectable live view with no later live
  evidence waiting offers BSR a deliberation opportunity. It does not grant a
  dream; BSR may decline or choose which dream to show.
  
  ## Execution order
  
  1. [`I-05a`](../dev_history/mind/I-05a-live-mailbox-signal.md) — expose protocol-owned
     submitted/unfinished live-mailbox truth.
  2. [`I-05b`](../dev_history/mind/I-05b-neglectable-live-view.md) — classify whether the completed
     live view may yield foreground attention.
  3. [`I-05c`](../dev_history/mind/I-05c-bsr-deliberation.md) — pure adaptive deliberation and one
     bounded, generation-correlated grant.
  4. [`I-05d`](../dev_history/mind/I-05d-serial-attention-routing.md) — serial lane integration,
     foreground preemption, and cancellation.
  
  Each implementation slice is one reviewed commit. I-05a knows only scheduling
  truth; I-05b knows only live-view meaning; I-05c does not schedule; I-05d does
  not implement BCP/FOF.
  
  ## Vel VFR note
  
  The first split correctly discovered mailbox truth and neglectable-view meaning
  as separate concepts, but placed both classification and future BSR policy
  interfaces into one unused source file before any slice was assigned. The
  review keeps those semantics and removes that premature scaffolding. Implement
  the four tickets in order, introducing each type only with the focused tests and
  caller that establish its role. This keeps the commit gait reviewable and
  prevents later workers from mistaking a speculative interface for landed
  architecture.
  
  The implementation VFR reviewed `036224c` through `1defdf5`. Shift preserved
  the four intended jurisdictions and the single Beetle lane. One timing seam
  needed repair: a consensus-setting update invalidated queued lane attention
  immediately, but BSR's own `READY_TO_DREAM`/`CHOOSING_MOVIE_GENRE` state waited
  for the next live frame before cancelling. Vel made the already ordered
  cognition-configuration command carry the consensus value, so scheduling and
  cognitive state now cancel together. A deterministic test also proves that a
  stale configuration cannot roll a newer grant backward.
  
  Focused tests and `./gradlew test :app:assembleDebug` pass. No real Food FOF
  work exists yet, so physical attention behavior is intentionally batched into
  the [`I-08 SM-T350 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md) after
  I-06 and I-07 land.
  
  ## Required behavior
  
  - BeetleMind owns ordered BSR state on its existing serial lane.
  - BSR decides attention; it neither recognizes cards nor mutates the board.
  - BSR may deliberate after a neglectable live view only when its live-evidence
    mailbox is empty after the current command.
  - Mailbox state is an explicit protocol-owned submitted/unfinished-live signal; do not inspect executor or Android queue internals.
  - A grant snapshots current `requiredConsensusFrames` as its maximum FOF-opportunity budget.
  - Newly queued live evidence preempts at the next completed bite/FOF boundary and is processed before another bite.
  - Food installation does not automatically grant a dream.
  - Dream completion returns a result for BSR analysis and does not automatically
    grant another dream.
  - Scene/Food replacement, lifecycle disposal, or explicit reset cancels or invalidates old grants.
  - Consensus-setting change cancels the current dream; a later grant snapshots the new value.
  - Telemetry overload cannot affect attention correctness.
  
  One dream is serial Beetle work. Do not create another thread, inspect Android's Main queue, or interrupt FOF halfway through one attempt.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [x] Deterministic tests cover mailbox truth, view classification, deliberate
    grant, foreground preemption, replacement, and disposal.
  - [x] No grant can outlive its scene/Food generation.
  - [x] Foreground Stream behavior is unchanged when no Food exists.
  - [x] A three-opportunity dream snapshots three; a setting change cancels its remainder, and only the next grant uses the new value.
  - [x] Telemetry and optional Main-presentation pressure do not participate in
    live-view classification or mailbox truth.
  - [x] Neither Food installation nor dream completion automatically grants.
  - [x] Not-found and target-hand-member views are neglectable; unknown,
    ambiguous, conversion-failure, board-absent cards, and cards in another hand
    are not.
  
  ## Read first
  
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamBeetleLane.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamBeetleProcessor.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/BeetleMind.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamFrameEnvelope.kt`
  - [`I-04f`](../dev_history/mind/I-04f-active-board-cognitive-copy.md)
  - their deterministic executor/latch tests.
  
  ## Handoff
  
  Land the live-mailbox signal, pure BSR state machine, and serial routing in that
  order before connecting any real FOF bite. Avoid wall-clock sleeps. Publication
  may expose small immutable introspection state, but no user-visible dream
  overlay belongs here.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  No bite search or board mutation from retained evidence.
