  # I-06: BCP dream loop through FOF
  
  Status: software VFR complete; integrated tablet behavior joins I-08
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: I-05 and I-04f
  
  Design source: [`I-impression.md`](I-impression.md), especially **First BSR policy**, **Food lifecycle**, and **Evidence provenance and board consequences**.
  
  ## Goal
  
  Let Beetle Chewing Process feed bounded bites of retained Food through the ordinary FOF cognition path.
  
  ## Execution order
  
  1. [`I-06a`](../dev_history/mind/I-06a-food-fof-dream-results.md) — deterministic Food traversal
     through the ordinary FOF/cognition result seam.
  2. [`I-06b`](../dev_history/mind/I-06b-optimistic-cognitive-board.md) — optimistic cognitive-copy
     updates and generation-sealed Main basket proposals.
  
  Each slice is one reviewed commit. I-06a must not invent an unsealed board
  mutation shortcut; I-06b must not add new vision or traversal behavior.
  
  ## Vel handoff after I-05
  
  Shift has a green light to implement I-06a and I-06b as two commits, in that
  order. Preserve the I-05 distinction between one **dream grant** and one atomic
  **FOF attempt**:
  
  - one grant chooses one deterministic bite location and snapshots the
    consensus-sized attempt budget;
  - repeated opportunities within that grant feed the same bite pixels through
    FOF, so ordinary consensus can actually stabilize;
  - each attempt is one atomic Beetle-lane task; before queuing the next attempt,
    check the protocol-owned live mailbox and let admitted live work run first;
  - completing, exhausting, cancelling, or replacing the grant is explicit. A
    later neglectable live view may deliberate again, but dream completion must
    not manufacture its successor;
  - evolve the I-05 test seam into `DREAMING(MovieGenre)` with only the first real
    deterministic genre. Do not keep a production fake-step branch beside it.
  
  Before wiring the decoder, write the chosen bite rectangle, near-slit-first
  order, stride, and terminal edge clamp into I-06a. Derive the bite dimensions
  from the ordinary FOF input contract and retained Food geometry; do not assume
  that the stretched Food overlay is algorithmic geometry. If the current FOF
  entry point cannot consume an immutable retained-luma view without a large
  copy, stop and report that exact seam rather than creating a Food-only decoder.
  
  I-06b then consumes the typed Food result. Keep prediction, cognitive-copy
  update, and proposal creation in one Beetle transition; keep reducer authority
  and the generation seal on Main. Test the final hand-completing proposal before
  invalidating its seal, plus disagreement, user mutation, and stale queued
  proposal rejection.
  
  ## Required behavior
  
  - Reuse FOF and normal typed cognition semantics; do not use Snap candidate decoding.
  - Every dream result carries Food provenance and therefore cannot trigger Impression recapture.
  - Every completed Food FOF opportunity emits the same P2-05 Beetle-owned
    perception fact as completed live FOF; Telemetry, not Main, accumulates it.
  - Begin with a deterministic cinema traversal. Before coding, the worker records the exact bite size, order, stride, and edge-clamping derived from current FOF input geometry; Shift reviews that small geometry decision.
  - BCP receives each result and retains explicit progress for choosing the next bite. One completed FOF attempt consumes one snapshotted dream opportunity.
  - Show the current bite outline on Food and its supplied pixels in `RoiPreviewStrip()`.
  - Scene/Food generation replacement rejects queued dream results.
  - Food exhaustion is explicit and permits later reselection from the same SAA/SAB scene.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [x] Tests prove live and Food inputs use the intended common recognition seam.
  - [x] Food-origin predicted `ADDED` follows the I-06b cognitive-copy/basket
    protocol and never arms capture.
  - [x] Cancellation/replacement cannot publish stale cognition or UI state.
  - [x] Current-bite geometry and preview pixels correspond to the same retained evidence.
  - [x] Live evidence queued during a dream runs after the current FOF call and before another bite.
  - [x] Orientation/consensus changes and hard-clear events follow the canonical lifecycle matrix.
  - [ ] The consolidated physical behavior remains `Not checked` until the
    [`I-08 SM-T350 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md).
  
  Partial field evidence now confirms visible Food cinema and card recognition on
  SM-T350; exact traversal, board consequence, preemption, and lifecycle checks
  remain in I-08. See
  [`SessionI-08-1`](../optimizations/SessionI-08-1/README.md).
  
  ## Read first
  
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/CameraFrameDecoder.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamBeetleProcessor.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/BeetleMind.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/RoiPreview.kt`
  - [`I-04f`](../dev_history/mind/I-04f-active-board-cognitive-copy.md)
  - the current Stream decoder/evidence translation tests.
  
  ## Handoff
  
  Keep traversal pure and Beetle-owned. Land FOF reuse, Food provenance, cancellation, bite outline, and ROI-preview evidence without adding Snippet colors; I-07 owns reducer-outcome marks. Run full tests and `:app:assembleDebug`; update `docs/features.md` for visible bite/preview behavior.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Start with a deterministic traversal. Suspicion wobble and other adaptive search policy require later evidence and a separate ticket.

Response:
  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
  import java.util.concurrent.Executor
  import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService
  import java.util.concurrent.Executors
  import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
  
  internal interface StreamBeetleLane : AutoCloseable {
      fun hasFrameCapacity(): Boolean
      fun submitFrame(envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope): Boolean
      fun submitControl(command: StreamBeetleCommand): Boolean
      override fun close()
  }
  
  internal fun interface StreamBeetleLaneFactory {
      fun create(
          nowMillis: () -> Long,
          mainExecutor: Executor,
          mainHandoffGate: StreamMainHandoffGate,
          isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
          pulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder,
          onFofCompleted: (FofPerceptionSource) -> Unit,
          onPublication: (StreamBeetlePublication) -> Unit,
      ): StreamBeetleLane
  }
  
  internal class InlineStreamBeetleLane(
      nowMillis: () -> Long,
      private val isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
      private val pulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder = ImpressionPulseRecorder(),
      onFofCompleted: (FofPerceptionSource) -> Unit = {},
      private val onPublication: (StreamBeetlePublication) -> Unit,
  ) : StreamBeetleLane {
      private val processor = StreamBeetleProcessor(nowMillis, onFofCompleted = onFofCompleted)
      private var closed = false
  
      override fun hasFrameCapacity(): Boolean = !closed
  
      override fun submitFrame(envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope): Boolean {
          if (closed || !isFrameCurrent(envelope.streamOutcome.epoch)) return false
          processor.process(
              StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame(envelope, LiveEvidenceMailboxView.CurrentOnly),
          )?.let(onPublication)
          var nextGrant = processor.takePendingDreamGrant()
          while (nextGrant != null) {
              processor.process(StreamBeetleCommand.RunGrantedDream(nextGrant))
                  ?.let(onPublication)
              nextGrant = processor.takePendingDreamGrant()
          }
          return true
      }
  
      override fun submitControl(command: StreamBeetleCommand): Boolean {
          require(command !is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame) {
              "Frame evidence must use submitFrame"
          }
          if (closed) {
              command.releaseCapturedOutcome()
              return false
          }
          val request = command.impressionRequestOrNull()
          request?.let(pulseRecorder::beetleStarted)
          val publication = try {
              processor.process(command)
          } finally {
              request?.let(pulseRecorder::beetleFinished)
          }
          publication?.let { result ->
              request?.let(pulseRecorder::beetlePublicationSubmitted)
              request?.let(pulseRecorder::mainReceived)
              onPublication(result)
          }
          return true
      }
  
      override fun close() {
          if (closed) return
          closed = true
          processor.close()
      }
  
      companion object {
          val FACTORY = StreamBeetleLaneFactory { now, _, _, current, pulse, fof, publish ->
              InlineStreamBeetleLane(now, current, pulse, fof, publish)
          }
      }
  }
  
  internal class ExecutorStreamBeetleLane(
      nowMillis: () -> Long,
      private val mainExecutor: Executor,
      private val mainHandoffGate: StreamMainHandoffGate,
      private val isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
      private val onPublication: (StreamBeetlePublication) -> Unit,
      private val pulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder = ImpressionPulseRecorder(),
      onFofCompleted: (FofPerceptionSource) -> Unit = {},
      private val processor: StreamBeetleProcessor = StreamBeetleProcessor(
          nowMillis,
          onFofCompleted = onFofCompleted,
      ),
      private val executor: ExecutorService = newBeetleExecutor(),
      frameLimit: Int = DEFAULT_FRAME_LIMIT,
  ) : StreamBeetleLane {
      private val frameGate = BoundedStreamWorkGate(frameLimit, "Stream evidence handoff")
      private val closed = AtomicBoolean(false)
      private val processorLock = Any()
      private val pendingCaptures = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<ImpressionCaptured>()
      private val attentionRevision = AtomicLong(1L)
      private var lastEnqueuedThought: EnqueuedThought? = null
  
      override fun hasFrameCapacity(): Boolean =
          !closed.get() && frameGate.hasCapacity()
  
      override fun submitFrame(envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope): Boolean {
          if (closed.get() || !frameGate.tryAcquire()) return false
          val accepted = execute {
              try {
                  synchronized(processorLock) {
                      if (!closed.get() && isFrameCurrent(envelope.streamOutcome.epoch)) {
                          val liveMailbox = LiveEvidenceMailboxView(
                              unfinishedAfterCurrent = frameGate.outstandingWork() - 1,
                          )
                          processor.process(StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame(envelope, liveMailbox))
                              ?.let { publishIfMeaningful(it) }
                          processor.takePendingDreamGrant()?.let { grant ->
                              scheduleAttention(grant, attentionRevision.get())
                          }
                      }
                  }
              } finally {
                  frameGate.release()
              }
          }
          if (!accepted) frameGate.release()
          return accepted
      }
  
      override fun submitControl(command: StreamBeetleCommand): Boolean {
          require(command !is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame) {
              "Frame evidence must use submitFrame"
          }
          val captured = command.capturedImpressionOrNull()
          if (closed.get()) {
              captured?.close()
              return false
          }
          if (command.invalidatesAttention()) attentionRevision.incrementAndGet()
          captured?.let(pendingCaptures::add)
          val accepted = execute {
              synchronized(processorLock) {
                  captured?.let(pendingCaptures::remove)
                  if (!closed.get()) {
                      val request = command.impressionRequestOrNull()
                      request?.let(pulseRecorder::beetleStarted)
                      val publication = try {
                          processor.process(command)
                      } finally {
                          request?.let(pulseRecorder::beetleFinished)
                      }
                      publication?.let { publishIfMeaningful(it, request) }
                  } else {
                      captured?.close()
                  }
              }
          }
          if (!accepted) {
              captured?.let(pendingCaptures::remove)
              captured?.close()
          }
          return accepted
      }
  
      override fun close() {
          if (!closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
          synchronized(processorLock) {
              pendingCaptures.forEach(ImpressionCaptured::close)
              pendingCaptures.clear()
              processor.close()
          }
          executor.shutdownNow()
      }
  
      private fun execute(block: () -> Unit): Boolean = try {
          executor.execute(block)
          true
      } catch (_: RejectedExecutionException) {
          false
      }
  
      private fun scheduleAttention(grant: BsrDreamGrant, revision: Long) {
          execute {
              if (closed.get() || attentionRevision.get() != revision) return@execute
              var retryAfterLive = false
              synchronized(processorLock) {
                  if (closed.get() || attentionRevision.get() != revision) return@synchronized
                  if (frameGate.outstandingWork() > 0) {
                      retryAfterLive = true
                  } else {
                      processor.process(StreamBeetleCommand.RunGrantedDream(grant))
                          ?.let { publishIfMeaningful(it) }
                      processor.takePendingDreamGrant()?.let { next ->
                          scheduleAttention(next, revision)
                      }
                  }
              }
              if (retryAfterLive) scheduleAttention(grant, revision)
          }
      }
  
      private fun publishIfMeaningful(
          publication: StreamBeetlePublication,
          impressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest? = null,
      ) {
          val output = publication.mindOutput
          val thoughtKey = output?.let {
              EnqueuedThought(publication.sourceEpoch, it.snapshot)
          }
          val thoughtChanged = thoughtKey != null && thoughtKey != lastEnqueuedThought
          val mustDeliver =
              output?.acceptedCardScan != null ||
                  publication.foodBoardProposal != null ||
                  publication.snippetUpdate != null ||
                  publication.foodUpdate != null ||
                  publication.impressionUpdate != null ||
                  publication.groundedResourceFailure != null
          if (!thoughtChanged && !mustDeliver && publication.roiPreview == null) {
              publication.releaseRetainedPresentation()
              return
          }
  
          impressionRequest?.let(pulseRecorder::beetlePublicationSubmitted)
          val acquired = if (mustDeliver) {
              mainHandoffGate.acquireRequired()
              true
          } else {
              mainHandoffGate.tryAcquire()
          }
          if (!acquired) {
              publication.releaseRetainedPresentation()
              return
          }
          try {
              mainExecutor.execute {
                  try {
                      impressionRequest?.let(pulseRecorder::mainReceived)
                      if (!closed.get() && publication.isCurrent(isFrameCurrent)) {
                          onPublication(publication)
                      } else {
                          publication.releaseRetainedPresentation()
                      }
                  } finally {
                      mainHandoffGate.release()
                  }
              }
              if (thoughtKey != null) lastEnqueuedThought = thoughtKey
          } catch (_: RejectedExecutionException) {
              mainHandoffGate.release()
              publication.releaseRetainedPresentation()
          }
      }
  
      companion object {
          const val DEFAULT_FRAME_LIMIT = 5
  
          val FACTORY = StreamBeetleLaneFactory { now, main, gate, current, pulse, fof, publish ->
              ExecutorStreamBeetleLane(now, main, gate, current, publish, pulse, fof)
          }
  
          private fun newBeetleExecutor(): ExecutorService =
              Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
                  Thread(runnable, "ITROBOC-BeetleMind").apply { isDaemon = true }
              }
      }
  
      private data class EnqueuedThought(
          val sourceEpoch: StreamEvidenceEpoch?,
          val snapshot: BeetleMindSnapshot,
      )
  }
  
  private fun StreamBeetlePublication.isCurrent(
      isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
  ): Boolean = sourceEpoch?.let(isFrameCurrent) ?: true
  
  private fun StreamBeetleCommand.impressionRequestOrNull(): ImpressionCaptureRequest? =
      (this as? StreamBeetleCommand.InstallImpression)?.outcome?.request
  
  private fun StreamBeetleCommand.capturedImpressionOrNull(): ImpressionCaptured? =
      ((this as? StreamBeetleCommand.InstallImpression)?.outcome as?
          ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured)?.impression
  
  private fun StreamBeetleCommand.releaseCapturedOutcome() {
      capturedImpressionOrNull()?.close()
  }
  
  private fun StreamBeetleCommand.invalidatesAttention(): Boolean = when (this) {
      is StreamBeetleCommand.ReserveImpression,
      is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveCognitionConfiguration,
      StreamBeetleCommand.Unimpress,
      -> true
      is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame,
      is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveStatus,
      is StreamBeetleCommand.Dream,
      is StreamBeetleCommand.InstallImpression,
      is StreamBeetleCommand.RunGrantedDream,
      -> false
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.core.DeckProfile
  
  internal sealed interface StreamBeetleCommand {
      data class ObserveFrame(
          val envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope,
          val liveMailbox: LiveEvidenceMailboxView,
      ) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class ObserveStatus(val status: BeetleOperationalStatus) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class Dream(val topic: BeetleDream) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class ObserveCognitionConfiguration(
          val deckProfile: DeckProfile,
          val orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          val generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
          val requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      ) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class ReserveImpression(val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class InstallImpression(val outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class RunGrantedDream(val grant: BsrDreamGrant) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data object Unimpress : StreamBeetleCommand
  }
  
  internal data class StreamBeetlePublication(
      val mindOutput: BeetleMindOutput?,
      val sourceEpoch: StreamEvidenceEpoch? = null,
      val configurationGeneration: StreamConfigurationGeneration? = null,
      val roiPreview: RoiPreviewSnapshot? = null,
      val impressionUpdate: ImpressionPresentationUpdate? = null,
      val foodUpdate: FoodStateUpdate? = null,
      val foodBiteUpdate: FoodBitePresentationUpdate? = null,
      val foodBoardProposal: FoodBoardProposal? = null,
      val snippetUpdate: SnippetStateUpdate? = null,
      val groundedResourceFailure: GroundedResourceFailure? = null,
  ) {
      init {
          require(
              mindOutput != null ||
                  roiPreview != null ||
                  impressionUpdate != null ||
                  foodUpdate != null ||
                  foodBiteUpdate != null ||
                  foodBoardProposal != null ||
                  snippetUpdate != null ||
                  groundedResourceFailure != null
          ) {
              "A Stream Beetle publication must contain visible or diagnostic output"
          }
      }
  }
  
  internal data class GroundedResourceFailure(val reason: String) {
      init {
          require(reason.isNotBlank()) { "Grounded resource failure reason must not be blank" }
      }
  }
  
  internal fun StreamBeetlePublication.releaseRetainedPresentation() {
      (impressionUpdate as? ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Present)?.snapshot?.close()
  }
  
  /** One serial command handler around BeetleMind; scheduling is supplied later. */
  internal class StreamBeetleProcessor(
      nowMillis: () -> Long,
      settings: BeetleMindSettings = BeetleMindSettings(
          requiredConsensusFrames = TdSessionState.DEFAULT_CONSENSUS_FRAMES,
      ),
      private val onFofCompleted: (FofPerceptionSource) -> Unit = {},
      private val mind: BeetleMind = BeetleMind(nowMillis = nowMillis, settings = settings),
      private val foodCinema: FoodDreamCinema = FoodDreamCinema(),
      private val nowNanos: () -> Long = System::nanoTime,
  ) {
      private var pendingDreamGrant: BsrDreamGrant? = null
      private var cognitionConfiguration: StreamBeetleConfiguration? = null
  
      val thought: BeetleThought
          get() = mind.thought
  
      val lastLiveMailboxView: LiveEvidenceMailboxView?
          get() = mind.lastLiveMailboxView
  
      val bsrState: BsrAttentionState
          get() = mind.bsrState
  
      val priorDreamResult: BsrDreamResult?
          get() = mind.priorDreamResult
  
      fun takePendingDreamGrant(): BsrDreamGrant? =
          pendingDreamGrant.also { pendingDreamGrant = null }
  
      fun close() {
          mind.close()
      }
  
      fun process(command: StreamBeetleCommand): StreamBeetlePublication? = when (command) {
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame -> processFrame(
              command.envelope,
              command.liveMailbox,
          )
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveStatus -> StreamBeetlePublication(
              mindOutput = mind.observeStatus(command.status),
          )
          is StreamBeetleCommand.Dream -> StreamBeetlePublication(
              mindOutput = mind.dream(command.topic),
          )
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveCognitionConfiguration -> {
              cognitionConfiguration = StreamBeetleConfiguration(
                  generation = command.generation,
                  deckProfile = command.deckProfile,
                  orientationMode = command.orientationMode,
                  requiredConsensusFrames = command.requiredConsensusFrames,
              )
              if (
                  mind.observeCognitionConfiguration(
                      orientationMode = command.orientationMode,
                      generation = command.generation,
                      requiredConsensusFrames = command.requiredConsensusFrames,
                  )
              ) {
                  StreamBeetlePublication(
                      mindOutput = null,
                      foodUpdate = mind.currentFood.toStateUpdate(
                          requireNotNull(mind.currentImpressionGeneration),
                          requireNotNull(mind.currentFoodGeneration),
                      ),
                  )
              } else {
                  null
              }
          }
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ReserveImpression -> {
              mind.reserveImpression(command.request)
              null
          }
          is StreamBeetleCommand.InstallImpression -> {
              processImpressionOutcome(command.outcome)
          }
          is StreamBeetleCommand.RunGrantedDream -> {
              processFoodDream(command.grant)
          }
          StreamBeetleCommand.Unimpress -> {
              val clearsPresentation = mind.isImpressed
              val clearsFood = mind.currentFood != null
              val clearedGeneration = mind.currentImpressionGeneration
              val clearedFoodGeneration = mind.currentFoodGeneration
              foodCinema.reset()
              StreamBeetlePublication(
                  mindOutput = mind.unimpress(),
                  impressionUpdate = if (clearsPresentation) {
                      ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Cleared
                  } else {
                      null
                  },
                  foodUpdate = if (clearsFood) {
                      FoodStateUpdate.Cleared(
                          impressionGeneration = requireNotNull(clearedGeneration),
                          foodGeneration = requireNotNull(clearedFoodGeneration),
                      )
                  } else {
                      null
                  },
                  snippetUpdate = if (clearsPresentation) SnippetStateUpdate.Cleared else null,
              )
          }
      }
  
      private fun processImpressionOutcome(
          outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome,
      ): StreamBeetlePublication? {
          if (!mind.isReservedImpression(outcome.request)) {
              mind.installImpression(outcome)
              return null
          }
          val previousFood = mind.currentFood
          val previousImpressionGeneration = mind.currentImpressionGeneration
          val previousFoodGeneration = mind.currentFoodGeneration
          val update = mind.installImpression(outcome)
          foodCinema.install(mind.currentFood)
          return when (outcome) {
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured -> update?.let {
                  val currentFood = mind.currentFood
                  StreamBeetlePublication(
                      mindOutput = null,
                      impressionUpdate = it,
                      foodUpdate = if (currentFood !== previousFood) {
                          currentFood.toStateUpdate(
                              impressionGeneration =
                                  requireNotNull(mind.currentImpressionGeneration),
                              foodGeneration = requireNotNull(mind.currentFoodGeneration),
                          )
                      } else {
                          null
                      },
                  )
              }
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed -> null
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.CutOff -> StreamBeetlePublication(
                  mindOutput = mind.reportImpressionCutOff(),
              )
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.GroundingInvalid -> {
                  val hadImpression = mind.isImpressed
                  val hadFood = mind.currentFood != null
                  StreamBeetlePublication(
                      mindOutput = mind.unimpress(),
                      impressionUpdate = if (hadImpression) {
                          ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Cleared
                      } else {
                          null
                      },
                      foodUpdate = if (hadFood) {
                          FoodStateUpdate.Cleared(
                              requireNotNull(previousImpressionGeneration),
                              requireNotNull(previousFoodGeneration),
                          )
                      } else {
                          null
                      },
                      groundedResourceFailure = GroundedResourceFailure(outcome.reason),
                  )
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun processFrame(
          envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope,
          liveMailbox: LiveEvidenceMailboxView,
      ): StreamBeetlePublication? {
          val configuration = envelope.configuration
          cognitionConfiguration = configuration
          val foodChanged = mind.observeCognitionConfiguration(
              orientationMode = configuration.orientationMode,
              generation = configuration.generation,
              requiredConsensusFrames = configuration.requiredConsensusFrames,
          )
          val outcome = envelope.streamOutcome.outcome
          val evidence = outcome.toBeetleEvidence(
              profile = configuration.deckProfile,
              orientationMode = configuration.orientationMode,
              provenance = BeetleEvidenceProvenance.Live,
          )
          val output = evidence?.let {
              val observation = mind.observeLive(
                  evidence = it,
                  requiredConsensusFrames = configuration.requiredConsensusFrames,
                  liveMailbox = liveMailbox,
              )
              pendingDreamGrant = observation.dreamGrant
              observation.output.also { reportFofCompletion(FofPerceptionSource.LIVE) }
          }
          val roiPreview = outcome.roiPreview
          val foodUpdate = if (foodChanged) {
              mind.currentFood.toStateUpdate(
                  requireNotNull(mind.currentImpressionGeneration),
                  requireNotNull(mind.currentFoodGeneration),
              )
          } else {
              null
          }
          if (output == null && roiPreview == null && foodUpdate == null) return null
          return StreamBeetlePublication(
              mindOutput = output,
              sourceEpoch = envelope.streamOutcome.epoch,
              configurationGeneration = configuration.generation,
              roiPreview = roiPreview,
              foodUpdate = foodUpdate,
          )
      }
  
      private fun processFoodDream(grant: BsrDreamGrant): StreamBeetlePublication? {
          val configuration = cognitionConfiguration ?: return null
          foodCinema.install(mind.currentFood)
          if (!mind.beginDream(grant, MovieGenre.NEAR_SLIT_FIRST)) return null
          val attempt = foodCinema.attempt(grant) ?: return null
          val provenance = BeetleEvidenceProvenance.Food(
              impressionGeneration = grant.foodIdentity.impressionGeneration.value,
              foodGeneration = grant.foodIdentity.foodGeneration.value,
              dreamId = grant.dreamId,
              biteId = attempt.bite.identity.biteId,
          )
          val outcome = attempt.asCameraScanOutcome(nowNanos())
          val evidence = outcome.toBeetleEvidence(
              profile = configuration.deckProfile,
              orientationMode = configuration.orientationMode,
              provenance = provenance,
          ) ?: return null
          val mindOutput = mind.observeFood(evidence, grant) ?: return null
          reportFofCompletion(FofPerceptionSource.FOOD)
          val terminal =
              mindOutput.acceptedCardScan != null ||
                  attempt.attemptNumber == grant.maxFofOpportunities
          var foodUpdate: FoodStateUpdate? = null
          var foodBoardProposal: FoodBoardProposal? = null
          var snippetUpdate: SnippetStateUpdate? = null
          if (terminal) {
              val result = BsrDreamResult(
                  grant = grant,
                  opportunitiesUsed = attempt.attemptNumber,
                  outcome = FoodDreamOutcome(
                      genre = attempt.genre,
                      bite = attempt.bite,
                      acceptedScan = mindOutput.acceptedCardScan,
                  ),
              )
              mind.completeFoodDream(result)?.let { cognition ->
                  foodBoardProposal = cognition.proposal
                  snippetUpdate = cognition.snippetSnapshot?.let(SnippetStateUpdate::Present)
              }
              val exhausted = foodCinema.complete(grant)
              if (exhausted) {
                  val previousFood = mind.currentFood
                  val replacement = mind.reselectFood()
                  foodCinema.install(replacement)
                  if (replacement !== previousFood) {
                      foodUpdate = replacement.toStateUpdate(
                          requireNotNull(mind.currentImpressionGeneration),
                          requireNotNull(mind.currentFoodGeneration),
                      )
                  }
              }
          } else {
              pendingDreamGrant = grant
          }
          val firstAttempt = attempt.attemptNumber == 1
          if (
              !firstAttempt &&
              foodUpdate == null &&
              foodBoardProposal == null &&
              snippetUpdate == null
          ) return null
          return StreamBeetlePublication(
              // Food cognition stays Beetle-owned until I-06b creates a sealed proposal;
              // its internal result must not overwrite the operator's latest live Thought.
              mindOutput = null,
              roiPreview = if (firstAttempt) outcome.roiPreview else null,
              foodUpdate = foodUpdate,
              foodBiteUpdate = if (firstAttempt) {
                  FoodBitePresentationUpdate.Present(attempt.bite)
              } else {
                  null
              },
              foodBoardProposal = foodBoardProposal,
              snippetUpdate = snippetUpdate,
          )
      }
  
      private fun reportFofCompletion(source: FofPerceptionSource) {
          try {
              onFofCompleted(source)
          } catch (_: Exception) {
              // Lossy diagnostics cannot alter cognition or Beetle ordering.
          }
      }
  }
  
  private fun BeetleFood?.toStateUpdate(
      impressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration,
      foodGeneration: FoodGeneration,
  ): FoodStateUpdate =
      this?.let(FoodStateUpdate::Present)
          ?: FoodStateUpdate.Cleared(impressionGeneration, foodGeneration)

Response:
  # I-04g — Edit Board controller jurisdiction split
  
  Status: software VFR complete; physical TD scan smoke remains Not checked
  
  Phase: I — Impression foundation refactoring
  
  Depends on: I-04f and P2-06
  
  ## Why now
  
  `EditBoardController.kt` has grown to roughly 864 lines and its principal test
  file to roughly 1,046 lines. The controller currently combines several valid
  Main-owned responsibilities with lane construction, frozen Snap lifecycle,
  Impression presentation preparation, temporary P2 telemetry, evidence mapping,
  and its Compose factory. The behavior is working; the review surface is not.
  
  This is an **attention-economy** refactor. It must make later I-05/I-06 work
  easier to locate and review without changing field behavior or inventing a new
  architecture layer merely to reduce a line count.
  
  ## Goal
  
  Keep `EditBoardController` as the small Main-thread façade and authoritative
  board/reducer seam while moving existing subordinate jurisdictions into boring,
  focused Kotlin files inside `:app`.
  
  This ticket means file-level components, not new Gradle modules, executors, or
  threads.
  
  ## Target jurisdictions
  
  ### `EditBoardController.kt` — Main authority and façade
  
  Retain:
  
  - UI-facing operational state and the API consumed by `EditBoardScreen`;
  - authoritative `BoardEditState` and calls to `EditBoardReducer`;
  - accepted-card disposition handling;
  - the exact live-`ADDED` Impression trigger;
  - semantic hard-clear decisions and operator command routing;
  - final application of ordered subordinate effects.
  
  It must not retain coroutine-based Snap processing, worker construction, or
  camera-evidence translation after this refactor.
  
  ### `EditBoardStreamSession.kt` — four-lane Stream plumbing
  
  Own:
  
  - `StreamBeetleConfigurationStore`;
  - `StreamMainHandoffGate`, Telemetry lane, and Beetle lane construction;
  - `ImpressionRetinalBridge` and Love-Blonds gate wiring;
  - frame admission/submission, Mind status/configuration submission, dreams,
    unimpress, and exact lane disposal order;
  - immutable callbacks carrying Beetle publications and low-rate telemetry back
    to the Main façade.
  
  It must not mutate `BoardEditState`, call `EditBoardReducer`, or own Compose
  presentation state.
  
  ### `EditBoardSnapCoordinator.kt` — isolated frozen Snap jurisdiction
  
  Own:
  
  - `SnapCaptureGate`, Snap correlation IDs, feed/diagnostic arming, and
    `SnapScanState`;
  - the Snap coroutine/job, processing deadline, finder settings, result dwell,
    cancellation, and resume behavior;
  - diagnostic fixture-capture handoff and processed Snap evidence;
  - Main-owned callbacks for the existing reducer/result effects.
  
  The coordinator stays behavior-compatible and deletion-friendly. This ticket
  does not repair, revive, or redesign Snap. Heavy analysis remains on its
  existing dispatcher; reducer effects remain ordered on Main.
  
  ### `EditBoardPublicationPresenter.kt` — Main presentation preparation
  
  Own:
  
  - `ImpressionDisplayState` and `FoodDisplayState` application;
  - P2 pulse preparation spans, completed-line publication, and bounded log
    ledger bookkeeping;
  - transformation of one Beetle publication into presentation/diagnostic
    effects returned to the controller.
  
  It may expose Main-owned observable presentation state, but it must return
  accepted scans and grounded-resource failures to `EditBoardController`; it
  must not mutate the board or navigate.
  
  ### Leaf files
  
  - Move `CameraScanOutcome.toBeetleEvidence` to
    `CameraScanOutcomeBeetleEvidence.kt` with its focused tests.
  - Move `rememberEditBoardController` to `RememberEditBoardController.kt` so
    Compose lifetime wiring is not hidden at the bottom of the controller.
  - Keep small Snap formatting/correlation helpers with the Snap coordinator,
    not as unrelated controller-file tails.
  
  Names may be tightened during implementation, but these ownership boundaries
  must not collapse into one replacement god-object or one context object carrying
  the whole controller.
  
  ## Small-commit gait
  
  1. **I-04g1 — leaf extraction:** move evidence mapping, Snap-local helpers, and
     the Compose factory without behavior changes.
  2. **I-04g2 — Snap isolation:** extract the frozen Snap coordinator and migrate
     its focused tests.
  3. **I-04g3 — Stream-session isolation:** extract lane/configuration/retinal
     plumbing with deterministic lifecycle and ordering tests.
  4. **I-04g4 — presentation isolation:** extract Main presentation/pulse state,
     shrink the façade, split the remaining controller tests by jurisdiction,
     and align stable architecture/UI docs.
  
  Each gait is one reviewable code commit. Do not mix an I-05 behavior change
  into these commits.
  
  ## Load-bearing invariants
  
  - Main remains the only authoritative board/reducer owner.
  - Analyzer -> BeetleMind -> Main ordering and the bounded handoff contract do
    not change.
  - Telemetry stays lossy and cannot affect cognition or board correctness.
  - Only reducer-confirmed live `ADDED` may arm Impression capture.
  - I-04g reserved no Food-proposal interface; I-06b later added that seam in its
    owning behavior ticket.
  - Hard-clear, reimpression, Love Blonds, generation/correlation, and retained
    scene release behavior remain exact.
  - Existing Snap behavior remains unchanged even though its feature code is
    headed for later deletion.
  - Compose state and board effects are not mutated from Analyzer, BeetleMind,
    Telemetry, or the Snap analysis dispatcher.
  - Closing an Edit Board visit closes each owned lane/gate/job exactly once and
    late work cannot revive UI state.
  - No new executor, application thread, Gradle module, or speculative growth
    stub lands in this refactor.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [x] `EditBoardController.kt` contains no Snap coroutine/processor ownership,
    no Stream-lane construction, no `CameraScanOutcome` mapping, and no Compose
    factory.
  - [x] The controller remains the clear place to review reducer authority,
    live-`ADDED` Impression capture eligibility, hard clears, and operator board
    commands.
  - [x] Extracted components depend on narrow callbacks/snapshots rather than on
    `EditBoardController` itself or a broad mutable context bag.
  - [x] Focused mapper, Stream-session, presenter, and Snap tests are divided by
    jurisdiction; cross-jurisdiction characterization remains in the façade
    suite, and coverage is preserved.
  - [x] Deterministic tests cover lane close/rejection, Snap cancellation and
    correlation, presentation release, pulse logging, and accepted-card ordering.
  - [x] No user-visible string, layout, timing policy, scan disposition, or
    accessibility semantics changes.
  - [x] Full `./gradlew test` and `:app:assembleDebug` pass after every gait.
  - [ ] Physical behavior remains **Not checked** until Archy performs the normal
    TD scan smoke in the consolidated
    [`I-08 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md).
  
  ## Vel VFR
  
  Vel reviewed `3283ef3` through `ffb1d28` as one four-gait refactor. The road is
  sound: Main retains reducer and board authority; Snap keeps its former frozen
  lifecycle behind one coordinator; Stream lane creation and shutdown are visit
  owned; presentation and pulse bookkeeping remain Main-owned; and the extracted
  objects receive narrow callbacks rather than the controller.
  
  VFR retained Shift's code and made one attention-economy cleanup: the presenter
  test file now carries the presenter name. The large façade suite intentionally
  keeps flows which cross reducer, Impression, and subordinate-publication seams;
  the acceptance text no longer implies that those integration tests became
  isolated unit tests.
  
  `./gradlew test :app:assembleDebug` passed on the combined convoy. The
  calibration-preview assertions included in I-04g1 correctly catch up with
  Archy's earlier one-third preview tuning; they do not introduce an I-04g UI
  change. Physical TD scanning remains explicitly unclaimed.
  
  ## Read first
  
  - `AGENTS.md`
  - `docs/architecture.md`, especially TD Stream execution ownership
  - `docs/ui_patterns.md`, especially the diagnostic-state boundary
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/EditBoardController.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/EditBoardDiagnosticState.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamBeetleLane.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamTelemetryLane.kt`
  - `app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/ImpressionRetinalBridge.kt`
  - `app/src/test/kotlin/org/itroboc/app/EditBoardControllerTest.kt`
  - `app/src/test/kotlin/org/itroboc/app/SnapScanOrchestrationTest.kt`
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Do not use this ticket to change product behavior, remove Snap, implement BSR or
  Food dreaming, alter thread count, redesign Compose/device layouts, or move
  Main authority into a worker. The value is smaller jurisdiction and cheaper
  review—not abstraction for its own sake.

  # Phase Drafts
  
  This directory holds phase-specific product notes, parked ideas, and future-ticket drafts that are more concrete than the high-level roadmap but not yet stable architecture.
  
  Use it for ideas that belong to a roadmap phase but should not immediately become a workbee ticket.
  
  ## Naming
  
  Use the roadmap phase prefix: (it stopped being alphabetic-ordered)
  
  ```text
  A-*.md  Focus-tested baseline <--- ever iterating
  B-*.md  Snap scanning path <--- done and frozen as partly failed; see B2
  P1-*.md "Profiling" -- done some with ⏩🐝
  I-*.md  "Impression" -- BSR/BCP/Food; overlays; I-08 field flight active
  P2-*.md "Profiling & Design" -- software gait VFR'd; Archy's field closeout remains
  I-*.md  "Impression" -- BSR/BCP/Food; overlays; to resume after P2
  C-*.md  Feature-complete closure
  D-*.md  Phone UI design
  E-*.md  Tablet UI reconciliation
  F-*.md  Composable architecture pass
  P3-*.md "Profiling" -- may do some more optimizations
  S-*.md  Explicit Streak feed mode  <-- may never happen
  B2-*.md  Revisit Snap scanning path  <-- may never happen
  ```
  
  Example:
  
  ```text
  D-scissors.md
  frozen/S-streak-feed-mode.md
  ```
  
  Phase letters describe product/design lanes; they are not required to be alphabetical execution order.
  
  Completed Phase I cognition tickets and their review notes move to [Mind implementation history](../dev_history/mind/README.md); active Phase I contracts and tickets remain here.
  
  Completed P2 implementation tickets move to
  [`P2 optimization history`](../dev_history/optimizations/P2/README.md); active
  P2 umbrellas and field-closeout work remain here.
  
  Current non-urgent Phase A Admin Calibrate follow-ups:
  
  - [`first-ever granted-permission calibration`](A-admin-calibrate-first-ever-polish.md);
  - [`missing/denied/revoked camera permission`](A-admin-calibrate-missing-camera-permission.md).
  
  Current P2 work begins at
  [`P2 — Impression pulse profiling and resource preparation`](P2-impression-pulse.md).
  
  I-06 and I-07 have passed software VFR. Current Phase I execution is the
  combined [`I-08 SM-T350 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md).
  
  Frozen or indefinitely parked phase families live under
  [`frozen/`](frozen/README.md).
  They are retained design/history, not the current execution queue.
  
  ## Lifecycle
  
  ```text
  rough idea / parked design note
  -> phase draft in docs/phases/
  -> tightened workbee ticket when implementation timing arrives
  -> source implementation and review
  -> durable truth absorbed into stable docs
  -> temporary ticket/draft deleted or marked historical if still useful
  ```
  
  ## Guardrails
  
  - `docs/roadmap.md` carries the dependency ladder.
  - `docs/phases/` carries phase-local drafts and future-ticket seeds.
  - `docs/dev_history/` carries active or historical implementation handoffs.
  - Stable product and architecture truth belongs in `product_context.md`, `ui_patterns.md`, `logic_invariants.md`, or `architecture.md`.
  
  Phase drafts may be speculative. They should clearly say when they are blocked by a later phase or not ready for implementation.

Call: write_file(text=# I-08a — BSR quiet-interval deliberation opportunity

Status: ticketed; identified during I-08 flight

Phase: I — Impression

Depends on: I-08

## Problem

During the I-08 field flight, the "Beetle sitting in a BAR" (BSR) was found to
wait for the end of the `Love Blonds` quiet second before starting its first
"dream."

### Cause

- `P2-04` (Love Blonds) suppresses `LIVE` barcode analysis for one monotonic
  second after a successful Impression capture submission.
- The `Analyzer` is quiet during this window, so no `ObserveFrame` commands
  reach the `BeetleMind` lane.
- `I-05` (BSR) triggers deliberation only upon "completion of a neglectable
  live view" (via `BeetleMind.observeLive`).
- Consequently, the BAR remains empty and no background Food cognition runs
  until the first post-quiet live frame arrives.

### Goal

Allow the Beetle to begin "ladybug hunting" (background Food dreams) immediately
after an Impression is installed, even while the live foreground remains in its
"devotional" quiet interval.

## Required behavior

- The one-second `Love Blonds` quiet must continue to suppress `LIVE`
  recognition and board addition from the slit.
- BeetleMind must receive an opportunity to deliberate and grant a dream
  immediately after a new Impression is installed, without waiting for the
  first post-capture frame.
- The "Quiet Foreground" during the `Love Blonds` window should be treated as
  an eligible (neglectable) view for BSR deliberation.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A successful Impression capture submission immediately triggers the first
  BSR deliberation.
- [ ] Food "cinema" (traversal and recognition) begins running during the
  one-second `Love Blonds` quiet.
- [ ] `LIVE` recognition remains suppressed until the monotonic quiet expires.

## Boundary

This ticket addresses the timing conflict between P2-04 and I-05. It does not
change the one-second duration, the "neglectable view" definition, or the
`FOF` recognition seam.

  # I-08b — Continuing Food attention while LIVE is quiet
  
  Status: field-discovered design problem; awaiting Selyn design; not ready for implementation
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: archived
  [`I-08a`](../dev_history/mind/I-08a-bsr-quiet-interval-opportunity.md),
  [`I-05`](I-05-bsr-attention-router.md), and
  [`I-06`](I-06-bcp-fof-dream-loop.md)
  
  ## Field truth
  
  Archy's ten-second Love-Blonds experiment distinguishes the two seams clearly:
  
  ```text
  initial Food becomes ready
  → INITIAL_FOOD_READY grants one bounded dream
  → one bite outline shifts and its ROI is visible during Love Blonds
  → that dream completes
  → BSR returns to IMPRESSED
  → cinema stalls until LIVE recognition resumes
  ```
  
  I-08a therefore works. The new defect is that recurring attention is offered
  only by a completed neglectable LIVE view. Love Blonds deliberately suppresses
  all Analyzer LIVE decoding during its quiet interval, so BSR waits for a
  certificate from an office that is closed. 🍅🎯
  
  One visible frame does not mean one FOF call. A bounded dream retries one stable
  bite up to its captured consensus budget, while only the first attempt normally
  publishes bite/ROI presentation.
  
  ## Product intent
  
  Love Blonds pauses LIVE recognition, not BeetleMind's use of retained Food.
  Once current Food exists, BSR should be able to continue allocating bounded
  cognition opportunities without requiring a later live frame. LIVE work that
  was already admitted or arrives after quiet ends must still regain priority at
  the established atomic FOF boundary.
  
  ## Selyn's design questions
  
  Design the smallest coherent continuation policy before assigning code:
  
  1. What Beetle-owned event offers the next deliberation opportunity after a
     bounded Food dream completes?
  2. What keeps continuing cinema bounded and prevents a tight self-scheduling
     loop on the BeetleMind executor?
  3. How do LIVE preemption, replacement reservation, consensus/configuration
     change, hard clear, and disposal revoke pending continuation work?
  4. When may BSR refuse, pause, change Food, or declare Food exhausted?
  5. Which internal attempts update SPS, and which bite/ROI transitions deserve
     operator-visible publication? Do not infer cognition timing only from a
     lossy UI frame.
  6. Which rules belong to pure `BeetleSelfReflection`, which belong to serial
     lane scheduling, and which are merely presentation policy?
  
  Selyn may split implementation tickets after answering these questions. She is
  welcome to ask Archy or Vel when product pacing, visibility, or cancellation is
  unclear.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Do not reopen I-08a, weaken Love Blonds, manufacture live evidence, add a
  Mind-to-Analyzer signal, or make an unbounded executor loop. This ticket first
  designs a proper continuing BSR policy; it does not yet prescribe its timer,
  budget, genre selection, or Food-exhaustion algorithm.

  # Hive to Selyn — application for BSR design review
  
  Status: field feedback and design genealogy; no code change proposed here
  
  ## Why this application exists
  
  SM-T350 observation clarified the current behavior:
  
  ```text
  Impression and initial Food appear immediately
  → one white Food-bite rectangle appears immediately
  → that bite is chewed to its consensus bound
  → SPS returns to IDLE
  → the white rectangle remains still for the rest of Love Blonds
  → the first post-quiet neglectable LIVE view permits the next dream/bite
  ```
  
  There is no mysterious timer or executor failure. The software is following a
  locally coherent but globally unhelpful composition of the BSR rules.
  
  Archy's high-level intention remains:
  
  > Love Blonds pauses LIVE recognition only. It must not make BeetleMind wait
  > before using newly installed Food.
  
  The present implementation lets BeetleMind use Food for one dream, then makes
  further deliberation depend on LIVE recognition—which Love Blonds deliberately
  suppresses.
  
  ## Chat log between ⏩🐝 Shift and  Archy 
  
  ⏱️👓 **Bob:** I found a reason that fits the exact `DEFAULT_DURATION_MILLIS` correlation.
  The cinema probably starts on time, but its first visible publication can be dropped.
  
  The first Food attempt produces:
  
  - `foodBiteUpdate`
  - Food ROI preview
  
  at [StreamBeetleProcessor.kt](./app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamBeetleProcessor.kt:348).
  
  But [StreamBeetleLane.kt](./app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/StreamBeetleLane.kt:269) does **not** classify `foodBiteUpdate` as mandatory. If the five-slot Main/UI handoff is full, `tryAcquire()` fails and the entire visible publication is discarded at line 288.
  
  Open Mind makes this likely because every admitted LIVE frame also produces an optional ROI preview. Around Impression capture, the tablet can have several such Main callbacks outstanding.
  
  Then:
  
  ```text
  initial Food becomes ready
  → Food decoder runs during Love Blonds
  → first-bite/ROI publication is dropped
  → no retry for that bite
  → Love Blonds expires
  → next neglectable LIVE frame offers another dream
  → Main pressure has cleared
  → this movie becomes visible
  ```
  
  Thus increasing Love Blonds to five seconds moves the first **visible** cinema approximately five seconds, although the first invisible Food work may already have happened.
  
  🧭🪟 **Trace:** Our I‑08a test missed this distinction. It proves that the decoder runs during quiet, but its `onPublication` callback is empty; it never proves that the first bite reaches Main under a saturated handoff gate.
  
  ✂️💋 **Fi:** The beetle entered the cinema on time. The projector discarded the first reel, and the audience saw only the encore after the doors reopened. 🍿
  
  The narrow likely repair is to treat a `foodBiteUpdate` as mandatory presentation traffic—probably by including it in `mustDeliver`. A deterministic saturated-Main test should prove both:
  
  1. Food decoding occurs during Love Blonds.
  2. Its first bite and ROI actually reach Main during Love Blonds.
  
  One field confirmation is available now: if SPS changes during the five-second “visual wait,” that strongly confirms hidden Food cognition rather than delayed cognition.
  
  > 🛠️👓  team, wait.
  > feel free to ask me what I observe to help you locate the bug.
  > and explain me how would it look what you think you found as a bug.
  > we can inject some code, we can use `logcat`. etc. just guide me.
  > ℹ️ git Switched to a new branch 'crit/I-08a'
  
  💓🛠️ Good—let’s pause before fixing. `crit/I-08a` is exactly the right branch for instrumentation.
  
  ✂️💋 **Fi:** First, when you say “cinema starts,” which visible motion tells you that?
  
  Please watch one five-second run and tell us:
  
  1. Do SAA, SAB, and Food appear immediately after 🐞 appears, or only after five seconds?
  2. During the five-second wait, does the bite outline or ROI Preview:
  
     - keep showing the live slit,
     - freeze on its previous image,
     - disappear / say “Waiting for ROI”?
  3. Does SPS rise or flicker during the wait, even though no Food motion is visible?
  4. At five seconds, do you see one brief bite, or a continuing sequence of bites?
  
  🧭🪟 **Trace:** These observations separate three different clocks:
  
  ```text
  🐞 + postcards appear
  = Impression reached BeetleMind and Main
  
  SPS changes
  = Food cognition probably executed

  # Phase I — Impression vocabulary
  
  Status: working design vocabulary for current Impression / BSR / BCP work
  
  This file gives Archy, Selyn, and the Hive one shared language for discussing
  retained-scene cognition without making every conversation re-derive the same
  terms.
  
  It is a design vocabulary, not a claim that every current implementation detail
  already follows the newest wording. Where current I-06 behavior differs from the
  newer design direction, the implementation ticket remains historical truth and
  future design work owns the migration.
  
  ## Core scene terms
  
  ### Impression
  
  The retained cognitive encounter owned by BeetleMind after a qualifying live
  `ADDED`: retained SAA/SAB scene evidence, cognitive board context, Food,
  provenance/generations, dream progress, and Snippets.
  
  ### SAA / SAB — the postcards
  
  The retained grayscale scene reservoirs above and below the live slit.
  
  They are the wider remembered scene from which Food is selected.
  
  ### Food
  
  A retained grayscale corridor selected from SAA or SAB for later cognition.
  
  Food is not one scan result and not one bite. It is the larger material available
  to Beetle for background thought.
  
  ## Perception terms
  
  ### Bite
  
  One exact rectangular view into Food, shown by the white outline in Open Mind
  when that view is being supplied to FOF.
  
  A Bite is geometric. If the rectangle shifts, even slightly, that is a new Bite.
  
  One FOF attempt consumes one Bite view.
  
  ### FOF attempt
  
  One use of the ordinary Foreground Feeding recognition seam on one supplied
  view, whether the source is LIVE or FOOD.
  
  FOF remains the same perceptual primitive; source/provenance says whether the
  pixels came from the live slit or retained Food.
  
  ### Chewing
  
  Local repeated examination after a Bite shows something worth chewing: a
  barcode, or at least a result that is "not nothing" according to the active
  DreamGenre.
  
  Chewing should use a small family of nearby overlapping Bites rather than
  repeating the exact same pixels. The current design intuition is to shift the
  white rectangle by about one pixel between nearby views.
  
  Why this matters:
  
  ```text
  same exact crop repeated
  -> the same mixed/partial barcode artifact may repeat
  -> consensus can accidentally certify that artifact
  
  slightly shifted overlapping bites
  -> evidence changes geometrically
  -> consensus has a chance to reject a Frankenstein reading
  ```
  
  The exact shift pattern, number of nearby Bites, and what qualifies as
  "not nothing" belong to the selected DreamGenre. This file does not prescribe
  a universal wobble algorithm.
  
  ## Higher-level cognition terms
  
  ### Dream
  
  `Dream` and `movie` are synonyms; prefer **Dream** in current design prose.
  
  A Dream is one BSR-granted bounded chapter of retained-Food cognition under one
  DreamGenre.
  
  A Dream may inspect one or more Bites and may contain local Chewing. Its exact
  path is genre-specific. When the Dream ends, it returns a result to BSR for
  reflection/adaptation rather than blindly ordering its own successor.
  
  Compression:
  
  ```text
  BSR grants a Dream
  -> Dream runs one bounded chapter
  -> Dream returns a result
  -> BSR decides what happens next
  ```
  
  ### DreamGenre
  
  The strategy/algorithm by which one Dream chooses and consumes retained Food.
  
  This replaces the older term `MovieGenre` in current design vocabulary. Exact
  Kotlin renaming is a separate implementation decision; this vocabulary change
  does not by itself claim source has already migrated.
  
  A DreamGenre may decide, among other things:
  
  - where a Dream starts;
  - whether a weak/non-empty observation deserves Chewing;
  - how nearby overlapping Bites move during Chewing;
  - when the Dream has learned enough to stop and return a result.
  
  ### Cinema
  
  Cinema is the larger procession of Dreams over an Impression/Food context.
  
  A Dream is like one chapter in a book named **Cinema**.
  
  Successive Dreams do not have to inspect adjacent Food locations. BSR may use
  prior Dream results and the active DreamGenre to choose where attention goes
  next.
  
  ```text
  Cinema
    -> Dream
    -> BSR reflection
    -> Dream
    -> BSR reflection
    -> ...
  ```
  
  The current I-08b design problem is precisely how continuing Cinema should
  receive repeated BSR deliberation opportunities without becoming a blind
  self-scheduling loop or weakening LIVE preemption.
  
  ## Mind / ownership terms
  
  ### BSR — Beetle Self-Reflection
  
  The BeetleMind-owned attention/reflection policy.
  
  BSR decides whether and how retained cognition receives another bounded Dream.
  It does not decode pixels and does not mutate the authoritative board.
  
  ### BCP — Beetle Chewing Process
  
  The BeetleMind-owned retained-Food execution process used inside Dreams.
  
  BCP supplies Food-derived Bite views through FOF, tracks bounded progress, and
  returns typed Dream results/provenance to the surrounding cognition flow.
  
  ### Snippet
  
  A retained scene mark recording the board consequence associated with a barcode
  occurrence discovered through Food cognition.
  
  Current Phase-I language:
  
  - green — predicted `ADDED`;
  - yellow — `ALREADY_IN_TARGET`.
  
  ## Visual intuition
  
  Open Mind is an aquarium of cognition, not a debugger console:
  
  ```text
  postcards        = what scene Beetle retained
  Food             = what material is available for thought
  white Bite       = what exact view FOF is seeing now
  Chewing          = nearby overlapping views around something interesting
  Dream            = one bounded chapter of thought
  Cinema           = the larger procession of Dreams
  Snippets         = consequences remembered at places in the scene
  🐞               = Beetle remains impressed
  ```
  
  The visual vocabulary should stay close to real cognition state. A separate
  I-08 observability ticket owns the current gap where the **Thoughts** text does
  not refresh meaningfully while Beetle is dreaming.
  
  ## Current migration note
  
  The landed I-06 implementation currently defines one Dream around repeated FOF
  attempts on one stable Bite. That behavior is historical/current implementation
  truth.
  
  The newer design direction in this file changes the intended vocabulary and
  future algorithmic shape:
  
  ```text
  old:
  Dream -> repeated FOF on one exact stable Bite
  
  new direction:
  Dream -> one bounded chapter
         -> Bite(s)
         -> Chewing only when something is worth chewing
         -> nearby overlapping shifted Bites protect consensus
  ```
  
  Do not silently rewrite completed I-06 history. I-08b and later focused design
  work should explicitly migrate the current algorithm where Archy approves it.

Response:
  # I-08c — Keep Thoughts alive while Beetle dreams
  
  Status: field-observed design seed; not ready for implementation until wording/state policy is agreed
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: I-05 BSR, I-06 BCP/FOF dream loop, I-08 field observation
  
  ## Field observation
  
  Open Mind has become a useful cognition aquarium: Archy can see retained
  postcards, Food, the current white Bite outline, ROI Preview, and Snippets while
  Beetle performs retained-Food cognition.
  
  One visibility gap remains:
  
  ```text
  Beetle is actively dreaming / chewing
  -> bite/ROI aquarium changes
  -> Thoughts text does not meaningfully update
  ```
  
  The visual cognition can therefore be alive while the textual Beetle-thought
  surface looks stale.
  
  ## Product intent
  
  Keep **Thoughts** semantically aligned with Beetle's high-level cognitive state
  while Dreams/Cinema run.
  
  This is not a request for a debugger trace or one text update per FOF attempt.
  The aquarium should remain word-light. Thoughts should expose meaningful state
  or reflection changes, not become a scrolling execution log.
  
  ## Vocabulary
  
  Use [`I-vocabulary.md`](I-vocabulary.md):
  
  - **Bite** — one exact white-rectangle view into Food;
  - **Chewing** — local examination through nearby overlapping Bite views after
    something worth chewing appears;
  - **Dream** — one BSR-granted bounded chapter;
  - **Cinema** — a procession of Dreams with BSR reflection between them.
  
  The current landed I-06 stable-Bite behavior is implementation history. This
  ticket should follow the vocabulary/design state approved for I-08b rather than
  inventing a second terminology.
  
  ## Design questions for Archy / Selyn
  
  Before implementation, settle the smallest useful textual grammar:
  
  1. Which high-level events deserve a visible Thoughts update?
     Candidates to discuss include BSR granting/refusing a Dream, entering
     Chewing, completing a Dream, changing Food, or stopping Cinema.
  2. Should Thoughts describe the current activity, the latest BSR reflection,
     or both?
  3. What should remain visible after a Dream ends but before BSR chooses what
     happens next?
  4. Should Open Mind posture affect how much Thoughts says, or should Thoughts
     use the same semantic wording whether the aquarium is open or closed?
  5. When LIVE preempts a Dream, should Thoughts explicitly show the attention
     switch or simply return to ordinary foreground thought?
  
  These are product-language questions. Do not infer answers from current Kotlin
  state names alone.
  
  ## Boundaries
  
  - No per-FOF-attempt text spam.
  - No timing/SPS/queue diagnostics in normal Thoughts prose.
  - Do not make Thoughts the owner of BSR/BCP state; it renders immutable
    cognition publications.
  - Do not weaken LIVE preemption or change dream scheduling merely to make text
    easier to display.
  - Do not equate a still white Bite rectangle with no cognition; repeated or
    local Chewing may occur behind one visual region depending on the active
    design.
  - Do not close the aquarium issue by hiding the aquarium.
  
  ## Acceptance shape — to finalize after design
  
  A future implementation ticket should be able to prove at least:
  
  - when Beetle begins retained-Food cognition, Thoughts no longer remains
    misleadingly stale;
  - meaningful Dream/Cinema state transitions reach Main/UI without per-attempt
    callback pressure;
  - stale-generation or cleared Impression work cannot resurrect old Thoughts;
  - ordinary foreground scanning remains unchanged when no Dream is active;
  - field observation on SM-T350 confirms the text and aquarium tell a coherent
    story together.
  
  Exact strings, publication cadence, and state-to-text mapping remain deliberately
  open until Archy and Selyn design them.

Response:
  # ITROBOC Product Context
  
  Last aligned with branch state: `dev/impression` docs/code surface reviewed 2026-08-23.
  
  ITROBOC means **Independent Tool for Reading Observed Barcodes On Cards**.
  
  It is an Android-first assistant app for bridge Tournament Directors. The real-world bottleneck is manually converting physical dealt cards into digital bridge hand records.
  
  The app goal is:
  
  ```text
  physical barcode-marked playing cards
  -> decoded card IDs
  -> validated bridge hands/board
  -> PBN export/save/share
  ```
  
  ## Real-world workflow
  
  The TD needs to build bridge hand data from real physical cards. The cards have machine-readable barcode-like markings. The app helps the TD scan cards using a phone/tablet camera.
  
  Current TD-side workflow is guided and cumulative:
  
  1. Open TD overview.
  2. Choose a board.
  3. Select a seat: North, East, South, or West.
  4. Show cards/barcodes to the camera in ordinary Stream mode.
  5. The app reads a thin centered barcode ROI and extracts a raw Grid13 signature.
  6. The active Deck Profile maps the raw signature to a canonical `CardId`.
  7. BeetleMind stabilizes evidence before board mutation.
  8. The reducer applies only typed accepted card scans to board state.
  9. Unknown and ambiguous evidence may appear in beetle-thought, but do not mutate the board.
  10. Duplicates, already-present cards, and full-hand cases remain typed outcomes rather than guessed success.
  11. Human/scan mistakes and unreadable physical cards can be recovered with `Undo`, `Scissors`, `Swap`, `I'm sure`, and `Clear`.
  12. Auto-fill Fourth Hand can calculate the final hand when the other three are complete.
  13. When a board is scanned, the central view shows imported Double Dummy analysis when an optimum-result table is available; otherwise it shows a PBN preview.
  14. The scanned cockpit offers PREV/NEXT navigation through visible board numbers, wrapping at the grid boundaries.
  15. TD overview can export all scanned boards as cumulative PBN, share them, or save them locally.
  
  The app does not need one perfect scan. It should support fast iterative convergence.
  
  The current camera target is intentionally a thin blade rather than an open mouth: about 20% of the camera-frame width and at most 8 pixels high. The interaction should feel familiar to anyone who has used a grocery-store scanner: the operator moves the object until the visible beam crosses its barcode. The visible slit is a steering aid; the exact Analyzer ROI may differ from its theatrical position by a few pixels without breaking the interaction.
  
  Success is not “decode every visible card perfectly in one frame.”
  
  Success is:
  
  ```text
  help the TD reach 13 correct cards per hand quickly and safely.
  ```
  
  ## Current product principles
  
  ```text
  Admin = explanation; TD = verdict.
  Wrong card is worse than missed card.
  Scanner does not know card meaning.
  Profiles map raw signatures to cards.
  Orientation is data.
  Visible runs are evidence; normalized Grid13 cells are identity.
  TD flow must reduce hand-burden and babysitting.
  A verdict must be visible.
  Board scanned means: stop scanning; trust the landing.
  ```
  
  ## Admin side
  
  Admin defines and inspects Deck Profiles.
  
  A Deck Profile maps observed raw barcode signatures to canonical cards, for example:
  
  ```text
  bfm1549 -> SA
  brm.... -> D8
  ```
  
  Deck Profiles allow support for different physical deck types without changing app code.
  
  Current Admin surfaces include:
  
  - profile listing and active selection;
  - profile JSON import/export;
  - Admin::Edit calibration from live CameraX frames;
  - barcode ROI, Grid13 preview, alias support, profile-edit controls, and scan/debug output;
  - Admin resource calibration for Impression is a hard first-use prerequisite:
    it observes real camera analysis geometry, displays Frame/ROI/SAA/SAB,
    prepares two bounded scene slots, and later confirms the saved contract from
    one current-session analysis frame. TD capture transfers a compatible slot
    through Analyzer to BeetleMind; remaining physical closeout is folded into
    the consolidated I-08 field flight.
  
  Admin is part of the independence beam: real calibrated deck profiles are expected to come from observation and calibration, not from being stuck with a single built-in profile.
  
  ## TD side
  
  TD uses an existing Deck Profile to build boards.
  
  Current TD surfaces:
  
  - TD overview with dynamic board grid, Import, Export, Save, Settings;
  - TD::EditBoard cockpit with four hands, camera area, orientation control, feed/status areas, last-scanned-card/beetle area, and recovery controls;
  - TD::EditBoard uses a typed `BeetleMind` stabilization/thought layer before accepted scans mutate board state;
  - Scissors selected-hand repair screen for late correction, manual add of scratched/no-barcode cards, and moving cards from another hand when the previous placement was wrong;
  - completed-board cockpit state with DD/TNT analysis or PBN preview and PREV/NEXT board navigation;
  - app-level state and local persistence/autosave for the working tournament/session surfaces where currently implemented.
  
  Current TD recovery controls:
  
  - `Undo`: LIFO undo for currently selected hand;
  - `Scissors`: full-screen selected-hand repair; remove wrong cards, add unreadable/no-barcode cards from a 52-card grid, or explicitly confirm pulling a card from another hand into the selected hand;
  - `Swap`: swap selected hand with another seat;
  - `I'm sure`: move a rejected duplicate card from previous seat to selected seat;
  - `Clear`: context-sensitive selected-hand clear or whole-board clear confirmation.
  
  ## PBN, Double Dummy, and TNT
  
  PBN export is gated on scanned boards: four 13-card hands and 52 unique cards.
  
  Current MVP PBN board blocks intentionally emit neither `[Event "..."]` nor `[Site "..."]`.
  
  TD overview cumulative export includes scanned visible boards only, sorted by board number. It can be shared via Android share intent or saved locally as a `.pbn` file using the Android Storage Access Framework.
  
  TD import accepts complete PBN blocks numbered `1..39`, ignores unsupported/partial blocks, and expands the visible board grid to fit valid imported boards. Import preserves double-dummy solver metadata for later export. When imported data contains an `OptimumResultTable`, a scanned board presents that analysis directly in a tablet-readable table.
  
  `BoardProgressSummary.boardScanned` means physical capture/export readiness. `BoardEditState.isTntReady` means scanned + optimum table + derived TNT model; the overview presents that as Complete/TNT-ready.
  
  ## Impression direction
  
  `dev/impression` explores a retained-scene cognition road between frozen Snap and later feature-complete work.
  
  Impression keeps ordinary Stream alive. It does not create a new feed mode and does not use Snap's many-card candidate finder/decoder.
  
  ```text
  live Stream recognition
  -> reducer says ADDED
  -> Main reserves next-frame Impression capture
  -> Analyzer copies SAA/SAB luma from that next frame
  -> BeetleMind retains the Impression and selects Food
  -> BSR may grant bounded Dreams while foreground Stream keeps priority
  -> BCP supplies retained-Food Bite views through the ordinary FOF seam
  -> Dream results return to BSR for reflection/adaptation
  ```
  
  Shared design terminology lives in [`I-vocabulary.md`](phases/I-vocabulary.md).
  The short product-context meanings are:
  
  - **SAA / SAB**: retained grayscale scene reservoirs above/below the slit — the
    wider remembered “postcards”.
  - **Food**: a narrow retained corridor selected from SAA or SAB for later
    cognition; Food is larger than one Bite or one Dream.
  - **Bite**: one exact rectangular Food view supplied to one FOF attempt and
    shown by the white outline in Open Mind.
  - **Chewing**: local repeated examination only after a Bite shows a barcode or
    at least something worth chewing according to the active DreamGenre. The
    intended design uses nearby overlapping Bite views, typically shifted by
    about one pixel, rather than repeating the exact same crop and giving a mixed
    partial-barcode artifact a backdoor through consensus.
  - **Dream**: one BSR-granted bounded chapter of retained-Food cognition.
    `Dream` replaces `movie` in preferred design prose.
  - **DreamGenre**: the strategy by which one Dream chooses and explores Food;
    this is the design-vocabulary successor to `MovieGenre`.
  - **Cinema**: the larger procession of Dreams. Successive Dreams do not have to
    inspect adjacent Food locations; BSR may reflect on each Dream result before
    deciding what happens next.
  - **Open Mind**: the TD-side cognition aquarium exposing live ROI preview,
    retained postcards, selected-source outline, Food, current Bite, and
    Snippets while the Beetle remains impressed.
  - **ActiveBoardView**: a tiny Impression-scoped cognitive copy of board number,
    target seat, and four hands. It is not a full `BoardEditState` replica.
  - **FOF**: foreground-feeding recognition seam reused for both live evidence and
    retained-Food Bite views.
  - **BSR / BCP**: Beetle Self-Reflection deliberation/attention policy and the
    retained-Food execution process used inside granted Dreams.
  
  The landed I-06 implementation still represents one Dream as repeated FOF
  attempts on one stable Bite. That is current implementation/history truth. The
  newer vocabulary intentionally records the next design direction: a Dream is a
  bounded chapter; Chewing, when warranted, should use nearby overlapping shifted
  Bites so consensus sees changing geometric evidence. I-08b and later focused
  work own that migration rather than silently rewriting completed I-06 history.
  
  The product value of Impression is not “read many cards heroically.” It is “let the beetle remember and inspect a recent scene while the TD remains in ordinary Stream.”
  
  ## P2 pulse and resource grounding
  
  Physical SM-T350 testing found that becoming impressed can cause a visible pulse: SPS drops, preview behavior appears disturbed, and recovery may take around two seconds. The docs deliberately do not claim that app work changes camera focus; they claim an Impression-correlated processing shock.
  
  P2 measures and reduces that shock before deeper cognition resumes.
  
  The completed pulse, single-copy, grounded-resource foundation, and telemetry
  slices are retained in
  [`P2 implementation history`](dev_history/optimizations/P2/README.md). Active
  P2 prose now carries only umbrellas and remaining field/later-I obligations.
  
  Current P2 work includes:
  
  - pulse recorder and compact IMP line;
  - shareable JSONL pulse log;
  - SM-T350 open/closed and repeated-reimpression baseline;
  - single-copy/owned-luma transfer work;
  - bounded SAA/SAB slots consumed by the TD Analyzer/Beetle ownership path;
  - a landed one-second **Love Blonds** Analyzer quiet after successful capture
    submission for densely adjacent barcodes;
  - Beetle-owned live and Food FOF completion telemetry through one combined
    internal-cinema SPS ingress.
  
  Resource principle:
  
  ```text
  Prepare, size, and stabilize large resources while grounded;
  do not ask for another wing during a difficult frame.
  ```
  
  ## Current state
  
  Grounded current state:
  
  - app has Main, TD, and Admin entry surfaces;
  - Admin::Edit can calibrate profiles from CameraX frames;
  - Admin resource calibration grounds the bounded Impression scene slots consumed by TD capture; remaining P2 tablet closeout evidence is folded into I-08;
  - shared camera/analyzer infrastructure uses neutral scanner boundaries;
  - `grid13-v2` preserves `bfm`/`brm` physical orientation;
  - built-in observed profile has complete 52-card coverage;
  - TD overview supports flexible board grid sizes and board-state colors;
  - TD import/export/share/save and DDS/TNT preservation/display work for the current milestone;
  - TD::EditBoard is live, with recovery controls for common field errors and physical-card failures;
  - TD::EditBoard translates resolved camera evidence into pure `BeetleMind` input, routes only typed accepted card scans to board mutation, and keeps unknowns in thought only;
  - Open Mind can expose retained Impression maps, Food, current Bite, and Snippets while ordinary Stream continues;
  - BSR and the first retained-Food BCP/FOF cinema run on the target SM-T350; the current I-08b design problem is continuing Food attention after a Dream completes while LIVE is quiet;
  - the current Thoughts surface does not yet refresh meaningfully while Beetle is dreaming; I-08c holds that observability design seed;
  - P2 diagnostic telemetry/logging/export is temporary profiling equipment, not final product UI.
  
  Non-urgent Phase A work will test and polish the
  [first-ever granted-permission calibration](phases/A-admin-calibrate-first-ever-polish.md)
  and the distinct
  [missing/denied/revoked-permission road](phases/A-admin-calibrate-missing-camera-permission.md)
  without weakening the calibration prerequisite.
  
  ## Development style
  
  Keep core logic pure and testable.
  
  Do not put Android UI, CameraX, or device-specific logic into the core package.
  
  Keep tickets temporary. When a ticket is done, absorb only durable product/architecture truth into current docs.
  
  Prefer current lean docs over historical ticket piles.
