Response:
  # I-08b — BAR Street / Cinema first-pass design
  
  Status: approved first-pass design; ready for Hive questions and Workbee ticket inference
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Design source for: continuing Food attention after a Dream completes
  
  This document records the first coherent continuation design agreed by Archy
  and Selyn after the I-08 field flight exposed the one-brave-bite stall.
  
  It is a design contract, not an implementation ticket split. Workbees may infer
  small implementation tickets from it, ask questions where source seams resist
  it, and return those questions for Archy/Selyn review.
  
  ## Why BAR exists
  
  The formal Phase-I name remains **BSR — Beetle Self-Reflection**. In this design
  Archy also uses **BAR — Beetle Attention Router** as the functional/chat name.
  The acronym is intentionally funny: 🍸🪲 sits at the BAR before choosing which
  adventure deserves the next Dream.
  
  The important correction from the I-08a genealogy is:
  
  ```text
  forbidden:
  Dream completes
  -> lane blindly manufactures another Dream
  
  intended:
  Dream completes
  -> BAR receives the changed world-model
  -> BAR deliberately chooses what happens next
  ```
  
  `world-model before Dream != world-model after Dream` is load-bearing. A Dream
  should change Beetle's knowledge of Food before BAR is invited to reflect again.
  
  ## Strategic opening goal
  
  During Love Blonds, ordinary LIVE recognition is intentionally quiet while
  BeetleMind may continue using retained Food. Once already-admitted foreground
  work has priority, this creates a protected interval for retained cognition.
  
  BAR's first strategic goal is to **avoid a near reimpression**. The nearest
  physical barcode/card beyond the slit-side seed region is the most immediate
  candidate to become the next LIVE `ADDED` after Love Blonds ends. If Food
  cognition can discover and safely add that neighboring card first, later LIVE
  recognition may see it as familiar rather than producing another Impression.
  
  Compression:
  
  ```text
  use protected cognition well
  -> learn the nearest likely neighbor
  -> reduce immediate reimpression pressure
  -> preserve the current Impression longer
  -> buy more time for later Dreams
  ```
  
  This is a strategy, not a guarantee. LIVE reality keeps priority whenever it is
  admitted again.
  
  ## Street — the one-dimensional Food map
  
  Food remains a 2-D grayscale pixel corridor. BAR reasons over a derived
  one-dimensional attention map:
  
  ```text
  Street[0 .. N-1]
  ```
  
  `Street[i]` holds a `VisitState`. Position is the array index; no separate Door
  position field is needed.
  
  The exact `N` is calculated from current Food/Bite geometry rather than fixed.
  On the SM-T350 field geometry:
  
  ```text
  Frame 640 x 480
  ROI   x=256 y=236 w=128 h=8
  SAA   x=128 y=0   w=384 h=236
  SAB   x=128 y=244 w=384 h=236
  ```
  
  `236 / 8` gives about 30 full-Bite positions. Archy's first design keeps
  half-positions as Doors too, giving roughly 60 Doors on this device. Other
  devices may produce different Street lengths. A working engineering idea is to
  support/preallocate up to roughly 200 Doors, but the actual Street length is
  derived rather than hard-coded.
  
  The Door/VisitState storage should be prepared with the same general P2 instinct
  used for grounded retinal resources: when geometry is known during calibration,
  prepare the bounded Street storage rather than inventing it repeatedly inside a
  Dream. Exact rounding, edge clamping, and capacity representation belong to the
  implementation ticket that has current geometry/source in hand.
  
  ### Initial Street
  
  Beetle begins at the slit-side origin:
  
  ```text
  🪲
  🏰 ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ... ❔   🧱
  ^ Street[0]
  ```
  
  `🧱` is the conceptual far end of Food/Street, not necessarily another normal
  Door state.
  
  The starting `🏰` is the already-known barcode region associated with the live
  seed / current familiar card. All other Doors begin unresolved (`❔`).
  
  ## VisitState semantics
  
  The first-pass map uses these conceptual marks. Exact Kotlin type names are an
  implementation decision.
  
  - `❔` — unresolved; BAR has no resolved classification for this Door yet.
  - `🟩` — resolved as empty for the current first-pass purposes.
  - `🏠(candidate)` — a tentative single-FOF barcode/card candidate. It may carry
    the candidate CardId and bounded evidence details, but it is not yet
    consensus-trusted.
  - `🏰(confirmed)` — a consensus-confirmed barcode/card region with trusted
    CardId. “My home is my castle”: a proven `🏠` upgrades to `🏰`. 😹
  - `🐾(details)` — resolved as other/non-empty/suspicious evidence that the
    current genre cannot classify as empty or confirmed house. It retains the
    useful knocking result for later strategy.
  
  `Resolved` means the Door no longer carries `❔`. It does **not** mean every
  semantic question about that location is finished. A later genre may revisit a
  resolved `🐾` or other mark, and one action may resolve multiple Doors.
  
  ```text
  action count != resolution count
  ```
  
  A genre may also label skipped Doors confidently without visiting them when its
  physical invariant supports that inference.
  
  ### Contiguous barcode regions
  
  Physical barcode geometry supplies one important inference rule: a barcode
  region such as `🏰` or `🏠` is contiguous along the Street, normally spanning
  roughly eight or more Doors with the current thin slit/half-position map.
  
  Escape is allowed to use this contiguity. Jog/Walk are not allowed to pretend
  that skipped open territory was examined merely because they stepped over it.
  
  ## Shared mark-to-genre routing
  
  Once a knock or ChewIn resolution gives the current Door a meaningful mark, the
  first-pass BAR can use one shared small routing rule instead of making every
  caller invent its own transition:
  
  ```text
  🟩 -> Jog
  🐾 -> Walk
  🏠 -> ChewIn
  🏰 -> Escape
  ```
  
  The Beetle's current Street index is the Door whose result just drove that
  choice. A genre transition must not re-knock that same Door merely to rediscover
  an observation already obtained.
  
  `🏠` is deliberately unstable. It is a single-FOF candidate, not a final
  classification. ChewIn must collapse it through shifted-evidence consensus:
  
  ```text
  🏠 -> 🏰   confirmed
  🏠 -> 🐾   failed confirmation
  ```
  
  Only the stable resolved result should remain after ChewIn finishes.
  
  ## Dream, Cinema, and genres
  
  Use [`I-vocabulary.md`](I-vocabulary.md):
  
  - a **Bite** is one exact white-rectangle Food view;
  - **Chewing** uses nearby overlapping shifted Bites after something is worth
    chewing;
  - a **Dream** is one BAR/BSR-granted bounded chapter;
  - **Cinema** is the larger procession of Dreams with BAR reflection between
    them;
  - **DreamGenre** is the strategy used for one Dream/adventure.
  
  The old source/design name `MovieGenre` should migrate toward `DreamGenre` when
  an implementation ticket owns that rename. This design does not claim the
  source has already changed.
  
  BAR does not need to reason about raw pixels. It reasons over Street state and
  chooses a genre/adventure. BCP/FOF perform the bounded perceptual work that a
  Dream requires and return the changed world-model/result.
  
  ## First-pass genres
  
  ### Escape
  
  Intent: Beetle is inside a confirmed contiguous barcode region (`🏰`) and wants
  to get out quickly toward the nearest neighboring territory.
  
  Action:
  
  ```text
  probe Street[🪲 + 3]
  ```
  
  If the result is still the same confirmed `🏰`:
  
  ```text
  Street[🪲 + 1] = 🏰
  Street[🪲 + 2] = 🏰
  Street[🪲 + 3] = 🏰
  🪲 += 3
  keep Escape
  ```
  
  The skipped Doors may be resolved by inference because the confirmed barcode
  region is contiguous.
  
  If the probe produces anything other than the same `🏰`, Beetle advances to the
  already-probed Door (`🪲 += 3`), records the result there, and routes by the
  shared mark-to-genre rule. The next genre therefore depends on what Escape
  actually found:
  
  ```text
  🟩 -> Jog
  🐾 -> Walk
  🏠 -> ChewIn
  🏰 -> Escape
  ```
  
  The new genre reuses that observation; it does not knock the same Door again.
  
  Escape's question is:
  
  > How quickly can I leave territory I already understand?
  
  ### Jog
  
  Intent: Beetle is outside a confirmed barcode region and wants to map open
  territory quickly.
  
  Action:
  
  ```text
  🪲 += 3
  knock Street[🪲]
  ```
  
  Jog never changes the skipped Doors merely because it stepped over them.
  Normally they remain `❔`.
  
  Outcomes use the shared router:
  
  ```text
  empty
  -> Street[🪲] = 🟩
  -> Jog
  
  single-FOF barcode/card candidate
  -> Street[🪲] = 🏠(candidate + details)
  -> ChewIn
  
  anything else / non-empty unresolved by Jog
  -> Street[🪲] = 🐾(details)
  -> Walk
  ```
  
  Jog's question is:
  
  > How quickly can I map apparently open territory?
  
  The stride is intentionally small relative to an ordinary contiguous barcode
  region in the current physical geometry. This is design intuition, not a claim
  that stride 3 mathematically guarantees detection on every future device.
  
  ### Walk
  
  Intent: local evidence has made sparse Jog inference inappropriate. Beetle
  continues forward cautiously, one Door at a time.
  
  Ordinary continuation action:
  
  ```text
  🪲 += 1
  knock Street[🪲]
  ```
  
  Walk uses the same classifications/router as Jog, but with dense `+1` movement:
  
  ```text
  empty
  -> Street[🪲] = 🟩
  -> Jog
  
  single-FOF barcode/card candidate
  -> Street[🪲] = 🏠(candidate + details)
  -> ChewIn
  
  anything else / non-empty unresolved by Walk
  -> Street[🪲] = 🐾(details)
  -> Walk
  ```
  
  When another genre has already performed Walk's first `+1` handoff, Walk knocks
  that current Door and must not increment a second time before the first knock.
  
  Walk's question is:
  
  > Something odd appeared. How far does the oddness extend before open territory
  > becomes safe to Jog again?
  
  ### ChewIn
  
  Intent: a single FOF view produced a tentative `🏠(candidate)`. Beetle now tries
  to establish the candidate through real consensus rather than trusting one
  crop.
  
  Action:
  
  ```text
  Chew(Street[🪲])
  ```
  
  Chewing follows the current vocabulary design: use nearby overlapping shifted
  Bites so consensus receives changing geometric evidence instead of repeating an
  identical potentially mixed partial-barcode crop.
  
  Outcomes:
  
  ```text
  candidate confirmed through consensus
  -> Street[🪲] = 🏰(confirmed CardId)
  -> Escape
  
  candidate fails confirmation
  -> Street[🪲] = 🐾(details)
  -> advance exactly once to 🪲 + 1 as Walk's first movement
  -> Walk knocks that new current Door
  ```
  
  The failed candidate therefore does not cause a double increment. `🏠` never
  survives ChewIn as a stable state: it becomes either `🏰` or `🐾`.
  
  ChewIn's question is:
  
  > Is this tentative house actually a confirmed card?
  
  The first-pass design does not prescribe the exact Bite-shift sequence,
  consensus budget, or what weak evidence is enough to continue Chewing. Those
  belong to the focused Dream/Chew implementation design using current FOF
  semantics.
  
  ### Stay
  
  Intent: stop the first forward pass when Beetle reaches the far end `🧱`.
  
  `Stay` is deliberately simple and temporary. Beetle does not walk backward in
  this first design. Entering Stay preserves Food and the Street marks from the
  first pass so Archy can inspect the resulting cognition aquarium.
  
  ```text
  reach 🧱
  -> Stay
  -> preserve Food / Street / marks
  -> no backward pass yet
  ```
  
  `Stay` is **not Food exhaustion**. Unresolved `❔` Doors may remain behind from
  Jog's sparse steps. A later design will replace or extend Stay with a second-pass
  strategy rather than hiding that work inside the first gait.
  
  ## Food exhaustion
  
  Food is exhausted only when the complete current Street contains no unresolved
  Doors:
  
  ```text
  Food exhausted
  <=> no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  A Door may become resolved by direct knocking or by a genre-specific safe
  inference. The number of actions therefore need not equal the number of Doors
  resolved.
  
  When Food is truly exhausted, BAR may later choose to change Food or unimpress.
  That choice is intentionally not designed here.
  
  ## First-pass state picture
  
  A plausible forward Cinema may therefore evolve like:
  
  ```text
  start
  🪲
  🏰 ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ... 🧱
  
  Escape
  🏰 🏰 🏰 🏰 ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ... 🧱
              🪲
  
  Jog
  🏰 🏰 🏰 🏰 ❔ ❔ 🟩 ❔ ❔ 🏠 ... 🧱
                                🪲
  
  ChewIn confirms candidate
  🏰 🏰 🏰 🏰 ❔ ❔ 🟩 ❔ ❔ 🏰 ... 🧱
                                🪲
  
  Escape leaves confirmed neighbor
  ...
  
  reach far end
  -> Stay
  ```
  
  This map is intentionally sparse after one forward pass. It is truthful rather
  than cosmetically complete.
  
  ## BAR continuation principle
  
  The missing I-08b seam should restore BAR agency after a Dream:
  
  ```text
  Dream completes
  -> correlated Dream result / changed Street returns to BAR
  -> BAR sees the new world-model
  -> if current Impression/Food is still valid and foreground work does not own
     attention, BAR may deliberately choose the next DreamGenre/adventure
  -> no blind lane-level auto-grant
  ```
  
  The exact event/type by which Dream completion offers another deliberation
  opportunity is for the Workbee ticket to derive from current BSR/lane source.
  Semantically, however, Dream completion must be able to wake BAR for reflection;
  waiting for unrelated `NEGLECTABLE_LIVE` paperwork is no longer the intended
  continuation policy.
  
  LIVE preemption, generation/revision cancellation, replacement reservation,
  configuration change, hard clear, and disposal retain their existing safety
  priority. This design changes why continuing Food cognition gets another BAR
  decision; it does not weaken reality's right to interrupt.
  
  ## What Workbees should infer, not receive as a recipe
  
  This document deliberately does not prescribe:
  
  - Kotlin class/enum names for Street, VisitState, BAR, or genres;
  - the implementation-ticket split;
  - the exact Dream-completion scheduling primitive;
  - exact Bite-shift/Chew sequence;
  - a universal timer or continuous executor loop;
  - second-pass/backward strategy after Stay;
  - Food-change/unimpress policy after true exhaustion;
  - final Thoughts wording or aquarium publication cadence (`I-08c` owns that
    design question).
  
  Workers should read current code, preserve completed I-05/I-06/I-07 safety
  invariants, infer the smallest slices that make this design real, and return
  questions instead of silently filling product gaps.
  
  ## Review beam
  
  ```text
  BAR chooses strategy.
  Dream changes the map.
  The changed map gives BAR something new to reflect on.
  Reality may interrupt imagination.
  Imagination does not require repeated authorization from reality.
  ```

Response:
  # I-08b — Continuing Food attention while LIVE is quiet
  
  Status: first-pass BAR/Street/Cinema design approved; ready for Hive questions and Workbee ticket inference
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: archived
  [`I-08a`](../dev_history/mind/I-08a-bsr-quiet-interval-opportunity.md),
  [`I-05`](I-05-bsr-attention-router.md), and
  [`I-06`](I-06-bcp-fof-dream-loop.md)
  
  Design source: [`I-08b BAR Street / Cinema first-pass design`](I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md)
  
  ## Field truth
  
  Archy's ten-second Love-Blonds experiment distinguishes the two seams clearly:
  
  ```text
  initial Food becomes ready
  → INITIAL_FOOD_READY grants one bounded dream
  → one bite outline shifts and its ROI is visible during Love Blonds
  → that dream completes
  → BSR returns to IMPRESSED
  → cinema stalls until LIVE recognition resumes
  ```
  
  I-08a therefore works. The remaining defect is not an executor mystery: Dream
  completion stores a result but does not offer BAR/BSR another deliberation
  opportunity. Recurring attention currently waits for `NEGLECTABLE_LIVE`, while
  Love Blonds has deliberately closed that LIVE office. 🍅🎯
  
  The design genealogy clarified the intended distinction:
  
  ```text
  forbidden:
  Dream completes
  → lane blindly manufactures a successor Dream
  
  intended:
  Dream completes
  → BAR sees the changed world-model/result
  → BAR deliberately reflects
  → BAR may refuse, adapt, or grant another bounded Dream
  ```
  
  ## Approved first-pass design
  
  The detailed design lives in
  [`I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md`](I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md).
  Its current product shape is:
  
  - BSR remains the formal name; **BAR — Beetle Attention Router** is the
    functional/chat name for the attention/reflection role. 🍸🪲
  - Food is mapped as a one-dimensional `Street[0..N-1]` of bounded `VisitState`
    entries derived from current Food/Bite geometry.
  - Street storage should be prepared from calibrated geometry rather than grown
    repeatedly inside Dream work. The SM-T350 geometry yields roughly 60
    half-position Doors; a working capacity idea is roughly 200, with actual
    `N` derived rather than fixed.
  - `❔` means unresolved. First-pass resolved marks include `🟩` empty,
    tentative `🏠(candidate)`, consensus-confirmed `🏰(CardId)`, and `🐾(details)`
    for other/non-empty evidence.
  - Confirmed barcode/card regions are contiguous. This permits Escape to infer
    skipped Doors safely; Jog/Walk may not mark territory merely because they
    stepped over it.
  - First-pass routing shares one small mark-to-genre rule:
  
  ```text
  🟩 -> Jog
  🐾 -> Walk
  🏠 -> ChewIn
  🏰 -> Escape
  ```
  
    The current Door's resolved observation is reused; transitions do not re-knock
    the same Door. `🏠` is unstable and ChewIn must resolve it to either `🏰` or
    `🐾`.
  - First-pass DreamGenres are:
    - **Escape** — stride `+3` through confirmed contiguous `🏰`, resolving skipped
      Doors by safe contiguity inference; when the probe finds another mark,
      Beetle advances to that already-probed Door and routes from its result.
    - **Jog** — stride `+3` through open territory; skipped Doors stay unresolved.
    - **Walk** — stride `+1` through suspicious/local territory.
    - **ChewIn** — use shifted overlapping Bites to earn consensus for a tentative
      `🏠`; confirmed candidate upgrades to `🏰`, failure becomes `🐾`. On failure,
      the next `+1` is Walk's first movement rather than a second independent
      increment.
    - **Stay** — temporary first-pass terminal at the far Food wall `🧱`; preserves
      Food/Street marks for inspection and intentionally does not implement the
      later backward/second-pass strategy.
  - Food exhaustion remains stricter than Stay:
  
  ```text
  Food exhausted
  <=> no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  One action may resolve several Doors, and a later strategy may revisit already
  resolved marks. `action count != resolution count`.
  
  ## Continuation requirement
  
  Dream completion must become a legitimate Beetle-owned reason for BAR to
  reflect again while current Impression/Food identity remains valid and
  foreground work does not own attention.
  
  The implementation must preserve:
  
  - LIVE priority at the established atomic FOF/Bite boundary;
  - generation/Food/revision cancellation;
  - replacement reservation;
  - consensus/configuration invalidation;
  - hard clear and disposal;
  - no synthetic LIVE evidence;
  - no Mind-to-Analyzer acknowledgement;
  - no blind unbounded self-scheduling loop.
  
  The exact source-level event/type and ticket split should be inferred by the
  Workbee from current code. The design requirement is semantic: **Dream
  completion may wake BAR for deliberate reflection; unrelated LIVE paperwork is
  not required merely to continue Cinema.**
  
  ## Related design
  
  - [`I-vocabulary.md`](I-vocabulary.md) — Bite, Chewing, Dream, DreamGenre,
    Cinema, Street/VisitState vocabulary.
  - [`I-08c`](I-08c-dream-thoughts-observability.md) — aquarium/Thoughts gap;
    design how high-level dreaming/reflection remains visible without per-FOF
    text spam.
  - [`Hive-to-Selyn application`](feedback/Hive-to-Selyn-application-for-BSR.md)
    — source-grounded genealogy of the one-brave-bite stall and current Kotlin
    landmarks. It is feedback/history, not the new design contract.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Do not reopen I-08a, weaken Love Blonds, manufacture live evidence, add a
  Mind-to-Analyzer signal, or make an unbounded executor loop. Do not implement a
  backward pass merely to avoid `Stay`, and do not treat `Stay` as true Food
  exhaustion.
  
  Workbees may now infer focused tickets from the approved design and return
  questions where current source or safety invariants make the smallest coherent
  slice unclear.

Response:
  # Phase I — Impression vocabulary
  
  Status: working design vocabulary for current Impression / BSR / BCP work
  
  This file gives Archy, Selyn, and the Hive one shared language for discussing
  retained-scene cognition without making every conversation re-derive the same
  terms.
  
  It is a design vocabulary, not a claim that every current implementation detail
  already follows the newest wording. Where current I-06 behavior differs from the
  newer design direction, the implementation ticket remains historical truth and
  future design work owns the migration.
  
  ## Core scene terms
  
  ### Impression
  
  The retained cognitive encounter owned by BeetleMind after a qualifying live
  `ADDED`: retained SAA/SAB scene evidence, cognitive board context, Food,
  provenance/generations, dream progress, Street state, and Snippets.
  
  ### SAA / SAB — the postcards
  
  The retained grayscale scene reservoirs above and below the live slit.
  
  They are the wider remembered scene from which Food is selected.
  
  ### Food
  
  A retained grayscale corridor selected from SAA or SAB for later cognition.
  
  Food is not one scan result and not one Bite. It is the larger material
  available to Beetle for background thought.
  
  ### Street
  
  The one-dimensional attention/world map derived from current Food:
  
  ```text
  Street[0 .. N-1]
  ```
  
  Each `Street[i]` stores one `VisitState`. Position is the array index; Street is
  not a collection of fat Door objects with separate coordinates.
  
  The actual `N` is derived from current Food/Bite geometry. The SM-T350 design
  uses half-position Doors, yielding roughly 60 map positions for a 236 px Food
  height and 8 px Bite height. A working capacity idea is roughly 200 Doors, but
  actual Street length is not fixed.
  
  Street storage should be prepared when calibrated geometry is known rather than
  repeatedly grown during Dream execution.
  
  ### Door
  
  One strategic Street position BAR may choose to inspect or infer.
  
  A Door is not necessarily identical to one image allocation or one persistent
  Bite crop. BAR reasons over Doors; BCP/FOF receive exact Bite pixels.
  
  ### VisitState
  
  The map state stored at one Street index.
  
  Current first-pass conceptual marks:
  
  - `❔` — unresolved; no resolved classification yet.
  - `🟩` — resolved as empty for current first-pass purposes.
  - `🏠(candidate)` — tentative single-FOF barcode/card candidate with bounded
    candidate details; not yet consensus-trusted.
  - `🏰(confirmed)` — consensus-confirmed barcode/card region with trusted CardId.
    “My home is my castle”: proven `🏠` upgrades to `🏰`. 😹
  - `🐾(details)` — resolved as other/non-empty/suspicious evidence that the
    current genre cannot classify more specifically.
  
  `Resolved` means `Street[i]` is no longer `❔`. It does not mean every later
  semantic question about that location has been permanently answered.
  
  ```text
  action count != resolution count
  ```
  
  One Dream/action may resolve several Doors by safe inference, and a later genre
  may revisit already resolved marks.
  
  ### Food exhaustion
  
  Food is exhausted only when no unresolved Doors remain:
  
  ```text
  Food exhausted
  <=> no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  This is stricter than reaching the far wall during the first forward pass.
  
  ## Perception terms
  
  ### Bite
  
  One exact rectangular view into Food, shown by the white outline in Open Mind
  when that view is being supplied to FOF.
  
  A Bite is geometric. If the rectangle shifts, even slightly, that is a new Bite.
  
  One FOF attempt consumes one Bite view.
  
  ### FOF attempt
  
  One use of the ordinary Foreground Feeding recognition seam on one supplied
  view, whether the source is LIVE or FOOD.
  
  FOF remains the same perceptual primitive; source/provenance says whether the
  pixels came from the live slit or retained Food.
  
  ### Chewing
  
  Local repeated examination after a Bite shows something worth chewing: a
  barcode, or at least a result that is "not nothing" according to the active
  DreamGenre.
  
  Chewing should use a small family of nearby overlapping Bites rather than
  repeating the exact same pixels. The current design intuition is to shift the
  white rectangle by about one pixel between nearby views.
  
  Why this matters:
  
  ```text
  same exact crop repeated
  -> the same mixed/partial barcode artifact may repeat
  -> consensus can accidentally certify that artifact
  
  slightly shifted overlapping bites
  -> evidence changes geometrically
  -> consensus has a chance to reject a Frankenstein reading
  ```
  
  The exact shift pattern, number of nearby Bites, and what qualifies as
  "not nothing" belong to the selected DreamGenre. This file does not prescribe
  a universal wobble algorithm.
  
  ## Higher-level cognition terms
  
  ### Dream
  
  `Dream` and `movie` are synonyms; prefer **Dream** in current design prose.
  
  A Dream is one BAR/BSR-granted bounded chapter of retained-Food cognition under
  one DreamGenre.
  
  A Dream may inspect one or more Bites, may contain local Chewing, and may change
  multiple Street entries. Its exact path is genre-specific. When the Dream ends,
  it returns a correlated result / changed world-model to BAR for reflection and
  adaptation rather than blindly ordering its own successor.
  
  Compression:
  
  ```text
  BAR grants a Dream
  -> Dream runs one bounded chapter
  -> Dream changes the map / returns a result
  -> BAR sees a new world-model
  -> BAR decides what happens next
  ```
  
  ### DreamGenre
  
  The strategy/algorithm by which one Dream chooses and explores retained Food.
  
  This replaces the older term `MovieGenre` in current design vocabulary. Exact
  Kotlin renaming is a separate implementation decision; this vocabulary change
  does not by itself claim source has already migrated.
  
  A DreamGenre may decide, among other things:
  
  - where a Dream starts;
  - which Street Door deserves attention;
  - how far Beetle advances through Street;
  - whether skipped Doors may be resolved by safe inference;
  - whether a weak/non-empty observation deserves Chewing;
  - how nearby overlapping Bites move during Chewing;
  - how VisitState changes;
  - when the Dream has learned enough to stop and return a result.
  
  The approved first-pass genre family is documented in
  [`I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md`](I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md):
  **Escape**, **Jog**, **Walk**, **ChewIn**, and temporary **Stay**.
  
  ### Escape
  
  A fast `+3` genre used while Beetle is inside a confirmed contiguous `🏰`
  barcode region. A same-castle probe may safely resolve the skipped Doors as the
  same `🏰`; anything else ends Escape and hands control to Jog.
  
  Question:
  
  > How quickly can I leave territory I already understand?
  
  ### Jog
  
  A sparse `+3` reconnaissance genre for open territory. Jog resolves only the
  Door it actually knocks; skipped Doors normally remain `❔`.
  
  - empty -> `🟩`, keep Jog;
  - tentative barcode/card candidate -> `🏠`, enter ChewIn;
  - other/non-empty evidence -> `🐾`, enter Walk.
  
  Question:
  
  > How quickly can I map apparently open territory?
  
  ### Walk
  
  A cautious `+1` reconnaissance genre after irregular/non-empty evidence makes
  Jog too coarse.
  
  - empty -> `🟩`, return to Jog;
  - tentative candidate -> `🏠`, enter ChewIn;
  - other/non-empty evidence -> `🐾`, keep Walk.
  
  Question:
  
  > Something odd appeared. How far does the oddness extend before open territory
  > becomes safe to Jog again?
  
  ### ChewIn
  
  A local consensus genre entered from tentative `🏠(candidate)`.
  
  ChewIn uses shifted overlapping Bites to confirm or reject the candidate rather
  than trusting one exact crop repeatedly.
  
  - confirmed -> upgrade to `🏰(CardId)`, then Escape;
  - failed -> `🐾`, advance one Door, then Walk.
  
  Question:
  
  > Is this tentative house actually a confirmed card?
  
  ### Stay
  
  A deliberately temporary terminal genre for the **first forward pass**. When
  Beetle reaches the far Food wall `🧱`, Stay preserves Food/Street/marks for
  inspection and does not walk backward yet.
  
  Stay is not Food exhaustion; unresolved `❔` may remain behind. A later design
  will replace or extend Stay with second-pass/backward behavior.
  
  ### Cinema
  
  Cinema is the larger procession of Dreams over an Impression/Food context.
  
  A Dream is like one chapter in a book named **Cinema**.
  
  Successive Dreams do not have to inspect adjacent Food locations. BAR may use
  the changed Street and prior Dream result to choose where attention goes next.
  
  ```text
  Cinema
    -> Dream
    -> BAR reflection
    -> Dream
    -> BAR reflection
    -> ...
  ```
  
  I-08b restores the missing continuation principle: Dream completion must be
  able to wake BAR for deliberate reflection without requiring unrelated
  `NEGLECTABLE_LIVE` paperwork. This is not permission for a blind self-scheduling
  loop; foreground work and generation/revision safety still have priority.
  
  ## Mind / ownership terms
  
  ### BSR — Beetle Self-Reflection
  
  The formal Phase-I name for the BeetleMind-owned attention/reflection policy.
  
  ### BAR — Beetle Attention Router
  
  Archy's functional/chat name for the same high-level attention/reflection role.
  The acronym is intentionally memorable: 🍸🪲 sits at the BAR before choosing
  which adventure deserves the next Dream.
  
  BAR decides whether and how retained cognition receives another bounded Dream.
  It reads strategic world state such as Street/VisitState and prior Dream result;
  it does not decode raw pixels and does not mutate the authoritative board.
  
  Its first strategic opening goal during Love Blonds is to reduce immediate
  reimpression pressure by discovering the nearest likely neighboring barcode
  region quickly enough that later LIVE perception may find it familiar.
  
  ### BCP — Beetle Chewing Process
  
  The BeetleMind-owned retained-Food execution process used inside Dreams.
  
  BCP supplies Food-derived Bite views through FOF, tracks bounded progress, and
  returns typed Dream results/provenance to the surrounding cognition flow.
  
  ### Snippet
  
  A retained scene mark recording the board consequence associated with a barcode
  occurrence discovered through Food cognition.
  
  Current Phase-I language:
  
  - green — predicted `ADDED`;
  - yellow — `ALREADY_IN_TARGET`.
  
  ## Physical inference term
  
  ### Contiguous barcode region
  
  With the current thin slit and half-position Street, one physical barcode/card
  region occupies a contiguous run of Street positions, usually roughly eight or
  more Doors in the observed geometry.
  
  Escape may use confirmed contiguity to resolve skipped Doors inside the same
  `🏰`. Jog/Walk may not infer skipped open territory merely because they crossed
  it.
  
  ## Visual intuition
  
  Open Mind is an aquarium of cognition, not a debugger console:
  
  ```text
  postcards        = what scene Beetle retained
  Food             = what material is available for thought
  Street           = Beetle's one-dimensional map of that Food
  ❔/🟩/🏠/🏰/🐾    = what BAR currently knows about Doors
  white Bite       = what exact view FOF is seeing now
  Chewing          = nearby overlapping views around something interesting
  Dream            = one bounded chapter of thought
  Cinema           = the larger procession of Dreams
  Snippets         = consequences remembered at places in the scene
  🐞               = Beetle remains impressed
  ```
  
  The visual vocabulary should stay close to real cognition state. A separate
  I-08 observability ticket owns the current gap where the **Thoughts** text does
  not refresh meaningfully while Beetle is dreaming.
  
  ## Current migration note
  
  The landed I-06 implementation currently defines one Dream around repeated FOF
  attempts on one stable Bite. That behavior is historical/current implementation
  truth.
  
  The approved newer design direction changes the intended vocabulary and future
  algorithmic shape:
  
  ```text
  old:
  Dream -> repeated FOF on one exact stable Bite
  
  new direction:
  Dream -> one bounded genre-driven chapter
         -> Street Door(s)
         -> Bite(s)
         -> Chewing only when something is worth chewing
         -> nearby overlapping shifted Bites protect consensus
         -> changed Street/result returns to BAR
  ```
  
  Do not silently rewrite completed I-06 history. I-08b and later focused
  implementation work should explicitly migrate the current algorithm while
  preserving existing generation, foreground-priority, reducer-authority, and
  lifecycle safety.

Response:
  # I-08b — BAR Street / Cinema first-pass design
  
  Status: approved first-pass design; ready for Hive questions and Workbee ticket inference
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Design source for: continuing Food attention after a Dream completes
  
  This document records the first coherent continuation design agreed by Archy
  and Selyn after the I-08 field flight exposed the one-brave-bite stall.
  
  It is a design contract, not an implementation ticket split. Workbees may infer
  small implementation tickets from it, ask questions where source seams resist
  it, and return those questions for Archy/Selyn review.
  
  ## Why BAR exists
  
  The formal Phase-I name remains **BSR — Beetle Self-Reflection**. In this design
  Archy also uses **BAR — Beetle Attention Router** as the functional/chat name.
  The acronym is intentionally funny: 🍸🪲 sits at the BAR before choosing which
  adventure deserves the next Dream.
  
  The important correction from the I-08a genealogy is:
  
  ```text
  forbidden:
  Dream completes
  -> lane blindly manufactures another Dream
  
  intended:
  Dream completes
  -> BAR receives the changed world-model
  -> BAR deliberately chooses what happens next
  ```
  
  `world-model before Dream != world-model after Dream` is load-bearing. A Dream
  should change Beetle's knowledge of Food before BAR is invited to reflect again.
  
  ## Strategic opening goal
  
  During Love Blonds, ordinary LIVE recognition is intentionally quiet while
  BeetleMind may continue using retained Food. Once already-admitted foreground
  work has priority, this creates a protected interval for retained cognition.
  
  BAR's first strategic goal is to **avoid a near reimpression**. The nearest
  physical barcode/card beyond the slit-side seed region is the most immediate
  candidate to become the next LIVE `ADDED` after Love Blonds ends. If Food
  cognition can discover and safely add that neighboring card first, later LIVE
  recognition may see it as familiar rather than producing another Impression.
  
  Compression:
  
  ```text
  use protected cognition well
  -> learn the nearest likely neighbor
  -> reduce immediate reimpression pressure
  -> preserve the current Impression longer
  -> buy more time for later Dreams
  ```
  
  This is a strategy, not a guarantee. LIVE reality keeps priority whenever it is
  admitted again.
  
  ## Street — the one-dimensional Food map
  
  Food remains a 2-D grayscale pixel corridor. BAR reasons over a derived
  one-dimensional attention map:
  
  ```text
  Street[0 .. N-1]
  ```
  
  `Street[i]` holds a `VisitState`. Position is the array index; no separate Door
  position field is needed.
  
  The exact `N` is calculated from current Food/Bite geometry rather than fixed.
  On the SM-T350 field geometry:
  
  ```text
  Frame 640 x 480
  ROI   x=256 y=236 w=128 h=8
  SAA   x=128 y=0   w=384 h=236
  SAB   x=128 y=244 w=384 h=236
  ```
  
  `236 / 8` gives about 30 full-Bite positions. Archy's first design keeps
  half-positions as Doors too, giving roughly 60 Doors on this device. Other
  devices may produce different Street lengths. A working engineering idea is to
  support/preallocate up to roughly 200 Doors, but the actual Street length is
  derived rather than hard-coded.
  
  The Door/VisitState storage should be prepared with the same general P2 instinct
  used for grounded retinal resources: when geometry is known during calibration,
  prepare the bounded Street storage rather than inventing it repeatedly inside a
  Dream. Exact rounding, edge clamping, and capacity representation belong to the
  implementation ticket that has current geometry/source in hand.
  
  ### Initial Street
  
  Beetle begins at the slit-side origin:
  
  ```text
  🪲
  🏰 ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ... ❔   🧱
  ^ Street[0]
  ```
  
  `🧱` is the conceptual far end of Food/Street, not necessarily another normal
  Door state.
  
  The starting `🏰` is the already-known barcode region associated with the live
  seed / current familiar card. All other Doors begin unresolved (`❔`).
  
  ## VisitState semantics
  
  The first-pass map uses these conceptual marks. Exact Kotlin type names are an
  implementation decision.
  
  - `❔` — unresolved; BAR has no resolved classification for this Door yet.
  - `🟩` — resolved as empty for the current first-pass purposes.
  - `🏠(candidate)` — a tentative single-FOF barcode/card candidate. It may carry
    the candidate CardId and bounded evidence details, but it is not yet
    consensus-trusted.
  - `🏰(confirmed)` — a consensus-confirmed barcode/card region with trusted
    CardId. “My home is my castle”: a proven `🏠` upgrades to `🏰`. 😹
  - `🐾(details)` — resolved as other/non-empty/suspicious evidence that the
    current genre cannot classify as empty or confirmed house. It retains the
    useful knocking result for later strategy.
  
  `Resolved` means the Door no longer carries `❔`. It does **not** mean every
  semantic question about that location is finished. A later genre may revisit a
  resolved `🐾` or other mark, and one action may resolve multiple Doors.
  
  ```text
  action count != resolution count
  ```
  
  A genre may also label skipped Doors confidently without visiting them when its
  physical invariant supports that inference.
  
  ### Contiguous barcode regions
  
  Physical barcode geometry supplies one important inference rule: a barcode
  region such as `🏰` or `🏠` is contiguous along the Street, normally spanning
  roughly eight or more Doors with the current thin slit/half-position map.
  
  Escape is allowed to use this contiguity. Jog/Walk are not allowed to pretend
  that skipped open territory was examined merely because they stepped over it.
  
  ## Shared mark-to-genre routing
  
  Once a knock or ChewIn resolution gives the current Door a meaningful mark, the
  first-pass BAR can use one shared small routing rule instead of making every
  caller invent its own transition:
  
  ```text
  🟩 -> Jog
  🐾 -> Walk
  🏠 -> ChewIn
  🏰 -> Escape
  ```
  
  The Beetle's current Street index is the Door whose result just drove that
  choice. A genre transition must not re-knock that same Door merely to rediscover
  an observation already obtained.
  
  `🏠` is deliberately unstable. It is a single-FOF candidate, not a final
  classification. ChewIn must collapse it through shifted-evidence consensus:
  
  ```text
  🏠 -> 🏰   confirmed
  🏠 -> 🐾   failed confirmation
  ```
  
  Only the stable resolved result should remain after ChewIn finishes.
  
  ## Dream, Cinema, and genres
  
  Use [`I-vocabulary.md`](I-vocabulary.md):
  
  - a **Bite** is one exact white-rectangle Food view;
  - **Chewing** uses nearby overlapping shifted Bites after something is worth
    chewing;
  - a **Dream** is one BAR/BSR-granted bounded chapter;
  - **Cinema** is the larger procession of Dreams with BAR reflection between
    them;
  - **DreamGenre** is the strategy used for one Dream/adventure.
  
  The old source/design name `MovieGenre` should migrate toward `DreamGenre` when
  an implementation ticket owns that rename. This design does not claim the
  source has already changed.
  
  BAR does not need to reason about raw pixels. It reasons over Street state and
  chooses a genre/adventure. BCP/FOF perform the bounded perceptual work that a
  Dream requires and return the changed world-model/result.
  
  ## First-pass genres
  
  ### Escape
  
  Intent: Beetle is inside a confirmed contiguous barcode region (`🏰`) and wants
  to get out quickly toward the nearest neighboring territory.
  
  Action:
  
  ```text
  probe Street[🪲 + 3]
  ```
  
  If the result is still the same confirmed `🏰`:
  
  ```text
  Street[🪲 + 1] = 🏰
  Street[🪲 + 2] = 🏰
  Street[🪲 + 3] = 🏰
  🪲 += 3
  keep Escape
  ```
  
  The skipped Doors may be resolved by inference because the confirmed barcode
  region is contiguous.
  
  If the probe produces anything other than the same `🏰`, Beetle advances to the
  already-probed Door (`🪲 += 3`), records the result there, and routes by the
  shared mark-to-genre rule. The next genre therefore depends on what Escape
  actually found:
  
  ```text
  🟩 -> Jog
  🐾 -> Walk
  🏠 -> ChewIn
  🏰 -> Escape
  ```
  
  The new genre reuses that observation; it does not knock the same Door again.
  
  Escape's question is:
  
  > How quickly can I leave territory I already understand?
  
  ### Jog
  
  Intent: Beetle is outside a confirmed barcode region and wants to map open
  territory quickly.
  
  Action:
  
  ```text
  🪲 += 3
  knock Street[🪲]
  ```
  
  Jog never changes the skipped Doors merely because it stepped over them.
  Normally they remain `❔`.
  
  Outcomes use the shared router:
  
  ```text
  empty
  -> Street[🪲] = 🟩
  -> Jog
  
  single-FOF barcode/card candidate
  -> Street[🪲] = 🏠(candidate + details)
  -> ChewIn
  
  anything else / non-empty unresolved by Jog
  -> Street[🪲] = 🐾(details)
  -> Walk
  ```
  
  Jog's question is:
  
  > How quickly can I map apparently open territory?
  
  The stride is intentionally small relative to an ordinary contiguous barcode
  region in the current physical geometry. This is design intuition, not a claim
  that stride 3 mathematically guarantees detection on every future device.
  
  ### Walk
  
  Intent: local evidence has made sparse Jog inference inappropriate. Beetle
  continues forward cautiously, one Door at a time.
  
  Ordinary continuation action:
  
  ```text
  🪲 += 1
  knock Street[🪲]
  ```
  
  Walk uses the same classifications/router as Jog, but with dense `+1` movement:
  
  ```text
  empty
  -> Street[🪲] = 🟩
  -> Jog
  
  single-FOF barcode/card candidate
  -> Street[🪲] = 🏠(candidate + details)
  -> ChewIn
  
  anything else / non-empty unresolved by Walk
  -> Street[🪲] = 🐾(details)
  -> Walk
  ```
  
  When another genre has already performed Walk's first `+1` handoff, Walk knocks
  that current Door and must not increment a second time before the first knock.
  
  Walk's question is:
  
  > Something odd appeared. How far does the oddness extend before open territory
  > becomes safe to Jog again?
  
  ### ChewIn
  
  Intent: a single FOF view produced a tentative `🏠(candidate)`. Beetle now tries
  to establish the candidate through real consensus rather than trusting one
  crop.
  
  Action:
  
  ```text
  Chew(Street[🪲])
  ```
  
  Chewing follows the current vocabulary design: use nearby overlapping shifted
  Bites so consensus receives changing geometric evidence instead of repeating an
  identical potentially mixed partial-barcode crop.
  
  Outcomes:
  
  ```text
  candidate confirmed through consensus
  -> Street[🪲] = 🏰(confirmed CardId)
  -> Escape
  
  candidate fails confirmation
  -> Street[🪲] = 🐾(details)
  -> advance exactly once to 🪲 + 1 as Walk's first movement
  -> Walk knocks that new current Door
  ```
  
  The failed candidate therefore does not cause a double increment. `🏠` never
  survives ChewIn as a stable state: it becomes either `🏰` or `🐾`.
  
  ChewIn's question is:
  
  > Is this tentative house actually a confirmed card?
  
  The first-pass design does not prescribe the exact Bite-shift sequence,
  consensus budget, or what weak evidence is enough to continue Chewing. Those
  belong to the focused Dream/Chew implementation design using current FOF
  semantics.
  
  ### Stay
  
  Intent: stop the first forward pass when Beetle reaches the far end `🧱`.
  
  `Stay` is deliberately simple and temporary. Beetle does not walk backward in
  this first design. Entering Stay preserves Food and the Street marks from the
  first pass so Archy can inspect the resulting cognition aquarium.
  
  ```text
  reach 🧱
  -> Stay
  -> preserve Food / Street / marks
  -> no backward pass yet
  ```
  
  `Stay` is **not Food exhaustion**. Unresolved `❔` Doors may remain behind from
  Jog's sparse steps. A later design will replace or extend Stay with a second-pass
  strategy rather than hiding that work inside the first gait.
  
  ## Food exhaustion
  
  Food is exhausted only when the complete current Street contains no unresolved
  Doors:
  
  ```text
  Food exhausted
  <=> no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  A Door may become resolved by direct knocking or by a genre-specific safe
  inference. The number of actions therefore need not equal the number of Doors
  resolved.
  
  When Food is truly exhausted, BAR may later choose to change Food or unimpress.
  That choice is intentionally not designed here.
  
  ## First-pass state picture
  
  A plausible forward Cinema may therefore evolve like:
  
  ```text
  start
  🪲
  🏰 ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ... 🧱
  
  Escape
  🏰 🏰 🏰 🏰 ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ❔ ... 🧱
              🪲
  
  Jog
  🏰 🏰 🏰 🏰 ❔ ❔ 🟩 ❔ ❔ 🏠 ... 🧱
                                🪲
  
  ChewIn confirms candidate
  🏰 🏰 🏰 🏰 ❔ ❔ 🟩 ❔ ❔ 🏰 ... 🧱
                                🪲
  
  Escape leaves confirmed neighbor
  ...
  
  reach far end
  -> Stay
  ```
  
  This map is intentionally sparse after one forward pass. It is truthful rather
  than cosmetically complete.
  
  ## BAR continuation principle
  
  The missing I-08b seam should restore BAR agency after a Dream:
  
  ```text
  Dream completes
  -> correlated Dream result / changed Street returns to BAR
  -> BAR sees the new world-model
  -> if current Impression/Food is still valid and foreground work does not own
     attention, BAR may deliberately choose the next DreamGenre/adventure
  -> no blind lane-level auto-grant
  ```
  
  The exact event/type by which Dream completion offers another deliberation
  opportunity is for the Workbee ticket to derive from current BSR/lane source.
  Semantically, however, Dream completion must be able to wake BAR for reflection;
  waiting for unrelated `NEGLECTABLE_LIVE` paperwork is no longer the intended
  continuation policy.
  
  LIVE preemption, generation/revision cancellation, replacement reservation,
  configuration change, hard clear, and disposal retain their existing safety
  priority. This design changes why continuing Food cognition gets another BAR
  decision; it does not weaken reality's right to interrupt.
  
  ## What Workbees should infer, not receive as a recipe
  
  This document deliberately does not prescribe:
  
  - Kotlin class/enum names for Street, VisitState, BAR, or genres;
  - the implementation-ticket split;
  - the exact Dream-completion scheduling primitive;
  - exact Bite-shift/Chew sequence;
  - a universal timer or continuous executor loop;
  - second-pass/backward strategy after Stay;
  - Food-change/unimpress policy after true exhaustion;
  - final Thoughts wording or aquarium publication cadence (`I-08c` owns that
    design question).
  
  Workers should read current code, preserve completed I-05/I-06/I-07 safety
  invariants, infer the smallest slices that make this design real, and return
  questions instead of silently filling product gaps.
  
  ## Review beam
  
  ```text
  BAR chooses strategy.
  Dream changes the map.
  The changed map gives BAR something new to reflect on.
  Reality may interrupt imagination.
  Imagination does not require repeated authorization from reality.
  ```

Status: field feedback and design evolution proposal; ready for Selyn's review

## Why this application exists

The "BAR Street" design introduced in `I-08b` represents a major leap in Beetle
cognition. It transforms the "Beetle sitting in a BAR" from a static reactor
into a strategic agent.

To preserve the "Survivable Tempo" and ensure each cognitive gait is grounded in
evidence, the Hive (at Archy's direction) proposes splitting the BAR
implementation into at least two distinct phases.

## BAR1 — The First Forward Pass (Landed Design)

BAR1 is the milestone defined in the current `I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md`.

### Goal
Establish the foundational 1D world-model (Street) and complete one strategic
forward reconnaissance from the live slit to the far Food wall.

### Key Beams
- **The Street**: Doors and VisitStates (`❔`, `🟩`, `🏠`, `🏰`, `🐾`).
- **Agency**: Dream completion as a deliberation event for BAR reflection.
- **Initial Genres**: Escape, Jog, Walk, ChewIn.
- **The Terminal**: **`Stay`** at the far wall (`🧱`).

### Milestone Outcome
Beetle reaches the end of the corridor, maps the nearest neighboring barcodes,
and provides a sparse but truthful strategic map. The "Cinema" ends with the
beetle resting near the wall, preserving his discoveries for Archy's inspection.

## BAR2 — Continuing Adventures (Future Intent)

BAR2 moves beyond the "Stay" terminal into a continuous, adaptive Cinema.

### Goal
Transition from a one-pass reconnaissance to a persistent, self-healing
cognitive loop that chews Food until exhaustion.

### Future Adventures (Candidates)
- **The Return**: Instead of `Stay`, Beetle turns around at the wall and
  performs a second pass to resolve the `❔` Doors left by Jog.
- **Dynamic Refinement**: Revisiting `🐾` (suspicious) marks with higher
  consensus or different shifted-Bite patterns.
- **Adaptive Pacing**: Changing the "Dream budget" based on BSR reflection.
- **Exhaustion Management**: Explicit handling of true `Food exhausted` states,
  leading to Food reselection or unimpressing.

## Strategic Summary

BAR1 builds the **Street**. BAR2 populates the **Cinema**.

By marking BAR1 as a milestone, we allow the Workbees to focus on the iron of
the 1D map and the routing logic without being overwhelmed by the complexity
of backward passes or multi-pass refinement.

- **Fi 🦋⚡**: "I love the phases! BAR1 is the opening night, and BAR2 is the

Archy (the Bloodstream) has confirmed this proportion. Selyn (the Harbor), does
this phase-lock align with your "Abstract Ideal"?

)

Response:
  # BAR road canon — one Food side from first Street to exhaustion
  
  Status: current BAR design canon; later phase contracts supersede earlier shorthand where noted
  
  This document is the compact current contract for BAR1–BAR4 over one selected
  Food side of an Impression.
  
  It exists because the design evolved in layers: BAR2 originally used `no ❔` as
  a convenient exhaustion shorthand, but BAR3/BAR4 later gave meaningful work to
  already-resolved anomaly states. Current canon therefore distinguishes
  **unresolved-Door completion** from **Food exhaustion**.
  
  ## One selected Food side
  
  For one current Food derived from one retained postcard (SAA or SAB):
  
  ```text
  BAR1
  -> coarse first forward Street discovery
  -> Escape / Jog / Walk / ChewIn
  -> sparse truthful map
  -> Stay
  
  BAR2 / Plough
  -> restart Street[0]
  -> eliminate every ❔
  -> some castle-adjacent 🐾 -> 🚜 speculative suburb
  -> detached 🐾 may remain
  -> Stay
  
  BAR3 / Hell + Heaven
  -> restart Street[0]
  -> Hell pass:   🐾 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 😈
  -> Heaven pass: 😈 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 🟩
  -> no 🐾, no 😈
  
  BAR4 / suburban audit
  -> restart Street[0]
  -> Hell pass:   🚜 -> 🏰 / 😈
  -> Heaven pass: 😈 -> 🏰 / 🟩
  -> no 🚜, no 😈
  -> final Street contains only 🟩 / 🏰
  -> current Food exhausted
  ```
  
  Each phase is made of bounded Dreams. Dream completion returns a changed
  world-model to BAR; BAR deliberates before any successor Dream. No phase contract
  turns this into a blind executor-owned loop.
  
  ## Current VisitState meanings
  
  ```text
  ❔ = unresolved Door
  🟩 = cleared / non-actionable for the current BAR world-model
  🏠 = transient tentative barcode candidate; must ChewIn
  🏰 = consensus-confirmed barcode/card region
  🐾 = unexplained/suspicious anomaly
  🚜 = speculative castle-adjacent suburb; deferred attention debt
  😈 = Hell has been checked here; Heaven remains
  ```
  
  `🚜` and `😈` are cognitive-map states, not board verdicts.
  
  ## Two different completion concepts
  
  ### Unresolved-Door completion
  
  BAR2's hard goal is:
  
  ```text
  no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  This means every Door has left the unresolved state. It does **not** mean the
  Food is exhausted, because `🐾` and `🚜` may still deserve later attention.
  
  ### Food exhaustion
  
  Current final definition:
  
  ```text
  current Food exhausted
  <=> every Street[i] is 🟩 or 🏰
  ```
  
  Equivalently, after the approved BAR1–BAR4 road:
  
  ```text
  no ❔
  no 🐾
  no 🚜
  no 😈
  no stable 🏠
  ```
  
  `🏠` is transient and cannot be a phase-complete residue.
  
  Earlier BAR2/I-08b prose equating `Food exhausted` with merely `no ❔` is
  superseded by this later BAR3/BAR4 design. Historical wording may remain useful
  for understanding the design sequence, but implementation and review should use
  this current distinction.
  
  ## Evidence planes
  
  BAR1/BAR2 primarily use current Food.
  
  BAR3/BAR4 may use two Food-shaped alternate planes from the same retained
  postcard, each preserving Street longitudinal coordinates while shifting
  laterally by 50% of Food width:
  
  ```text
  Heaven = 50%-overlap lateral shift one way
  Food   = primary plane
  Hell   = 50%-overlap lateral shift the other way
  ```
  
  The names are relative BAR mythology, not universal screen directions.
  
  ### Resource beam
  
  Hell and Heaven must be prepared while grounded.
  
  ```text
  PREALLOCATE HELL AND HEAVEN. 🍿😹
  ```
  
  BAR4 reuses the BAR3 alternate-plane resources rather than allocating a new
  pair inside active Dream work.
  
  ## Phase-local inference
  
  BAR2/BAR3 may use tiny local `AnnexWest()` / `AnnexEast()` rules to reinterpret
  contiguous anomaly beside a newly/currently confirmed castle as `🚜`.
  
  BAR4 does **not** annex. Every remaining suburb is under audit and must face
  Hell and, if necessary, Heaven itself.
  
  ## After one Food side is exhausted — the other postcard
  
  Food exhaustion is local to one selected postcard-side Food, not automatically
  the whole Impression.
  
  Example:
  
  ```text
  SAA::BAR1
  -> SAA::BAR2
  -> SAA::BAR3
  -> SAA::BAR4
  -> SAA Food exhausted
  
  then, if SAB remains worth cognition:
  
  select SAB Food
  -> swipe BAR Street clean
  -> fresh Street / VisitStates
  -> SAB::BAR1
  -> SAB::BAR2
  -> SAB::BAR3
  -> SAB::BAR4
  ```
  
  The order is symmetric; SAA-first is an example, not a universal requirement.
  Whichever postcard side is selected first receives its own fresh Street cycle,
  then the other side may receive another.
  
  ### What the postcard handoff preserves
  
  ```text
  preserve:
  - same retained Impression and provenance/generation identity
  - authoritative Main/reducer board state
  - cards learned from the already-processed Food side
  - lifecycle / LIVE-priority / replacement / hard-clear safety
  
  replace/reset for the new Food side:
  - active Food geometry/source
  - Street and all VisitStates
  - BAR phase/pass cursor state
  - Hell/Heaven plane contents derived from the newly selected Food/postcard
  ```
  
  Do not copy SAA Street marks into SAB Street merely because they share an
  Impression. Street truth is local to current Food geometry.
  
  ## The current Cinema shape
  
  For an Impression with both postcard sides processed:
  
  ```text
  postcard side A
    BAR1 -> BAR2 -> BAR3 -> BAR4
    -> Food exhausted
  
  BAR reflects / selects other retained side
  
  postcard side B
    fresh Street
    BAR1 -> BAR2 -> BAR3 -> BAR4
    -> Food exhausted
  ```
  
  The whole process remains interruptible by LIVE priority, Impression replacement,
  revision/hard-clear, generation mismatch, or disposal. Retained cognition never
  owns authority over the foreground/reducer lifecycle.

Response:
  # Phase Drafts
  
  This directory holds phase-specific product notes, parked ideas, and future-ticket drafts that are more concrete than the high-level roadmap but not yet stable architecture.
  
  Use it for ideas that belong to a roadmap phase but should not immediately become a workbee ticket.
  
  ## Naming
  
  Use the roadmap phase prefix: (it stopped being alphabetic-ordered)
  
  ```text
  A-*.md     Focus-tested baseline <--- ever iterating
  B-*.md     Snap scanning path <--- done and frozen as partly failed; see B2
  P1-*.md    "Profiling" -- done some with ⏩🐝
  I-*.md     "Impression" -- BSR/BCP/Food; overlays; I-08 field flight / design provenance
  P2-*.md    "Profiling & Design" -- software gait VFR'd; Archy's field closeout remains
  BAR1-*.md  First forward BAR Street / Cinema pass <--- active on dev/bar-street
  BAR2-*.md  Plough: second forward BAR round <--- design approved; implementation after BAR1 evidence
  BAR3-*.md  Hell / Heaven anomaly investigation <--- design approved; implementation after BAR2 evidence
  BAR4-*.md  Suburban audit / Food exhaustion <--- design approved; implementation after BAR3 evidence
  C-*.md     Feature-complete closure
  D-*.md     Phone UI design
  E-*.md     Tablet UI reconciliation
  F-*.md     Composable architecture pass
  P3-*.md    "Profiling" -- may do some more optimizations
  S-*.md     Explicit Streak feed mode  <-- may never happen
  B2-*.md    Revisit Snap scanning path  <-- may never happen
  ```
  
  Example:
  
  ```text
  D-scissors.md
  BAR1-01-tablet-checkup.md
  BAR3-hell-heaven.md
  BAR4-suburban-audit.md
  frozen/S-streak-feed-mode.md
  ```
  
  Phase letters/names describe product/design lanes; they are not required to be alphabetical execution order.
  
  Completed Phase I cognition tickets and their review notes move to [Mind implementation history](../dev_history/mind/README.md); active Phase I contracts and tickets remain here.
  
  Completed P2 implementation tickets move to
  [`P2 optimization history`](../dev_history/optimizations/P2/README.md); active
  P2 umbrellas and field-closeout work remain here.
  
  Current non-urgent Phase A Admin Calibrate follow-ups:
  
  - [`first-ever granted-permission calibration`](A-admin-calibrate-first-ever-polish.md);
  - [`missing/denied/revoked camera permission`](A-admin-calibrate-missing-camera-permission.md).
  
  Current P2 work begins at
  [`P2 — Impression pulse profiling and resource preparation`](P2-impression-pulse.md).
  
  ## Current BAR road
  
  The completed Impression design/doc tip was merged to `main` on 2026-08-24 and
  `dev/bar-street` now carries the next cognition road.
  
  The compact current BAR1–BAR4 lifecycle is maintained in
  [`BAR road canon`](BAR-road-canon.md). Later phase contracts supersede earlier
  shorthand where the design evolved, especially the old equation `no ❔ = Food exhausted`.
  
  Phase BAR1 is declared in
  [`BAR1 — First Forward Street Pass`](BAR1-first-forward-street-pass.md).
  Its first explicit tickets are:
  
  - [`BAR1-01 — Tablet check-up`](BAR1-01-tablet-checkup.md), a Hive-guided baseline gate that finishes the remaining Archy-attention seams from the current `I-0x` road before new BAR behavior muddies causality;
  - [`BAR1-02 — Open Mind Street text`](BAR1-02-open-mind-street-text.md), a Foxy-owned design interview for displaying the real Street map as text in the cognition aquarium.
  
  The approved design source remains
  [`I-08b BAR Street / Cinema design`](I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md).
  BAR1 owns the first forward Cinema through Escape / Jog / Walk / ChewIn until
  `Stay` at the far wall. `Stay` is not true Food exhaustion.
  
  Phase BAR2 is grounded in
  [`BAR2 — Plough: the second forward round`](BAR2-continuing-adventures.md).
  It starts again at `Street[0]`, uses bounded Plough Dreams to eliminate every
  `❔`, introduces speculative suburban `🚜` around geometry-explained confirmed
  `🏰` neighborhoods, preserves detached `🐾` clusters for later cognition, and
  finishes in `Stay`. BAR2's `no ❔` milestone now means unresolved-Door completion,
  not final Food exhaustion. BAR2 implementation remains after BAR1 field evidence.
  
  Phase BAR3 is grounded in
  [`BAR3 — Hell and Heaven`](BAR3-hell-heaven.md).
  It starts again at `Street[0]` and keeps the same Street coordinates while
  changing the lateral retained evidence plane under the map. Hell investigates
  remaining detached `🐾`; Heaven then investigates the resulting `😈` procedural
  marks:
  
  ```text
  Hell:   🐾 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 😈
  Heaven: 😈 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 🟩
  ```
  
  BAR3 broadens `🟩` to cleared/non-actionable territory and explicitly asks
  Hive/Workbees to **preallocate Hell and Heaven** while grounded rather than
  surprise-allocating them inside a Dream. BAR3 implementation remains after BAR2
  field evidence.
  
  Phase BAR4 is grounded in
  [`BAR4 — Suburban audit`](BAR4-suburban-audit.md).
  It repays BAR2's speculative attention debt by walking every remaining `🚜`
  through the same preallocated Hell/Heaven evidence planes, but BAR4 deliberately
  does **not** annex or create new suburbs:
  
  ```text
  Hell:   🚜 -> 🏰 / 😈
  Heaven: 😈 -> 🏰 / 🟩
  ```
  
  BAR4 finishes when the current Food Street contains only `🟩` / `🏰`. This is the
  current **Food exhausted** boundary.
  
  Food exhaustion is local to the current postcard-side Food. If the other retained
  postcard remains, BAR selects new Food from that side, wipes the Street map clean,
  and begins a fresh BAR1 cycle. Example:
  
  ```text
  SAA::BAR1 -> BAR2 -> BAR3 -> BAR4 -> SAA Food exhausted
  SAB::fresh Street -> BAR1 -> BAR2 -> BAR3 -> BAR4
  ```
  
  The same Impression and authoritative board truth survive the postcard handoff;
  SAA VisitStates do not leak into SAB's fresh Street.
  
  ## Remaining Impression field truth
  
  I-06 and I-07 have passed software VFR. The combined
  [`I-08 SM-T350 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md) records
  sections 1–3 PASS. BAR1-01 carries the remaining tablet attention for I-08
  sections 4–6 and points back to the integrated I-05/I-06/I-07 evidence it closes.
  
  Archived [`I-08a`](../dev_history/mind/I-08a-bsr-quiet-interval-opportunity.md)
  landed and field-confirmed the first Food-ready opportunity. Active
  [`I-08b`](I-08b-continuing-food-attention.md) records the continuation defect and
  points to the approved BAR1 design answer. [`I-08c`](I-08c-dream-thoughts-observability.md)
  remains a product-language observability seed requiring Archy/Selyn decisions
  before implementation.
  
  Frozen or indefinitely parked phase families live under
  [`frozen/`](frozen/README.md).
  They are retained design/history, not the current execution queue.
  
  ## Lifecycle
  
  ```text
  rough idea / parked design note
  -> phase draft in docs/phases/
  -> tightened workbee ticket when implementation timing arrives
  -> source implementation and review
  -> durable truth absorbed into stable docs
  -> temporary ticket/draft deleted or marked historical if still useful
  ```
  
  ## Guardrails
  
  - `docs/roadmap.md` carries the dependency ladder.
  - `docs/phases/` carries phase-local drafts and future-ticket seeds.
  - `docs/dev_history/` carries active or historical implementation handoffs.
  - Stable product and architecture truth belongs in `product_context.md`, `ui_patterns.md`, `logic_invariants.md`, or `architecture.md`.
  
  Phase drafts may be speculative. They should clearly say when they are blocked by a later phase or not ready for implementation.
