Response:
  # Phase I — Impression vocabulary
  
  Status: working design vocabulary for current Impression / BAR / BCP work
  
  This file gives Archy, Selyn, and the Hive one shared language for discussing
  retained-scene cognition without making every conversation re-derive the same
  terms.
  
  It is a design vocabulary, not a claim that every current implementation detail
  already follows the newest wording. Where current I-06 behavior differs from the
  newer design direction, the implementation ticket remains historical truth and
  future BAR work owns the migration.
  
  ## Core scene terms
  
  ### Impression
  
  The retained cognitive encounter owned by BeetleMind after a qualifying live
  `ADDED`: retained SAA/SAB scene evidence, cognitive board context, Food,
  provenance/generations, dream progress, Street state, and Snippets.
  
  ### SAA / SAB — the postcards
  
  The retained grayscale scene reservoirs above and below the live slit.
  
  They are the wider remembered scene from which Food and later alternate BAR
  evidence planes may be selected.
  
  A BAR Street belongs to the **currently selected postcard-side Food**. When one
  Food side is exhausted and BAR switches to the other postcard, the new Food gets
  a fresh Street; VisitStates from SAA do not leak into SAB or vice versa.
  
  ### Food
  
  A retained grayscale corridor selected from SAA or SAB for later cognition.
  
  Food is not one scan result and not one Bite. It is the larger material
  available to Beetle for background thought.
  
  Food exhaustion is local to the current selected postcard-side Food, not
  necessarily the whole Impression.
  
  ### Street
  
  The one-dimensional attention/world map derived from current Food:
  
  ```text
  Street[0 .. N-1]
  ```
  
  Each `Street[i]` stores one `VisitState`. Position is the array index; Street is
  not a collection of fat Door objects with separate coordinates.
  
  The actual `N` is derived from current Food/Bite geometry. The SM-T350 design
  uses half-position Doors, yielding roughly 60 map positions for a 236 px Food
  height and 8 px Bite height. A working capacity idea is roughly 200 Doors, but
  actual Street length is not fixed.
  
  Street storage should be prepared when calibrated geometry is known rather than
  repeatedly grown during Dream execution.
  
  ### Door
  
  One strategic Street position BAR may choose to inspect or infer.
  
  A Door is not necessarily identical to one image allocation or one persistent
  Bite crop. BAR reasons over Doors; BCP/FOF receive exact Bite pixels.
  
  ### VisitState
  
  The map state stored at one Street index.
  
  Current conceptual marks across BAR1–BAR4:
  
  - `❔` — unresolved; no resolved classification yet.
  - `🟩` — **cleared / non-actionable territory for the current BAR world-model**.
    Literal empty-looking evidence is one common path to `🟩`, but BAR3/BAR4 may
    also produce `🟩` after both approved alternate-plane hypotheses have been
    checked without recovering an actionable barcode. `🟩` is deliberate closure,
    not a claim that every sampled pixel was literally empty.
  - `🏠(candidate)` — tentative single-FOF barcode/card candidate with bounded
    candidate details; not yet consensus-trusted. It is intentionally unstable and
    cannot remain as a completed-phase residue.
  - `🏰(confirmed)` — consensus-confirmed barcode/card region with trusted CardId.
    “My home is my castle”: proven `🏠` upgrades to `🏰`. 😹
  - `🐾(details)` — resolved as other/non-empty/suspicious evidence not yet
    explained more specifically. After BAR2, remaining `🐾` should be detached
    anomaly clusters not touching ordinary castle/suburb territory.
  - `🚜(suburban)` — anomalous evidence spatially explained well enough as the
    optical/geometric neighborhood of a nearby confirmed `🏰`, commonly caused by
    a physically tilted barcode. `🚜` is BAR geography, not another card verdict,
    and does not mutate the board. BAR4 treats it as deferred attention debt to audit.
  - `😈(Hell checked)` — procedural memory: this location was investigated in the
    Hell alternate evidence plane and remained unresolved; Heaven is still worth
    trying. `😈` is not a card verdict and does not mean the pixels are intrinsically bad.
  
  `Resolved` means `Street[i]` is no longer `❔`. It does not mean every later
  semantic question about that location has been permanently answered.
  
  ```text
  action count != resolution count
  ```
  
  One Dream/action may resolve several Doors by safe inference, and a later genre
  may revisit already resolved marks.
  
  ### Unresolved-Door completion
  
  BAR2's hard map-completion milestone is:
  
  ```text
  no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  This means every Door has left the unresolved state. It does **not** mean the
  Food is exhausted, because later BAR phases may still investigate `🐾` and audit
  speculative `🚜`.
  
  ### Food exhaustion
  
  Current final definition:
  
  ```text
  current Food exhausted
  <=> every Street[i] is 🟩 or 🏰
  ```
  
  Equivalently, after BAR1–BAR4 there are no remaining `❔`, `🐾`, `🚜`, `😈`, or
  stable `🏠` entries.
  
  Earlier I-08b/BAR2 shorthand equating Food exhaustion with merely `no ❔` is
  superseded by the later BAR3/BAR4 design. See
  [`BAR-road-canon.md`](BAR-road-canon.md).
  
  ## Perception terms
  
  ### Bite
  
  One exact rectangular view into the active retained evidence plane, shown by the
  white outline in Open Mind when that view is being supplied to FOF.
  
  A Bite is geometric. If the rectangle shifts, even slightly, that is a new Bite.
  
  One FOF attempt consumes one Bite view.
  
  ### FOF attempt
  
  One use of the ordinary Foreground Feeding recognition seam on one supplied
  view, whether the source is LIVE or retained cognition evidence.
  
  FOF remains the same perceptual primitive; source/provenance says whether the
  pixels came from the live slit or retained Food / an approved alternate plane.
  
  ### Chewing
  
  Local repeated examination after a Bite shows something worth chewing: a
  barcode, or at least a result that is "not nothing" according to the active
  DreamGenre.
  
  Chewing should use a small family of nearby overlapping Bites rather than
  repeating the exact same pixels. The current design intuition is to shift the
  white rectangle by about one pixel between nearby views.
  
  Why this matters:
  
  ```text
  same exact crop repeated
  -> the same mixed/partial barcode artifact may repeat
  -> consensus can accidentally certify that artifact
  
  slightly shifted overlapping bites
  -> evidence changes geometrically
  -> consensus has a chance to reject a Frankenstein reading
  ```
  
  The exact shift pattern, number of nearby Bites, and what qualifies as
  "not nothing" belong to the selected DreamGenre. This file does not prescribe
  a universal wobble algorithm.
  
  ## Higher-level cognition terms
  
  ### Dream
  
  `Dream` and `movie` are synonyms; prefer **Dream** in current design prose.
  
  A Dream is one BAR/BSR-granted bounded chapter of retained-scene cognition under
  one DreamGenre.
  
  A Dream may inspect one or more Bites, may contain local Chewing, and may change
  multiple Street entries. Its exact path is genre-specific. When the Dream ends,
  it returns a correlated result / changed world-model to BAR for reflection and
  adaptation rather than blindly ordering its own successor.
  
  Compression:
  
  ```text
  BAR grants a Dream
  -> Dream runs one bounded chapter
  -> Dream changes the map / returns a result
  -> BAR sees a new world-model
  -> BAR decides what happens next
  ```
  
  ### DreamGenre
  
  The strategy/algorithm by which one Dream chooses and explores retained scene
  evidence.
  
  This replaces the older term `MovieGenre` in current design vocabulary. Exact
  Kotlin renaming is a separate implementation decision; this vocabulary change
  does not by itself claim source has already migrated.
  
  A DreamGenre may decide, among other things:
  
  - where a Dream starts;
  - which Street Door deserves attention;
  - which retained evidence plane supplies the current Bite;
  - how far Beetle advances through Street;
  - whether skipped Doors may be resolved by safe inference;
  - whether a weak/non-empty observation deserves Chewing;
  - how nearby overlapping Bites move during Chewing;
  - how VisitState changes;
  - when the Dream has learned enough to stop and return a result.
  
  The approved BAR1 genre family is documented in
  [`I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md`](I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md):
  **Escape**, **Jog**, **Walk**, **ChewIn**, and temporary **Stay**.
  
  BAR2 adds **Plough**; BAR3 adds the two-pass **Hell / Heaven** anomaly
  investigation; BAR4 reuses Hell/Heaven as a **suburban audit** over every
  remaining `🚜`.
  
  ### Escape
  
  A fast `+3` genre used while Beetle is inside a confirmed contiguous `🏰`
  barcode region. A same-castle probe may safely resolve the skipped Doors as the
  same `🏰`; anything else ends Escape and routes from the already-obtained mark.
  
  Question:
  
  > How quickly can I leave territory I already understand?
  
  ### Jog
  
  A sparse `+3` reconnaissance genre for open territory. Jog resolves only the
  Door it actually knocks; skipped Doors normally remain `❔`.
  
  - empty -> `🟩`, keep Jog;
  - tentative barcode/card candidate -> `🏠`, enter ChewIn;
  - other/non-empty evidence -> `🐾`, enter Walk.
  
  Question:
  
  > How quickly can I map apparently open territory?
  
  ### Walk
  
  A cautious `+1` reconnaissance genre after irregular/non-empty evidence makes
  Jog too coarse.
  
  - empty -> `🟩`, return to Jog;
  - tentative candidate -> `🏠`, enter ChewIn;
  - other/non-empty evidence -> `🐾`, keep Walk.
  
  Question:
  
  > Something odd appeared. How far does the oddness extend before open territory
  > becomes safe to Jog again?
  
  ### ChewIn
  
  A local consensus genre entered from tentative `🏠(candidate)`.
  
  ChewIn uses shifted overlapping Bites to confirm or reject the candidate rather
  than trusting one exact crop repeatedly.
  
  - confirmed -> upgrade to `🏰(CardId)`;
  - failed -> the calling DreamGenre decides the appropriate non-candidate state
    (`🐾`, `😈`, or `🟩` depending on the approved phase/pass contract).
  
  Question:
  
  > Is this tentative house actually a confirmed card?
  
  ### Plough 🚜
  
  The BAR2 second-forward-round DreamGenre.
  
  Plough starts again from `Street[0]`, moves west-to-east in Street terms, and
  uses the existing BAR1 map as an index rather than rediscovering coarse space.
  Its hard goal is to eliminate every `❔`. It also performs geometry-only local
  suburbanization:
  
  ```text
  castle-adjacent contiguous 🐾 -> 🚜
  ```
  
  using the bounded `AnnexWest()` / `AnnexEast()` rules in
  [`BAR2-continuing-adventures.md`](BAR2-continuing-adventures.md).
  
  A bounded Plough Dream has:
  
  ```text
  Knock   <= 1
  ChewIn  <= 1
  Street mutations = many
  ```
  
  ### Hell / Heaven 😈
  
  The BAR3 two-pass investigation for detached `🐾` anomaly clusters left after
  Plough.
  
  The Street coordinate system stays fixed while BAR changes the lateral retained
  evidence plane under it using Food-shaped regions from the same SAA/SAB
  postcard, each overlapping current Food by 50% of Food width:
  
  ```text
  Hell   = 50%-overlap shift to the right
  Heaven = 50%-overlap shift to the left
  ```
  
  BAR3 performs the whole Street through Hell first, then the whole Street through
  Heaven:
  
  ```text
  Hell pass:
  🐾 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 😈
  
  Heaven pass:
  😈 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 🟩
  ```
  
  Hell and Heaven resources should be prepared while grounded rather than
  surprise-allocated inside an active Dream. Full contract:
  [`BAR3-hell-heaven.md`](BAR3-hell-heaven.md).
  
  ### Suburban audit
  
  BAR4 reuses the preallocated Hell/Heaven planes to repay every remaining `🚜`
  speculation:
  
  ```text
  Hell pass:
  🚜 -> 🏰 / 😈
  
  Heaven pass:
  😈 -> 🏰 / 🟩
  ```
  
  BAR4 deliberately does **not** annex or create new suburbs. Every `🚜` is under
  audit and must face alternate-plane evidence itself. When BAR4 completes, the
  current Food Street contains only `🟩` / `🏰` and that Food is exhausted.
  
  Full contract: [`BAR4-suburban-audit.md`](BAR4-suburban-audit.md).
  
  ### Stay
  
  A deliberately temporary terminal genre used to preserve current retained
  Food/Street/marks at a phase boundary.
  
  BAR1 ends its first forward pass in Stay even though `❔` may remain. BAR2 also
  returns to Stay after Plough eliminates every `❔`. Later phase design may resume
  from the preserved world-model.
  
  Stay is a deliberate pause/phase boundary, not synonymous with Food exhaustion
  or final cognition.
  
  ### Cinema
  
  Cinema is the larger procession of Dreams over an Impression/retained-scene
  context.
  
  A Dream is like one chapter in a book named **Cinema**.
  
  Successive Dreams do not have to inspect adjacent locations. BAR may use the
  changed Street and prior Dream result to choose where attention goes next.
  
  ```text
  Cinema
    -> Dream
    -> BAR reflection
    -> Dream
    -> BAR reflection
    -> ...
  ```
  
  One selected postcard-side Food may run BAR1→BAR4 and become exhausted. BAR may
  then select Food from the other retained postcard, reset Street/VisitStates, and
  begin another BAR1→BAR4 sequence within the same Impression.
  
  I-08b restores the missing continuation principle: Dream completion must be
  able to wake BAR for deliberate reflection without requiring unrelated
  `NEGLECTABLE_LIVE` paperwork. This is not permission for a blind self-scheduling
  loop; foreground work and generation/revision safety still have priority.
  
  ## Mind / ownership terms
  
  ### BSR — Beetle Self-Reflection
  
  The formal Phase-I name for the BeetleMind-owned attention/reflection policy.
  
  ### BAR — Beetle Attention Router
  
  Archy's functional/chat name for the same high-level attention/reflection role.
  The acronym is intentionally memorable: 🍸🪲 sits at the BAR before choosing
  which adventure deserves the next Dream.
  
  BAR decides whether and how retained cognition receives another bounded Dream.
  It reads strategic world state such as Street/VisitState and prior Dream result;
  it does not decode raw pixels and does not mutate the authoritative board.
  
  Its first strategic opening goal during Love Blonds is to reduce immediate
  reimpression pressure by discovering the nearest likely neighboring barcode
  region quickly enough that later LIVE perception may find it familiar.
  
  ### BCP — Beetle Chewing Process
  
  The BeetleMind-owned retained-evidence execution process used inside Dreams.
  
  BCP supplies Bite views through FOF, tracks bounded progress, and returns typed
  Dream results/provenance to the surrounding cognition flow.
  
  ### Snippet
  
  A retained scene mark recording the board consequence associated with a barcode
  occurrence discovered through retained cognition.
  
  Current Phase-I language:
  
  - green — predicted `ADDED`;
  - yellow — `ALREADY_IN_TARGET`.
  
  ## Physical inference term
  
  ### Contiguous barcode region
  
  With the current thin slit and half-position Street, one physical barcode/card
  region occupies a contiguous run of Street positions, usually roughly eight or
  more Doors in the observed geometry.
  
  Escape may use confirmed contiguity to resolve skipped Doors inside the same
  `🏰`. Jog/Walk may not infer skipped open territory merely because they crossed
  it.
  
  Tilted/clipped barcodes may also create partial/wrong barcode-like observations
  around or beyond the trusted core. BAR2's `🚜`, BAR3's Hell/Heaven investigation,
  and BAR4's suburban audit are explicit world-model tools for handling those
  cases without weakening `🏰` consensus semantics.
  
  ## Visual intuition
  
  Open Mind is an aquarium of cognition, not a debugger console:
  
  ```text
  postcards              = what scene Beetle retained
  Food                   = the primary material available for thought
  Hell / Heaven          = alternate lateral retained evidence planes
  Street                 = Beetle's one-dimensional map for current Food
  ❔/🟩/🏠/🏰/🐾/🚜/😈    = what BAR currently knows about Doors
  white Bite             = what exact view FOF is seeing now
  Chewing                = nearby overlapping views around something interesting
  Dream                  = one bounded chapter of thought
  Cinema                 = the larger procession of Dreams
  Snippets               = consequences remembered at places in the scene
  🐞                     = Beetle remains impressed
  ```
  
  The visual vocabulary should stay close to real cognition state. A separate
  I-08 observability ticket owns the current gap where the **Thoughts** text does
  not refresh meaningfully while Beetle is dreaming. BAR1-02 separately owns the
  Open Mind textual Street presentation interview with Archy.
  
  ## Current migration note
  
  The landed I-06 implementation currently defines one Dream around repeated FOF
  attempts on one stable Bite. That behavior is historical/current implementation
  truth.
  
  The approved newer design direction changes the intended vocabulary and future
  algorithmic shape:
  
  ```text
  old:
  Dream -> repeated FOF on one exact stable Bite
  
  new direction:
  Dream -> one bounded genre-driven chapter
         -> Street Door(s)
         -> Bite(s)
         -> Chewing only when something is worth chewing
         -> nearby overlapping shifted Bites protect consensus
         -> changed Street/result returns to BAR
  ```
  
  Do not silently rewrite completed I-06 history. BAR implementation work should
  explicitly migrate the current algorithm while preserving existing generation,
  foreground-priority, reducer-authority, and lifecycle safety.

  # BAR1 — First Forward Street Pass
  
  Status: active phase on `dev/bar-street`
  
  Origin: approved [`I-08b BAR Street / Cinema design`](I-08b-bar-street-cinema-design.md)
  
  ## Goal
  
  Make the first BAR Street world-model real, observable, and field-grounded without pulling the later backward / multi-pass story into the same milestone.
  
  BAR1 proves one strategic forward Cinema from the slit-side seed region to the far Food wall:
  
  ```text
  known slit-side 🏰
  -> Street[0..N-1]
  -> BAR deliberation between Dreams
  -> Escape / Jog / Walk / ChewIn
  -> changed world-model after each Dream
  -> reach 🧱
  -> Stay
  -> preserve the sparse truthful Street for inspection
  ```
  
  BAR1 already contains **Cinema**. It is not merely Street storage. The phase ends when the first forward-pass milestone reaches `Stay`; it does not claim that Cinema, Food, or cognition are globally finished.
  
  ## Why BAR1 is separate
  
  The first pass is large enough to deserve its own physical evidence gate.
  
  It introduces or migrates several coupled concepts at once:
  
  - bounded Street storage derived from calibrated Food/Bite geometry;
  - `VisitState` marks (`❔`, `🟩`, tentative `🏠`, confirmed `🏰`, `🐾`);
  - BAR receiving a changed world-model after Dream completion and deliberately choosing again;
  - the shared mark-to-Genre router;
  - Escape, Jog, Walk, and ChewIn;
  - shifted overlapping Chewing where the selected Genre requires it;
  - a visible first-pass end at `Stay` while unresolved `❔` may remain behind.
  
  A tablet-observable BAR1 gives later design something real to react to instead of building the second pass on imagined Street behavior.
  
  ## Phase entry — BAR1-01
  
  Before new BAR Street implementation changes the baseline, Archy and Hive run [`BAR1-01 tablet check-up`](BAR1-01-tablet-checkup.md).
  
  That ticket gathers the remaining current-Impression field truth from the `I-0x` road and keeps old defects distinguishable from BAR1 regressions.
  
  ## Known BAR1 product/design work
  
  BAR1 currently declares two named tickets; Workbees may infer additional implementation slices from the approved design rather than receiving a complete pre-chewed ticket tree.
  
  1. [`BAR1-01 — Tablet check-up`](BAR1-01-tablet-checkup.md) — Hive-guided baseline closeout for the remaining Impression field evidence and Archy-attention seams.
  2. [`BAR1-02 — Open Mind Street text`](BAR1-02-open-mind-street-text.md) — Foxy-owned design interview for rendering the live Street map as text in Open Mind for debugging and enjoyment.
  
  The implementation decomposition for Street storage, BAR deliberation events, Genre execution, shared routing, cancellation, and publication should be inferred from current source by the Workbees and reviewed normally.
  
  ## Inherited beams
  
  ```text
  world-model before Dream != world-model after Dream
  
  Dream completion may wake BAR for deliberation.
  Dream completion must not blindly auto-grant a successor Dream.
  
  Reality may interrupt imagination.
  Imagination does not require repeated authorization from reality.
  
  Consensus needs changing evidence.
  
  Stay != Food exhausted.
  Food exhausted <=> no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  BAR1 must preserve LIVE priority, generation/revision cancellation, replacement semantics, hard clear/disposal safety, and Main authority established by Phase I.
  
  ## BAR1 field milestone
  
  A successful BAR1 field run should make the first-pass strategy intelligible in Open Mind:
  
  ```text
  starting 🏰
  -> Escape through confirmed contiguous barcode territory
  -> Jog sparsely through apparently open territory
  -> Walk densely when evidence becomes suspicious
  -> ChewIn when a tentative 🏠 needs consensus
  -> confirmed 🏠 becomes 🏰
  -> shared router chooses the next Genre from the resolved mark
  -> 🪲 eventually reaches 🧱
  -> Stay preserves the sparse map
  ```
  
  The map may still contain `❔`. That is truthful BAR1 output, not a failure to cosmetically finish the Street.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  BAR1 does **not** design or implement:
  
  - backward traversal after `Stay`;
  - a complete strategy for resolving every leftover `❔`;
  - general revisiting/refinement of every `🐾`;
  - adaptive Dream budgeting as a product rule;
  - Food reselection or unimpress policy after true exhaustion;
  - an endless, persistent, or "self-healing" loop contract.
  
  Those belong to BAR2 discussion after BAR1 evidence exists.

  # BAR2 — Plough: the second forward round
  
  Status: approved design contract; implementation remains after BAR1 field evidence
  
  Depends on: BAR1 first forward-pass Street preserved at `Stay`
  
  ## Goal
  
  BAR2 is **another round** over the same retained Food / Street.
  
  The Beetle starts again from `Street[0]` for the same strategic reason as BAR1:
  work from the slit-side / nearest-live-risk territory toward increasing Street
  indices.
  
  BAR2 has two goals with different strength:
  
  ```text
  hard goal:
  eliminate every ❔
  
  soft goal:
  reinterpret some 🐾 speculatively when Street geometry explains them
  ```
  
  BAR2 does **not** require every `🐾` mystery to be solved. Remaining detached
  `🐾` clusters are deliberate high-value residue for a later phase.
  
  ## DreamGenre: Plough 🚜
  
  BAR2 introduces one main DreamGenre: **Plough**.
  
  The name is intentionally suburban and ridiculous. The Beetle has finished the
  first BAR round, returns to `Street[0]`, starts the engine, and ploughs the mapped
  Street forward until the unknown Doors are gone. 🍿
  
  Plough is not BAR1-style locomotion through unexplored space. BAR1 already
  created the coarse map. Plough is a bounded map-repair / map-completion Dream
  that uses the existing Street as an index.
  
  ```text
  BAR1 asks:
  Where are the landmarks?
  
  BAR2 / Plough asks:
  Which remaining marks still deserve attention?
  ```
  
  Plough proceeds west-to-east in Street terms:
  
  ```text
  West = decreasing Street index
  East = increasing Street index
  ```
  
  ## New VisitState: suburban 🚜
  
  BAR2 adds a speculative Street category:
  
  - `🚜` — **suburban**: anomalous evidence spatially explained well enough as the
    optical / geometric neighborhood of a nearby confirmed `🏰`, commonly caused
    by a physically tilted barcode producing partial or wrong barcode-like reads
    before or after its trusted core.
  
  Observed shape:
  
  ```text
  ... 🟩 🟩 🐾 🏰 ... 🏰 🐾 🟩 🟩 ...
  ```
  
  may be reinterpreted as:
  
  ```text
  ... 🟩 🟩 🚜 🏰 ... 🏰 🚜 🟩 🟩 ...
  ```
  
  A more tilted / tipsy barcode may legitimately create a larger suburb:
  
  ```text
  ... 🟩 🟩 🚜 ... 🚜 🏰 🚜 ... 🚜 🟩 🟩 ...
  ```
  
  `🚜` is not another card verdict and does not mutate the board. It is a BAR
  world-model hypothesis:
  
  ```text
  🐾 = unexplained anomaly
  🚜 = anomaly explained enough by castle-adjacent geometry
  🏰 = consensus-confirmed barcode/card region
  ```
  
  Suburbanization may happen purely from Street geometry/proximity. It does not
  need a new FOF Bite because BAR is not claiming the original anomaly has been
  semantically decoded; it is only assigning a useful spatial explanation.
  
  ## AnnexWest() / AnnexEast()
  
  Plough uses two deliberately small reasoning routines.
  
  Conceptually:
  
  ```text
  AnnexWest(anchor):
      move toward decreasing Street indices
      while the directly adjacent Door is 🐾:
          🐾 -> 🚜
      stop at the first non-🐾 Door / Street boundary
  
  AnnexEast(anchor):
      move toward increasing Street indices
      while the directly adjacent Door is 🐾:
          🐾 -> 🚜
      stop at the first non-🐾 Door / Street boundary
  ```
  
  The routines consume only a contiguous `🐾` run attached to the relevant
  confirmed-castle / suburb edge. An empty or unresolved Door breaks the spatial
  explanation:
  
  ```text
  🐾 🟩 🏰
  ```
  
  does **not** justify annexing the `🐾`.
  
  The exact Kotlin signature / anchor representation is an implementation choice;
  the design invariant is local contiguous propagation, not a global rewrite of
  remote Street state.
  
  ## Pre-existing BAR1 castle normalization
  
  BAR1 may hand BAR2 a map such as:
  
  ```text
  🐾 🐾 🏰 🏰 🐾
  ```
  
  with no unresolved Door adjacent to that castle.
  
  Therefore Plough must be allowed to make a zero-perception Dream contribution
  when its forward cursor encounters an existing confirmed `🏰`:
  
  ```text
  encounter existing 🏰
  -> AnnexWest()
  -> AnnexEast()
  ```
  
  For example:
  
  ```text
  🐾 🐾 🏰 🏰 🐾
  -> 🚜 🚜 🏰 🏰 🚜
  ```
  
  No Knock and no ChewIn are required. Thinking over already-retained evidence may
  legitimately change the world-model.
  
  ## Local annex trigger table
  
  When Plough resolves the current `❔`, these three local rules are sufficient for
  the approved first BAR2 design:
  
  ```text
  1. current ❔ resolves to 🏰
     -> AnnexWest()
     -> AnnexEast()
  
  2. ❔ 🏰
     current ❔ resolves to 🐾
     -> AnnexWest()
  
  3. 🏰 ❔   or   🚜 ❔
     current ❔ resolves to 🐾
     -> AnnexEast()
  ```
  
  Rule 1 covers both sides of a newly discovered confirmed castle. Rules 2 and 3
  extend already-known castle/suburb interpretation when a newly resolved Door
  turns out anomalous.
  
  ### Deliberate asymmetry: no `❔ 🚜` rule
  
  Do not automatically symmetrize the table.
  
  BAR2 starts at `Street[0]` and moves toward increasing indices. A west-side `🚜`
  represents territory whose castle-adjacent anomaly has already been interpreted
  while the Plough cursor moves forward. The useful expanding frontier is the east
  side, hence:
  
  ```text
  🚜 ❔ resolved to 🐾
  -> AnnexEast()
  ```
  
  while the mirror-shaped:
  
  ```text
  ❔ 🚜
  ```
  
  has no approved special trigger in BAR2.
  
  This asymmetry is part of the forward-round design, not an omission to repair by
  reflex.
  
  ## One bounded Plough Dream
  
  A single Plough Dream may make many Street-map mutations while keeping new
  perception tightly bounded:
  
  ```text
  Knock   <= 1
  ChewIn  <= 1
  Street mutations = many
  ```
  
  A useful conceptual order is:
  
  ```text
  1. Begin from BAR's current forward Plough position / next relevant Street mark.
  
  2. Apply zero-perception reasoning already enabled by the current map,
     especially AnnexWest()/AnnexEast() around an encountered existing 🏰.
  
  3. Find the next unresolved ❔ toward increasing Street indices.
  
  4. If no ❔ remains, the Dream may finish without a Knock.
  
  5. Otherwise move 🪲 to that Door and Knock at most once.
  
  6. Resolve the Knock result:
  
     empty
     -> 🟩
  
     tentative single-FOF candidate
     -> 🏠
     -> allow at most one ChewIn
        -> confirmed: 🏰
        -> failed: 🐾
  
     other / anomalous
     -> 🐾
  
  7. Fire the applicable tiny annex trigger(s).
  
  8. Return the changed Street / Dream result to BAR.
  
  9. BAR deliberates on the new world-model before another Plough Dream is
     granted.
  ```
  
  This preserves the Phase-I cognition beam:
  
  ```text
  Dream
  -> world-model changes
  -> BAR reflects
  -> maybe another bounded Dream
  ```
  
  Plough must not become one unbounded executor loop merely because the tractor is
  purring. 🚜💨
  
  ## BAR2 progress and completion
  
  The hard completion condition remains the existing Food-exhaustion definition:
  
  ```text
  Food exhausted
  <=> no Street[i] == ❔
  ```
  
  BAR2 therefore keeps ploughing bounded Dreams until all `❔` are eliminated or
  existing higher-priority lifecycle/LIVE rules revoke the work.
  
  By the end of successful BAR2 ploughing, expected residual `🐾` should occur only
  as detached suspicious clusters, not touching a confirmed `🏰`.
  
  Typical residue:
  
  ```text
  ... 🟩 🐾 🐾 🐾 🟩 ...
  ```
  
  A single detached `🐾` may be ordinary noise. A contiguous run of detached
  `🐾` is much more suspicious / interesting. BAR2 deliberately preserves that
  signal rather than inventing an explanation.
  
  This partitions BAR1 anomaly into two useful classes:
  
  ```text
  castle-adjacent anomaly
  -> 🚜 suburban explanation
  
  still-detached anomaly cluster
  -> 🐾 retained for later cognition
  ```
  
  The detached-cluster story belongs to BAR3 / a later phase and is not designed
  here.
  
  ## BAR2 terminal: Stay
  
  BAR2 finishes in **Stay** for the same design reason as BAR1:
  
  ```text
  another forward round completes
  -> Stay
  -> preserve Food / Street / marks
  -> Archy and Hive can inspect the result
  -> later cognition is a separate design act
  ```
  
  In BAR2, reaching Stay after successful Ploughing normally coincides with no
  remaining `❔`, but `Stay` remains a phase/milestone posture rather than a magic
  synonym for every future cognition decision.
  
  BAR2 does not automatically launch BAR3.
  
  ## Expected field picture
  
  One possible evolution:
  
  ```text
  BAR1 residue:
  🏰 ❔ 🟩 🐾 🏰 🐾 ❔ 🐾 🐾 🟩 ... 🧱
  
  Plough resolves unknowns and annexes castle neighborhoods:
  🏰 🟩 🟩 🚜 🏰 🚜 🟩 🐾 🐾 🟩 ... 🧱
  
  BAR2 done:
  no ❔
  castle-adjacent anomaly -> 🚜
  detached suspicious clusters may remain 🐾
  -> Stay
  ```
  
  ## What BAR2 does not claim
  
  BAR2 does not:
  
  - prove what a `🚜` anomaly physically was;
  - mutate the board from `🚜`;
  - require every `🐾` to disappear;
  - globally reinterpret anomaly across empty/unresolved gaps;
  - revisit detached `🐾` clusters with a BAR3 strategy;
  - redefine `🏰` consensus trust;
  - weaken LIVE priority, Impression/Food generation checks, hard clear, disposal,
    or replacement cancellation;
  - auto-launch another phase after Stay.
  
  ## Review beams
  
  ```text
  BAR1 discovers the coarse Street.
  BAR2 ploughs its unknown Doors.
  
  Looking can change the map.
  Thinking about what was already seen can also change the map.
  
  🚜 is explanation, not certainty.
  🐾 left detached is signal, not failure.
  
  One Knock can enable many map changes.
  One Dream still returns to BAR before another begins.
  ```
  
  And the field joke remains mechanically accurate:
  
  ```text
  Bartender, looking out the window:
  "Somebody ploughed the entire street."
  
  🪲:
  "And I'll be back again."
  ```

  # BAR3 — Hell and Heaven: alternate-plane anomaly investigation
  
  Status: approved design contract; implementation remains after BAR2 field evidence
  
  Depends on: BAR2 Plough completing its second forward round at `Stay`
  
  ## Goal
  
  BAR3 investigates the anomaly clusters deliberately left by BAR2.
  
  BAR2 ends with no unresolved `❔`. Ordinary castle-adjacent anomaly has already
  been reinterpreted as suburban `🚜`, so the remaining `🐾` should occur only as
  detached suspicious clusters, for example:
  
  ```text
  🟩 🐾 🐾 🐾 🟩
  ```
  
  BAR3 starts again from `Street[0]` for the same strategic reason as BAR1/BAR2:
  work from the slit-side / nearest-live-risk territory toward increasing Street
  indices.
  
  BAR3's hard goal is:
  
  ```text
  eliminate every 🐾
  ```
  
  The key change is not another walk along new Street geometry. BAR3 keeps the
  same Street coordinate system and changes the **evidence plane underneath it**.
  
  ## Why alternate planes exist
  
  A barcode clipped by the current Food's vertical side may be impossible to read
  from that Food because the barcode is physically incomplete in the retained
  corridor. FOF may still see partial / wrong barcode-like evidence, leaving a
  cluster such as:
  
  ```text
  🟩 🐾 🐾 🐾 🟩
  ```
  
  From Street geometry this can look like a castle that should be present but is
  laterally displaced outside current Food.
  
  BAR3 tries two retained-scene hypotheses using the wider SAA/SAB postcard that
  owns the current Food.
  
  Assume current Food came from SAA. Let Food width be `W`.
  
  Conceptually:
  
  ```text
  Heaven
  = Food-shaped region from the same postcard
  = shifted laterally by 50% of W to the left
  = overlaps current Food by 50%
  
  current Food
  = the BAR1/BAR2 evidence plane
  
  Hell
  = Food-shaped region from the same postcard
  = shifted laterally by 50% of W to the right
  = overlaps current Food by 50%
  ```
  
  The same idea applies when the active retained reservoir is SAB; Hell/Heaven are
  relative alternate planes around current Food, not universal screen directions.
  
  Exact extraction/clamping mechanics belong to implementation. The design beam
  is:
  
  ```text
  same Street longitudinal coordinates
  + alternate lateral retained evidence
  ```
  
  ## PREALLOCATE HELL AND HEAVEN
  
  Hive / Workbees: do not allocate these alternate Food-shaped working planes on
  a difficult Dream frame.
  
  The Phase-P2 resource principle continues to apply:
  
  ```text
  prepare, size, and stabilize large resources while grounded
  ```
  
  BAR3 should have Hell and Heaven storage/resources prepared before active Dream
  work needs them. Exact buffer ownership, copy/view strategy, and lifecycle
  plumbing are implementation decisions, but per-Dream surprise allocation is not
  the intended design.
  
  In the BAR mythos this is ridiculous and therefore memorable:
  
  > Please preallocate Hell and Heaven. 🍿😹
  
  ## New VisitState: 😈
  
  BAR3 introduces:
  
  - `😈` — **Hell checked here; maybe try Heaven**.
  
  `😈` is procedural memory, not a card verdict and not an assertion that the
  location is intrinsically bad.
  
  ```text
  🐾 = unexplained anomaly after BAR2
  😈 = anomaly still unresolved after Hell was checked; Heaven remains
  ```
  
  A Door may become `😈` even if Hell's Knock looks empty. The meaning is not
  "Hell contains evidence"; it is "the Hell hypothesis has been spent here."
  
  ## Broadened meaning of 🟩
  
  BAR3 approves the broader interpretation:
  
  - `🟩` — **cleared / non-actionable territory for the current BAR world-model**.
  
  Literal empty-looking evidence remains one common path to `🟩`, but BAR3 may
  also produce `🟩` after both relevant alternate-plane hypotheses have been
  investigated without recovering an actionable barcode.
  
  Therefore:
  
  ```text
  🟩 does not necessarily mean every sampled pixel was literally empty.
  🟩 means BAR has no remaining actionable barcode hypothesis for this Door.
  ```
  
  This is deliberate closure, not certainty about all possible visual causes.
  
  ## PASS 1 — Hell
  
  BAR3 begins at `Street[0]` and traverses toward increasing indices.
  
  The Hell pass targets only `🐾` Doors.
  
  For each bounded Hell Dream:
  
  ```text
  1. select the next 🐾 toward increasing Street indices
  2. use Hell as the active evidence plane for that Street position
  3. Knock at most once
  4. if Knock yields a tentative candidate:
        🏠
        -> allow at most one ChewIn
        -> confirmed: 🏰
        -> failed: 😈
  5. if Knock does not produce a confirmed castle:
        -> 😈
  6. if a new 🏰 is confirmed:
        apply local annex reasoning over adjacent current-pass anomaly
        -> neighboring contiguous 🐾 may become 🚜
  7. return changed Street / Dream result to BAR
  8. BAR deliberates before another Hell Dream
  ```
  
  Thus Hell may transform a cluster directly:
  
  ```text
  🟩 🐾 🐾 🐾 🟩
  ```
  
  into a recovered tilted/lifted barcode neighborhood:
  
  ```text
  🟩 🚜 🏰 🚜 🟩
  ```
  
  or, if Hell does not recover it:
  
  ```text
  🟩 😈 😈 😈 🟩
  ```
  
  The Hell pass is complete when:
  
  ```text
  no Street[i] == 🐾
  ```
  
  ## PASS 2 — Heaven
  
  After Hell is complete:
  
  ```text
  reset BAR3 traversal to Street[0]
  swap active alternate plane Hell -> Heaven
  ```
  
  The Heaven pass targets only `😈` Doors.
  
  For each bounded Heaven Dream:
  
  ```text
  1. select the next 😈 toward increasing Street indices
  2. use Heaven as the active evidence plane for that Street position
  3. Knock at most once
  4. if Knock yields a tentative candidate:
        🏠
        -> allow at most one ChewIn
        -> confirmed: 🏰
        -> failed: 🟩
  5. if no confirmed castle is recovered:
        -> 🟩
  6. if a new 🏰 is confirmed:
        apply local annex reasoning over adjacent current-pass anomaly
        -> neighboring contiguous 😈 may become 🚜
  7. return changed Street / Dream result to BAR
  8. BAR deliberates before another Heaven Dream
  ```
  
  The Heaven pass gives up cleanly when the second lateral hypothesis fails:
  
  ```text
  😈 -> 🟩
  ```
  
  This is where the broadened `🟩` semantics matter: BAR has checked both relevant
  alternate planes and has no remaining actionable barcode hypothesis at that
  Door.
  
  ## Annexing inside BAR3
  
  BAR3 reuses the BAR2 idea of tiny local geometric reasoning, but the annexable
  anomaly state depends on the active pass:
  
  ```text
  Hell pass:
  new 🏰 may annex contiguous adjacent 🐾 -> 🚜
  
  Heaven pass:
  new 🏰 may annex contiguous adjacent 😈 -> 🚜
  ```
  
  The same spatial breaker rule remains:
  
  ```text
  an empty/cleared Door, unresolved mismatch, other castle, or Street boundary
  breaks the local propagation
  ```
  
  BAR3 does not globally reinterpret every Door merely because the evidence plane
  changed. Existing `🏰`, `🚜`, and ordinary `🟩` remain mapped unless a focused
  BAR3 rule explicitly owns a local change.
  
  ## One bounded BAR3 Dream
  
  The bounded-attention shape from BAR2 remains useful:
  
  ```text
  Knock   <= 1
  ChewIn  <= 1
  Street mutations = many
  ```
  
  A Dream may therefore recover one castle and reclassify several neighboring
  anomaly Doors by local geometry before returning the changed world-model to BAR.
  
  BAR3 does not become a hidden whole-cluster executor loop:
  
  ```text
  Dream
  -> changed Street
  -> BAR reflects
  -> maybe another bounded Dream
  ```
  
  ## Why two full passes instead of Hell+Heaven per Door
  
  BAR3 deliberately performs:
  
  ```text
  whole Street through Hell
  -> whole Street through Heaven
  ```
  
  rather than alternating Hell/Heaven at each anomaly Door.
  
  This keeps one alternate evidence geometry stable across a pass and lets a
  castle discovered in Hell annex neighboring `🐾` before BAR spends any Heaven
  attention on them. The changed world-model therefore gets a chance to reduce
  future perception cost.
  
  ## BAR3 completion
  
  BAR3 is complete when both passes have finished and:
  
  ```text
  no Street[i] == 🐾
  no Street[i] == 😈
  ```
  
  Expected ordinary residue is therefore composed of:
  
  ```text
  🟩 = cleared / non-actionable territory
  🏰 = consensus-confirmed barcode/card region
  🚜 = suburb explained by castle-adjacent geometry
  ```
  
  BAR3 does not claim that every visual oddity has been metaphysically explained.
  It claims that the current BAR world-model has exhausted the original Food plus
  the approved Hell/Heaven lateral barcode hypotheses.
  
  ## Phase relationship
  
  ```text
  BAR1
  -> discover coarse Street
  -> Stay
  
  BAR2 / Plough
  -> eliminate ❔
  -> explain ordinary castle-adjacent 🐾 as 🚜
  -> leave detached 🐾 clusters
  -> Stay
  
  BAR3 / Hell + Heaven
  -> Hell: 🐾 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 😈
  -> Heaven: 😈 -> 🏰 / 🚜 / 🟩
  -> no 🐾, no 😈
  ```
  
  BAR3 is deliberately silent about any BAR4 strategy. A later act may exist, but
  it must begin from the world-model BAR3 actually leaves rather than being
  smuggled into this contract.

  # BAR4 — Suburban audit: Hell and Heaven for every deferred suburb
  
  Status: approved design contract; implementation remains after BAR3 field evidence
  
  Depends on: BAR3 Hell/Heaven completing with no `🐾` and no `😈`
  
  ## Goal
  
  BAR4 repays the speculative attention debt introduced by BAR2.
  
  BAR2 deliberately allowed castle-adjacent anomaly to be de-prioritized as:
  
  ```text
  🐾 -> 🚜
  ```
  
  because Street geometry made a nearby confirmed `🏰` a plausible explanation.
  That was useful speculation, not final truth.
  
  BAR4's hard goal is:
  
  ```text
  eliminate every 🚜
  ```
  
  Every suburban Door is walked through the same two alternate evidence planes
  introduced by BAR3. BAR4 asks whether the deferred anomaly actually contains a
  recoverable barcode when viewed through Hell or Heaven.
  
  ## Why BAR4 exists
  
  BAR3 investigates detached unexplained anomaly (`🐾`). BAR4 instead audits an
  already-held explanation (`🚜`).
  
  ```text
  BAR3 asks:
  What is this unexplained anomaly?
  
  BAR4 asks:
  Was my suburban explanation actually safe?
  ```
  
  `🚜` therefore becomes explicitly provisional knowledge: BAR may defer it for
  strategic reasons, but the final Food-exhaustion contract does not permit it to
  survive forever.
  
  ## BAR4 does not annex
  
  BAR4 deliberately disables the BAR2/BAR3 suburban annex shortcut.
  
  Do **not** transform neighboring anomaly into `🚜` merely because BAR4 recovers
  a nearby `🏰`. BAR4 exists specifically to audit every remaining suburb rather
  than excuse it again by geometry.
  
  ```text
  BAR2/BAR3:
  local geometry may create 🚜
  
  BAR4:
  every 🚜 must face alternate-plane evidence
  ```
  
  No geometric forgiveness.
  
  ## PASS 1 — Hell audits every suburb
  
  BAR4 starts again from `Street[0]` and moves toward increasing Street indices.
  
  The Hell pass targets only `🚜` Doors.
  
  For each bounded Hell Dream:
  
  ```text
  1. select the next 🚜 toward increasing Street indices
  2. use the preallocated Hell plane for that Street position
  3. Knock at most once
  4. if Knock yields a tentative candidate:
        🏠
        -> allow at most one ChewIn
        -> confirmed: 🏰
        -> failed: 😈
  5. if no confirmed castle is recovered:
        -> 😈
  6. do not annex neighboring 🚜
  7. return changed Street / Dream result to BAR
  8. BAR deliberates before another Hell Dream
  ```
  
  The Hell pass ends when:
  
  ```text
  no Street[i] == 🚜
  ```
  
  At that point every former suburb has become either:
  
  ```text
  🏰 = barcode recovered in Hell
  😈 = Hell checked; Heaven remains
  ```
  
  ## PASS 2 — Heaven closes the audit
  
  After Hell is complete:
  
  ```text
  reset BAR4 traversal to Street[0]
  swap active alternate plane Hell -> Heaven
  ```
  
  The Heaven pass targets only `😈` Doors.
  
  For each bounded Heaven Dream:
  
  ```text
  1. select the next 😈 toward increasing Street indices
  2. use the preallocated Heaven plane for that Street position
  3. Knock at most once
  4. if Knock yields a tentative candidate:
        🏠
        -> allow at most one ChewIn
        -> confirmed: 🏰
        -> failed: 🟩
  5. if no confirmed castle is recovered:
        -> 🟩
  6. do not create new 🚜
  7. return changed Street / Dream result to BAR
  8. BAR deliberates before another Heaven Dream
  ```
  
  The broadened BAR3 meaning of `🟩` is used here unchanged:
  
  ```text
  🟩 = cleared / non-actionable for the current BAR world-model
  ```
  
  It is valid closure after both alternate-plane hypotheses have been spent.
  
  ## Bounded Dream shape
  
  BAR4 keeps the same attention budget used by BAR2/BAR3:
  
  ```text
  Knock   <= 1
  ChewIn  <= 1
  ```
  
  Unlike Plough and BAR3 annexing, BAR4 normally has little or no map cascade,
  because each suburb is being individually audited and BAR4 does not create new
  suburban territory.
  
  Every Dream still returns its changed world-model to BAR before another Dream
  is granted:
  
  ```text
  Dream
  -> changed Street
  -> BAR reflects
  -> maybe another bounded Dream
  ```
  
  ## Resource rule — reuse preallocated Hell and Heaven
  
  BAR4 reuses the alternate Food-shaped working planes prepared for BAR3.
  
  Do not allocate a new afterlife merely because the Beetle reached BAR4. 🍿
  
  The Phase-P2 resource beam still applies:
  
  ```text
  prepare, size, and stabilize large resources while grounded
  ```
  
  When active Food/postcard provenance changes later, the prepared storage may be
  repopulated/rebound according to implementation ownership, but difficult Dream
  frames should not discover that Hell or Heaven still needs allocation.
  
  ## BAR4 completion and final current-Food Street
  
  BAR4 is complete when:
  
  ```text
  no Street[i] == 🚜
  no Street[i] == 😈
  ```
  
  Because BAR2 already removed `❔` and BAR3 removed `🐾`, the final current-Food
  Street contains only:
  
  ```text
  🟩 = cleared / non-actionable territory
  🏰 = consensus-confirmed barcode/card region
  ```
  
  This is the new final exhaustion boundary for one Food:
  
  ```text
  current Food exhausted
  <=> every Street Door is final 🟩 or 🏰
  ```
  
  Earlier wording equating Food exhaustion with merely `no ❔` is superseded by
  BAR2–BAR4. `No ❔` means unresolved-Door completion; it does not mean all later
  BAR attention debts are paid.
  
  ## After BAR4 — the other postcard
  
  Food exhaustion is local to the current Food / retained postcard side. It does
  not mean the whole Impression has been exhausted.
  
  Example when SAA was processed first:
  
  ```text
  SAA::BAR1
  -> SAA::BAR2 / Plough
  -> SAA::BAR3 / Hell + Heaven
  -> SAA::BAR4 / suburban audit
  -> SAA Food exhausted: Street contains only 🟩 / 🏰
  
  then:
  
  select SAB as the next Food source
  -> swipe the BAR Street clean
  -> build a fresh SAB Street
  -> SAB::BAR1
  ```
  
  The Street reset is deliberate. VisitStates from an SAA-derived Food are
  conclusions about that Food geometry and must not be copied into SAB's fresh
  world-map.
  
  The handoff does **not** mean resetting the whole Impression or authoritative
  board truth:
  
  ```text
  preserve:
  - retained Impression / postcard provenance
  - authoritative Main/reducer board state and cards already learned
  - lifecycle / generation safety
  
  replace for the new Food side:
  - active Food geometry
  - Street / VisitStates
  - BAR pass progress
  - alternate Hell/Heaven plane contents derived from the new Food/postcard
  ```
  
  Exact SAA-first versus SAB-first choice remains owned by current Food selection;
  the design principle is symmetric: exhaust one selected postcard-side Food,
  then the other retained postcard may receive a fresh BAR1-to-BAR4 cognition
  cycle.
  
  ## Phase relationship
  
  ```text
  BAR1
  -> discover coarse Street
  -> Stay
  
  BAR2 / Plough
  -> eliminate ❔
  -> speculate some 🐾 -> 🚜
  -> Stay
  
  BAR3 / Hell + Heaven
  -> eliminate 🐾
  -> may leave 🚜
  
  BAR4 / suburban audit
  -> Hell:   🚜 -> 🏰 / 😈
  -> Heaven: 😈 -> 🏰 / 🟩
  -> no 🚜, no 😈
  -> current Food Street only 🟩 / 🏰
  -> current Food exhausted
  
  if the other retained postcard remains:
  -> new Food from other postcard
  -> fresh Street
  -> BAR1 again
  ```

  # BAR1-01 — Tablet Check-up Before New Street Work
  
  Status: ready for Archy + Hive field run
  
  Phase: BAR1
  
  Operator: Archy
  
  Guide: Hive / Workbee
  
  ## Purpose
  
  Before BAR1 changes Street/Cinema behavior, finish classifying the remaining current-Impression tablet evidence on the SM-T350.
  
  This ticket is deliberately first. It keeps two kinds of failure distinguishable:
  
  ```text
  existing Impression baseline defect
  vs
  new BAR1 regression
  ```
  
  Hive should guide Archy through the checks in small steps and preserve the existing truth vocabulary:
  
  ```text
  Pass
  Problem
  Not observed
  ```
  
  Do not turn a physically difficult scene into an invented software failure.
  
  ## Primary operational checklist
  
  Use the existing consolidated [`I-08 SM-T350 Impression cognition flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md) as the authoritative procedure.
  
  Sections 1–3 are already recorded PASS. BAR1-01 begins at the remaining sections:
  
  ### A. I-08 section 4 — Snippet truth
  
  This is the remaining physical/semantic attention for [`I-07 recognized barcode Snippets`](I-07-recognized-barcode-snippets.md).
  
  Check as I-08 specifies:
  
  - familiar occurrence may show yellow when Food recognized it;
  - Food-added occurrence may show green when it truly entered the board;
  - marks align to the same barcode occurrence in retained scene evidence;
  - repeated recognition does not stack duplicate marks;
  - green superseding yellow is observed only if the natural transition actually occurs;
  - screenshots prove presentation, while board state proves addition.
  
  ### B. I-08 section 5 — Lifecycle and preemption
  
  This is the remaining integrated physical attention for the safety beams established by [`I-05 BSR attention router`](I-05-bsr-attention-router.md) and [`I-06 BCP/FOF dream loop`](I-06-bcp-fof-dream-loop.md).
  
  Check as I-08 specifies:
  
  - BFM/BRM Food replacement keeps honest retained-scene semantics;
  - admitted LIVE work preempts retained cognition at the established atomic FOF boundary;
  - a new LIVE `ADDED` replaces the old Impression cleanly;
  - old Food/bite/Snippet/optimistic work cannot resurrect afterward;
  - seat change / Undo / Clear hard-clear retained cognition safely.
  
  The known continuing-attention stall is **not** a BAR1-01 failure. Its design answer became BAR1. Do not expect old source to have BAR Street continuation before BAR1 implementation lands.
  
  ### C. I-08 section 6 — Open Mind closed + P2 evidence closeout
  
  Check as I-08 specifies:
  
  - ordinary cognition may continue with Open Mind closed;
  - retained diagnostic layers stay hidden;
  - closing presentation does not itself clear the Impression;
  - controls remain responsive;
  - a fresh Open Mind open/closed pulse batch can be shared as readable JSONL;
  - the next share begins a fresh batch.
  
  This also supplies the postponed current-build evidence referenced by P2-06 without reviving old/new SPS-number comparisons.
  
  ## I-0x Archy-attention map
  
  This table prevents old Phase-I seams from disappearing merely because the branch name changed.
  
  | Phase-I item | Archy attention now? | BAR1-01 handling |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `I-04g` controller split | No further action expected | I-08 section 1 already PASS; retain as provenance only. |
  | `I-05` BSR attention router | Yes, integrated physical safety | Observe through I-08 section 5 preemption/lifecycle checks. |
  | `I-06` BCP/FOF dream loop | Yes, integrated physical safety | Observe through I-08 section 5 and current Food-cognition behavior. |
  | `I-07` Snippets | Yes | Observe through I-08 section 4 semantic/alignment checks. |
  | `I-08` consolidated flight | Yes | Finish sections 4–6; sections 1–3 already PASS. |
  | `I-08b` continuing Food attention | No separate old-source field check | Its approved design migrated into BAR1; BAR1 implementation will own the new behavior. |
  | `I-08c` Dream Thoughts observability | Yes, but as product-language design first | Surface the questions below; do not pretend it is an executable field pass before wording/state policy is agreed. |
  
  ## I-08c discussion seam
  
  [`I-08c`](I-08c-dream-thoughts-observability.md) remains a design seed because the aquarium's Bite/ROI can visibly move while Thoughts text looks stale.
  
  Hive may help Archy answer its product-language questions after or around the physical check-up:
  
  - which high-level Dream/BAR events deserve visible Thoughts updates;
  - current activity vs latest reflection vs both;
  - what remains visible between Dream completion and the next BAR choice;
  - whether Open Mind posture changes verbosity;
  - how LIVE preemption should appear in Thoughts.
  
  This discussion may remain explicitly deferred if Archy wants to keep BAR1-01 focused on physical baseline truth. Deferral is not silent closure.
  
  ## Report shape
  
  Hive should return a compact field note containing:
  
  - build commit;
  - I-08 sections 4 / 5 / 6 as Pass, Problem, or Not observed;
  - screenshots / JSONL filename where useful;
  - any stale resurrection, duplicate, focus stumble, or misleading overlay;
  - I-08c answers captured, or `deferred`.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  BAR1-01 is complete when the pre-BAR physical baseline has been honestly classified enough that later BAR1 behavior can be compared against it.
  
  A `Problem` does not automatically block BAR1. It must be identified as either:
  
  ```text
  baseline defect worth fixing first
  or
  known limitation BAR1 is intended to replace
  or
  non-blocking observation
  ```
  
  Selyn/Hive may make that routing judgment after Archy's field report.

  # BAR1-02 — Open Mind Street Text
  
  Status: Foxy-owned design interview; not ready for implementation until Archy gives the UI shape
  
  Phase: BAR1
  
  Owner: 🔥🐝👑 Foxy
  
  ## Goal
  
  Expose the current BAR Street as a **textual Open Mind view** so Archy can debug the world-model and enjoy watching the Beetle's map form.
  
  This is a development/aquarium surface, not a claim about final retail UI.
  
  At minimum the future view should be able to represent the real Street state rather than infer a prettier story:
  
  ```text
  🏰 ❔ ❔ 🟩 ❔ 🐾 ❔ 🏠 ... 🧱
              🪲
  ```
  
  Exact layout, wrapping, details, and wording are intentionally open for Archy/Foxy design.
  
  ## Foxy assignment
  
  Foxy should **ask Archy for detailed ideas before implementation**.
  
  Bring proposals. Ask questions. Let the UI become vivid enough to be useful.
  
  Foxy::Fi may remain fully expressive during ideation; radiance is welcome. The only discipline is to keep proposal vs settled contract legible so a playful idea does not become source behavior by accident.
  
  ## Questions Foxy should explore with Archy
  
  Do not answer these silently in code. Use them as an interview/fountain surface:
  
  - Should Street appear on one line, wrap, scroll, compress, or use another compact arrangement?
  - How should the current Beetle position be shown relative to the Door glyphs?
  - Should `🏠` / `🏰` expose CardId details inline, on another line, on selection, or not at all?
  - How much of `🐾(details)` should be visible without turning the aquarium into a debugger console?
  - Should current DreamGenre / BAR choice appear beside the Street, above it, or remain in Thoughts?
  - Should the far wall `🧱` always be visible even if the Street is wider than the text surface?
  - How should updates feel while Dreams move quickly: every resolved Door, only meaningful map changes, or another cadence?
  - Should the view distinguish current Food/orientation explicitly, or is its location in the existing Open Mind aquarium sufficient?
  - What would make the view fun enough that Archy actually watches it during field tests rather than merely tolerates it?
  
  Foxy may add better questions after reading current Open Mind source and the BAR1 design.
  
  ## Truth boundary
  
  The Street text is a **projection of cognition state**.
  
  It must not:
  
  - own or mutate Street / VisitState;
  - manufacture Door classifications;
  - turn missing publication into guessed UI state;
  - change BAR scheduling merely to animate itself;
  - weaken LIVE preemption or cancellation;
  - become an excuse for per-FOF text spam.
  
  Prefer immutable BAR/Street publications reaching Main/UI through existing safe presentation seams.
  
  ## Acceptance shape — after Archy/Foxy design
  
  A later implementation slice should be able to show, in Open Mind, a coherent textual Street that:
  
  - reflects actual current Door states;
  - makes the current Beetle position intelligible;
  - preserves sparse `❔` honestly;
  - updates when the world-model meaningfully changes;
  - remains harmless when Open Mind is closed;
  - survives replacement/clear without stale Street resurrection.
  
  Exact visual grammar remains deliberately unset until Foxy and Archy finish the design conversation.

  # I-08: Consolidated SM-T350 Impression cognition flight
  
  Status: flight in progress; sections 1-3 PASS; continuing-BSR defect identified
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: P2-06, I-04g, I-05, I-06, and I-07
  
  ## Goal
  
  Let Archy validate the complete post-P2 Impression road in one deliberate
  tablet session instead of interrupting every small code commit with a partial
  manual test. This flight closes only what is actually observed; automation and
  source review remain separately labeled.
  
  The two non-urgent Phase A Admin Calibrate polish tickets are outside this
  flight. Missing camera permission, permanent denial, and first-ever onboarding
  deserve their own Android-state setup later.
  
  ## Partial evidence already received
  
  - [x] **Manual observed:** Beetle visibly runs Food cinema in Open Mind on the
    SM-T350, and some cards are recognized while it runs.
  - [x] **Static screenshot:** BFM and BRM both show live preview, retained
    postcards, selected Food, bite/ROI introspection, and green/yellow Snippet
    presentation together.
  - [x] **Recorded JSONL:** two pulse exports contain 21 complete records spanning
    Open Mind open and closed captures.
  
  See [`SessionI-08-1`](../optimizations/SessionI-08-1/README.md) for the evidence
  and its deliberately narrow claims. Those observations partially establish
  sections 2–4 and section 6's logging surface, but do not replace the controlled
  A/B/C semantic, preemption, lifecycle, or fresh-share checks below.
  
  ## Prepare one useful physical scene
  
  Use the SM-T350 with a build at or after the final I-07 VFR commit. Record the
  commit, orientation, BFM/BRM choice, consensus value, and Open Mind posture.
  
  Prepare three packed barcodes on the Food side of the slit:
  
  - **A — familiar:** already belongs to the selected target hand;
  - **B — live seed:** board-absent and presented through the slit to create the
    final test Impression;
  - **C — new Food card:** board-absent and visible inside the retained Food
    corridor but not deliberately scanned through the slit.
  
  This arrangement gives one expected yellow occurrence (`A`) and one expected
  green occurrence (`C`) from the same retained scene. If focus or physical
  spacing prevents either recognition, record **Not observed** rather than
  turning absence into a software failure.
  
  ## One field flight
  
  ### 1. Startup and ordinary Stream regression (PASS)
  
  1. Start from an already calibrated installation.
  2. Observe the Little Theatre confirmation without a jerk or premature Main
     Menu actions. (Pass; Archy smiled)
  3. Enter TD Edit Board and add card A normally. (Pass)
  4. Exercise one ordinary repair action, such as Undo followed by adding A
     again, and confirm the controller refactor did not disturb board editing. (Pass)
  
  This closes I-04g's normal TD scan smoke.
  
  ### 2. Capture a deliberate cognition scene (PASS)
  
  1. With Open Mind enabled, present the packed arrangement and scan B through
     the slit.
  2. Confirm B is added once. (Pass)
  3. Confirm `🐞`, SAA, SAB, selected Food, and a readable `IMP` line appear. (Pass)
  4. Confirm the postcards plausibly show the packed scene just after B was
     accepted while the separate camera preview continues live. (Pass)
  5. During Love Blonds, move a different barcode through the still-live preview.
     It must neither land then nor appear later as delayed work. (Pass; no re-impression)
  6. Present that barcode again after the quiet second and confirm ordinary live
     recognition resumes. (Pass)
  
  ### 3. Watch real Food cognition (PASS)
  
  After the quiet second, hold the scene steady long enough for neglectable live
  views to offer BSR attention.
  
  Confirm:
  
  - the Food bite outline advances deterministically near-slit-first; (Pass)
  - `RoiPreviewStrip()` shows the same grayscale pixels as the outlined bite; (Pass)
  - the live preview remains responsive while Beetle dreams; (Pass)
  - SPS represents the combined inner cinema without a second Food counter; (Pass)
  - admitted live evidence runs after the current atomic FOF attempt and before
    another attempt; (Pass)
  - Food-origin card C may be added to Main without capturing a new Impression;
    SAA/SAB and Food therefore remain the same retained scene; (Pass)
  - no Food result is applied twice and no stale result appears after replacement. (Pass)
  
  **Observation:** Archived [`I-08a`](../dev_history/mind/I-08a-bsr-quiet-interval-opportunity.md)
  now gives initial Food one explicit BSR opportunity. Archy's ten-second
  Love-Blonds experiment confirmed that SAA/SAB and Food appear and the first
  bite outline/ROI moves once during the quiet interval.
  
  After that bounded dream, BSR returns to `IMPRESSED`. Further attention still
  depends on a post-quiet `NEGLECTABLE_LIVE` opportunity, so the visible cinema
  stalls while Love Blonds suppresses LIVE recognition. Active design ticket
  [`I-08b`](I-08b-continuing-food-attention.md) owns this newly isolated policy
  problem.
  
  Do not require a particular SPS number or dream duration. Record visible stalls,
  focus changes, duplicate additions, and whether Food recognition occurred.
  
  ### 4. Inspect Snippet truth
  
  Before replacing the Impression, inspect all visible overlays:
  
  - A's familiar occurrence is crossed yellow if Food recognized it;
  - C's adding occurrence is crossed green if Food added it;
  - each mark aligns with the same barcode in its source SAA/SAB postcard;
  - the mark also aligns in Food only while current Food contains it;
  - repeated recognition does not stack marks, and green supersedes yellow for
    the same occurrence if that transition is naturally exercised;
  - the live slit remains above retained overlays.
  
  Take one screenshot with the bite/ROI evidence and one with the clearest
  green/yellow marks. A screenshot proves presentation only; use the board state
  to establish whether C was actually added.
  
  ### 5. Lifecycle and preemption
  
  1. Change BFM/BRM orientation. Confirm SAA/SAB and historical Snippets remain,
     Food changes to the other retained side, old bite progress stops, and marks
     appear in the new Food only when its bounds contain them.
  2. While a dream is active, deliberately scan a new live card D. It may wait
     for the current atomic FOF call, but must run before another old-scene bite.
  3. Confirm D's live `ADDED` reserves and installs a new Impression; old Food,
     bite outline, Snippets, optimistic board copy, and queued dream work cannot
     return afterward.
  4. Switch target seat or use Undo/Clear. Confirm `🐞` and every retained overlay
     disappear and no sweet dream mutates the board afterward.
  
  ### 6. Open Mind closed and P2 evidence closeout
  
  In a fresh Edit Board visit, choose Open Mind closed before the first accepted
  card, then scan normally:
  
  - ordinary live and Food cognition may continue;
  - SAA/SAB/Food/bite/Snippet layers stay hidden;
  - closing presentation does not itself clear the Impression;
  - cockpit controls remain responsive.
  
  Finish with one Open Mind open/closed pulse batch and **Share IMP log**. Confirm
  one readable JSONL file is shared and the next share begins a fresh batch. This
  also supplies the postponed P2-06 current-build evidence without comparing old
  and new SPS numerically.
  
  ## Report back
  
  For each numbered section report **Pass**, **Problem**, or **Not observed**,
  plus:
  
  - build commit and the four Calibrate geometry lines if they changed;
  - which reservoir was Food and the physical A/B/C arrangement;
  - whether C entered the board from Food without reimpression;
  - yellow/green color and alignment observations;
  - live-preemption, replacement, orientation-change, and hard-clear behavior;
  - screenshots and the shared JSONL filename;
  - any visible stall, focus stumble, duplicate, or stale resurrection.
  
  ## Acceptance boundary
  
  One flight may close P2-06's postponed TD checks, I-04g physical smoke, and the
  integrated I-05 through I-07 behavior. It does not close an unobserved branch,
  prove internal queue order from animation alone, or replace the separate Phase
  A permission/onboarding tickets.

  # I-08c — Keep Thoughts alive while Beetle dreams
  
  Status: field-observed design seed; not ready for implementation until wording/state policy is agreed
  
  Phase: I — Impression
  
  Depends on: I-05 BSR, I-06 BCP/FOF dream loop, I-08 field observation
  
  ## Field observation
  
  Open Mind has become a useful cognition aquarium: Archy can see retained
  postcards, Food, the current white Bite outline, ROI Preview, and Snippets while
  Beetle performs retained-Food cognition.
  
  One visibility gap remains:
  
  ```text
  Beetle is actively dreaming / chewing
  -> bite/ROI aquarium changes
  -> Thoughts text does not meaningfully update
  ```
  
  The visual cognition can therefore be alive while the textual Beetle-thought
  surface looks stale.
  
  ## Product intent
  
  Keep **Thoughts** semantically aligned with Beetle's high-level cognitive state
  while Dreams/Cinema run.
  
  This is not a request for a debugger trace or one text update per FOF attempt.
  The aquarium should remain word-light. Thoughts should expose meaningful state
  or reflection changes, not become a scrolling execution log.
  
  ## Vocabulary
  
  Use [`I-vocabulary.md`](I-vocabulary.md):
  
  - **Bite** — one exact white-rectangle view into Food;
  - **Chewing** — local examination through nearby overlapping Bite views after
    something worth chewing appears;
  - **Dream** — one BSR-granted bounded chapter;
  - **Cinema** — a procession of Dreams with BSR reflection between them.
  
  The current landed I-06 stable-Bite behavior is implementation history. This
  ticket should follow the vocabulary/design state approved for I-08b rather than
  inventing a second terminology.
  
  ## Design questions for Archy / Selyn
  
  Before implementation, settle the smallest useful textual grammar:
  
  1. Which high-level events deserve a visible Thoughts update?
     Candidates to discuss include BSR granting/refusing a Dream, entering
     Chewing, completing a Dream, changing Food, or stopping Cinema.
  2. Should Thoughts describe the current activity, the latest BSR reflection,
     or both?
  3. What should remain visible after a Dream ends but before BSR chooses what
     happens next?
  4. Should Open Mind posture affect how much Thoughts says, or should Thoughts
     use the same semantic wording whether the aquarium is open or closed?
  5. When LIVE preempts a Dream, should Thoughts explicitly show the attention
     switch or simply return to ordinary foreground thought?
  
  These are product-language questions. Do not infer answers from current Kotlin
  state names alone.
  
  ## Boundaries
  
  - No per-FOF-attempt text spam.
  - No timing/SPS/queue diagnostics in normal Thoughts prose.
  - Do not make Thoughts the owner of BSR/BCP state; it renders immutable
    cognition publications.
  - Do not weaken LIVE preemption or change dream scheduling merely to make text
    easier to display.
  - Do not equate a still white Bite rectangle with no cognition; repeated or
    local Chewing may occur behind one visual region depending on the active
    design.
  - Do not close the aquarium issue by hiding the aquarium.
  
  ## Acceptance shape — to finalize after design
  
  A future implementation ticket should be able to prove at least:
  
  - when Beetle begins retained-Food cognition, Thoughts no longer remains
    misleadingly stale;
  - meaningful Dream/Cinema state transitions reach Main/UI without per-attempt
    callback pressure;
  - stale-generation or cleared Impression work cannot resurrect old Thoughts;
  - ordinary foreground scanning remains unchanged when no Dream is active;
  - field observation on SM-T350 confirms the text and aquarium tell a coherent
    story together.
  
  Exact strings, publication cadence, and state-to-text mapping remain deliberately
  open until Archy and Selyn design them.

  # P2-06 — SM-T350 software-gait closeout
  
  Status: software-ready and Vel-reviewed; awaiting Archy field evidence
  
  Depends on: P2-03d, P2-04, P2-05
  
  ## Why this is the final gate
  
  All P2 implementation tickets now pass deterministic JVM tests and debug APK
  assembly. The remaining claims concern a physical camera, tablet layout,
  Android sharing, and operator-visible handling. Code cannot honestly check
  those boxes on the workstation.
  
  ## One tablet flight
  
  Use a build at or after `f530079`.
  
  1. Open **Calibrate** and record its four compact `Frame`, `ROI`, `SAA`, and
     `SAB` lines. Its field-tuned camera preview must occupy no more than one
     third of either available screen dimension. Confirm `Resources grounded`

  2. Return to Main Menu, restart the app, and confirm the small live logo-camera
     patch appears briefly while the saved contract is checked. Ordinary menu
     actions must remain unavailable until that check succeeds.
  3. Enter TD with Open Mind on. Scan one new card. Confirm the accepted card,
     `🐞`, SAA/SAB postcards, selected Food, and a readable `IMP` line appear.
  4. During the next second, move another barcode through the visible slit.
     Camera preview must remain live, but that barcode must not land or appear
     later as a delayed result. Present it again after the quiet window and
     confirm ordinary recognition resumes.
  5. Repeat one dense adjacent-card handling sequence. Note whether Love Blonds
     makes repeated reimpression calmer and whether preview/focus still stumbles.
  6. Run the normal Open Mind open/closed pulse batch from
     [`measuring.md`](../optimizations/measuring.md), then press **Share IMP log**
     once. Confirm one readable JSONL batch is produced and the next share starts
     a fresh batch.
  
  ## Evidence boundary
  
  Compare `A/C/B/M`, preview continuity, apparent focus, and handling delay with
  the older P2 baseline. Do **not** compare old and new SPS numerically: P2-05
  changed SPS from live Analyzer ingress to completed Beetle-owned FOF tempo.
  
  Report:

  - whether the IMP line and Share action work on the SM-T350;

  - [ ] Current-build deliberate inside/outside-window and dense-handling check.
  - [ ] Current-build open/closed pulse batch and JSONL share.
  
  The ten batches under
  [`SessionP2-06`](../optimizations/SessionP2-06/README.md) contain 123 real
  tournament pulses, but the installed APK predates the nine-ticket P2 convoy.
  They are retained as the pre-convoy tournament baseline rather than mislabeled

  The remaining current-build TD checks are deliberately folded into the
  [`I-08 consolidated SM-T350 flight`](I-08-sm-t350-impression-cognition-flight.md),
  so I-06/I-07 can land in small automated commits before one coherent physical
  session.
